title: Good Dry Skin Ingredients, But I Don’t Get The Obvious Plumping Benefits I Get w/ Patchology Gels
text:
I have dry, sensitive skin and love using eye gel patches as they can feel so soothing and refreshing, and some immediately plump and smooth my fine lines around my eyes. My favorite gels are by Patchology as I get amazing results. The GenSkin marine algae gels seem good quality and they do make my skin feel soft, but I don’t see the obvious plumping benefits I get with the Patchology gels and these gels also don’t feel as comforting or refreshing. I’ve even compared by wearing one of each brand at the same time, and my skin with the Patchology gel gets superior results as my lines barely show.

These GenSkin gels are deep blue and have added colorant (which is typical). They also have fragrance, but it doesn’t smell overly strong. The GenSkin patches stay on well and have some good dry skin ingredients, such as sodium hyaluronate, glycerin, beta glucan, matricaria flower extract and butylene glycol. Most ingredients rate low risk by EWG (other than fragrance, colorant and preservative). These seem good, but I just don’t get the comfort or obvious plumping and hydration I get with Patchology gels. So these are just okay for me. 3 stars. Made in China.

Overall, I would recommend them as a nice way to familiarize yourself with the options and choose what works for you. I wish the company offered separate packs of 10 of each kind as they sell on their website.

text: I have an aunt in another state who is a hair dresser. Years ago, she asked me if I wanted to perm my lashes when she came down to visit. I thought she was crazy! This was like 10 years ago. Anyhows, then i've been doing exentions for about a year now but I am finding that my lash is getting worst and worst.. like when my extensions fall out, I barely have lashes! I used to have average lash that  I could curl. But now it seems like I barely have anything. So this is why I decided to finally consider perming my lash. So perming the did not make it longer by any means! What it did though is made it look like I had lashes that were longer but it curved up! My lash tends to grow straight. It may have have to do with the fact that I have asian eyes. So the curling has always been important when I used to wear mascara. The thing is I hate that sometimes it poked at me and the curler would yank some lashes out!  Also I just hate it doing it every day. With perm lashes, you don't have to do this. However, I don't know if I could have done this alone. I had to get a friend to help me. She said it was pretty easy. What took the longest is us reading things over and over to make sure we weren't going to make me blind! I think it took about an hour or so? I can't recall exactly as we didn't time it.  The reason I am giving it 4 stars is that you really cannot do this by yourself.  Now it may not look drastic to most people bc they don't usually notice your lashes. title: A LOT of power for really bad feet.
text:
I am going to confess something, my feet are hideous. My family make fun my feet all the time and call them barney rubble feet. I basically walk around barefoot almost 24/7 and never go for pedicures. I would go for a pedi but I am too embarrassed at how bad my feet were. I will be the first to say I neglect my feet, they are (or should I say were) very callused and stained. My heels had deep cracks from neglect and three years of being barefoot almost exclusively. Today my callus remover came and I have to say I am impressed. I shop on amazon ALOT and it takes a lot for me to go out of my way to write a review but this gadget deserves one.

First, out of the box it looks to be a heavy duty machine. Thick power cord and a decent weight but not cumbersome. It looks built to last. It has enough power on low to do a major overhaul on the hardest and deepest of calluses. User beware this thing packs a punch. Don't spent more than a couple seconds on an area or you will feel the burn quick. Try just tapping the head on your calluses. Go against the direction of the spin because it will run off on you. It's strong enough to sand down thick toenails too. My feet have never looked this good.

No worries for lack of power on this thing, if you are looking for a gentle buffer this isn't it so if you feet are in decent shape look for something a little less aggressive. If your feet look like they walk over hot coals from time to time, this baby will take care of that in one quick session. My feet are super smooth and look like brand new, albeit a little sore.

title: Nice electric shaver by Wahl
text:
I had a set of Wahl clippers that lasted for over a decade. I finally got a new pair of clippers and through the old clippers away. I miss my old Wahl clippers they were a super workhorse set of clippers. I had no idea that Wahl even made shavers.

I have had quite a few high-end electric shavers, and they all have the same problem, they just don't shave as close as a razor. The positive thing about electric shavers is that they are easy to use for quick touch ups and convenient shaves when you don't want to mess with water and creams and lotions.

This Wahl shaver, in particular, is pretty nice. It shaves about as close as other electric shavers, which isn't as close as a manual razor, but with repeated use and going back and forth, it is better than no shave. Some type of pre-shave lotion, like Williams Lectric shave, helps a little.

Still, this is a pretty decent shaver. It charges fast and holds the charge for a long time. The top pops off easy to clean the blades. You can use the provided brush or just rinse it off with water. You can also use it in the shower or wet/dry shave. The directions say not to submerge it under 3 feet of water.

It also has a shaver that pops up for sideburns or whatever you would want a clean smooth line on. Bottom line this is a pretty good shaver.

"You get what you pay for" applies here. Bought the hair for a wedding I was in so I wasn't exactly looking for the best of the best (quality/longevity wise). When it arrived, it felt great and looked great (even though it's not as wavy as the seller's pic) but had an unpleasant smell to it, telling me it was probably shipped overseas to the warehouse. The smell lingered but got less noticeable after two washes and a deep condition before installation. When I did the washing, I was disappointed to notice that it did not curl at all. No versatility meant I would have to keep straightening my hair to blend it (I usually wear my hair natural... Bye bye curl pattern!). I've never known Brazilian hair to have 0 curl to it. It straightens very well though!

Sooooo...I've had it in for a month and while it looks okay, it has been tangling and shedding like crazy, even after careful handling (brush 3x day, condition every week, wear scarf to bed). I also have to blow dry or flat iron it or it will look ratty. Still, this was an amazing deal and when I take my sweet time to condition, detangle, blow dry and flat iron my hair and the extensions, I look like a fat Pocahontas and I love it. I might take it out, boil or perm it curly and give it another try if it hasn't shed too much. The hair isn't terrible, but I would probably not recommend it to a friend. Maybe a coworker.

Also, I appreciated the free lashes!

title: A fairly aggressive razor
text:
Coming from my mild Rimei and Baili razors, I'd say this razor is pretty aggressive. Significantly higher blade exposure than what I'm used to. I have very coarse, tough facial hairs, but pretty sensitive skin on my throat and upper lip, so as you can imagine, shaving can be a nightmare for me if the razor and blade combo is wrong.

I like this razor, but it will take some getting used to. I would recommend using a less sharp, smoother blade at first, such as a Derby or a Big Ben, unless you already know you can handle the combination of an aggressive razor with a very sharp blade.

I first ordered the Rapira Swedish Supersteel razor, but it came with a bent guard (looked damaged in shipping), so I sent it back. Aside from that, that razor has a metal handle (zinc?) and the weight was more balanced towards the handle. This razor is overall lighter and the weight is more balanced towards the head, which I prefer. The head on both razors is the same Tech-type design.

The handle is good, probably not as tough as a metal handle though. I'd prefer a better grip on it, similar to a rougher checkered surface like on a plastic rifle stock or something, but it does the job.

Kind of gross actually, but her feet are looking so much nicer now!  The only issue she had is that the plastic "no mess socks" that come with the kit were too small for her size 10 feet.  She had to squish her feet into them, which left very little room to move her feet inside to work the gel around, which is what the directions say you should do. This came with three colors of crimp beads which is nice for different colors of hair to help blend it into the roots. I put one in my teenaged daughters hair to show her how to do it, and after that she found it easy enough to do in both her and other peoples hair. They go in and seem pretty durable since they are synthetic. The color will last longer than a real dye job will. The colors are bright and fun. title: Above average shaver, doesn't irritate my skin, pretty
text:
The Arcitec is replacing my almost 3 year old [[ASIN:B0012TLPBQ Philips Norelco Speedxl Men's Shave]] which served me well for all this time but, when the time came to replace the old 8140XL's heads I happened to notice that a brand-new Arcitec was available as a 'lightning deal' for some $35 more so I took advantage of the opportunity. After several weeks of using it I can say that the Arcitec is 'better' that the 8140XL and I am therefore pleased with my purchase. While the end result of shaving is basically the same which is not surprising because the Arcitec implements the same 'lift and cut' technology, it appears to be much gentler to my skin, the more flexible shaving heads better follow my face and neck, has a better grip, comes with a more protective storage/charger pod and, of course, is prettier.

But, let's go into some details:

PACKAGING, CONTENTS AND PRESENTATION

The shaver comes to you inside a triple-layered protective/defensive enclosure, hard plastic over cardboard over another clamshell (but easy to open) protective plastic layer. It's not totally bullet-proof but it probably ensures that most units don't suffer any damage while in transit.

Inside I found:

- The shaver itself
- Super-protective (for travel mostly) charging pod
- Cleaning brush
- Charging stand
- Sliding razor head cap
- 100/240V power cord
- User manual and warranty statement (English/Spanish)
- Quick start guide card

Taking the shaver out of its packaging, understanding its operation and making it work was relatively easy.

The manual, covering FOUR separate models is surprisingly well written to the extent that you are not annoyed by having to find the paragraph that applies to your specific model so, know thy model number (it's a 1050). It covers everything, from features, charging options, shaving tips and techniques, cleaning, storage and replacement of the razor head. I've actually read it and I am better off for it.

FEATURES AND OPERATION

Charging
--------
This is one of Arcitec's better features. The manual claims (verified) that it can take a full charge in about one hour and, once charged. I didn't count shaving minutes but, at least with a brand-new battery you won't need to recharge it very often. In 'emergencies', just 3 minutes of charging should give you 3 minutes of shave time.

There is no way to replace the battery inside the shaver but, based on my experience with Architec's precursor, my 2.5 year old 8140XL, this should not be an issue. After all these years the battery still allows me to shave several times before a recharge is needed.

You charge your shaver by either placing it on the charging stand or inside the charging pod. Philips recommends that you do not keep the charging stand continuously connected to the power outlet and I have no problem with that. One one-hour charge session keeps my shaver going for several weeks (I only shave 2-3 times per week).

Shaving
--------
The feature most of us buy a shaver for :)... It's okay, for an electric shaver. I won't say that "it's as close as a blade" because it isn't but that's not why I switched from blade shaving to electric some 7 years ago. I am using an electric shaver because shaving with a blade had my skin irritated, especially on my neck. The 8140XL was okay but my neck still felt uncomfortable. The Architec does NOT irritate my neck at all and this is a very good thing.

The above comes with a price. Shaving takes a lot longer. You need to go over the same area several times before all the hairs are 'lifted and cut' but that was a tradeoff I understood and I accepted. Norleco claim that the Arcitec has "50% more shaving surface" (compare with the old 8140XL claim of "up to 50% more shaving surface") is just marketing hype and always left me ask myself "50% more than what?". The reality is that the 3 heads together add up to a decent shaving surface, and the Arcitec's are not larger than the 8140XL's but I would not call them 'humongously large". And, again, contrary to marketing claims, shaving with the Arcitec or with just about any other electric shaver is not 'fast'.

As I noted before, the Arcitec is very gentle to my skin and this is the main reason, other than good looks, that I prefer it over the older model. Sometimes you need to go several times over the same neck spot because 'lift and cut' is good but not perfect but my experience with the Arcitec is that my skin tolerates it pretty well.

Trimmer
--------
A small trimmer can be pulled out when needed. I am not going to use it that much but I was able to successfully and quickly trim my mustache. It's a useful feature.

Other bells and whistles
-----------------------
When needed, a number of indicators/warnings discretely light up on shaver's body: low battery, charing indicator, needs cleaning indicator, travel lock and shaving head replacement indicator.

MAINTENANCE

I don't like spending a lot of time taking care of my shaving tools and the Arcitec does not need a lot of maintenance. Each of the 3 individual heads can be opened and the hair fragments stored inside are washed away in seconds. Any that don't go can be removed with the providing brush. It's possible to also use liquid soap or degreasing liquid (alcohol) solutions for cleaning but I haven't yet.

The trimmer, if used extensively, could use a couple of drops of mineral oil once or twice per year.

Norelco recommends that the full shaving head assembly is replaced once a year and an 'replace head' indicator should light up on the shaver when that time comes but we are not there yet and I will be making that decision when the time comes.

SUPPORT AND WARRANTY

There is a 45-day money back guarantee. Philips Norelco promise to fully refund your purchase price if you ship them back the product within 45 days of your purchase date. You will be paying for shipping and insurance and they are not responsible for lost items - therefore the need for insurance.

In addition, there is a 2-year limited warranty and warrants against defects and, of course, you lose coverage if you abuse your shaver or you try to fix it your self or through unauthorized repairers.

The 800 numbers you need to call for support or warranty service are printed on several locations on the box and on the manual.

Made in Holland.

DESIGN AND ERGONOMICS

'The looks' is clearly Arcitec's distinguishing feature. I like it but I'm not going to say more because everyone can see the images posted on Amazon's page. As I noted above, all indicators and warnings light up when only when needed and are invisible at any other time. The Arcitec's body shape makes for a very comfortable grip while shaving. I also appreciated the little suction cups at the bottom of the charging stand that add to its stability.

The charging pod, on the other hand, is a little too bulky and it's not easy to close/open and it can't store then shaver while the heads cap is on. I didn't take it on the road yet but, when I do I may appreciate how it protects my shaver but, on the other hand, I don't believe any of my shavers was ever damaged while travelling so I'm not so sure the bulkiness is justified.

Finally, I wish there was some 'case' to carry or store everything. The way the shaver comes, it's possibly to store it inside the pod but then the heads cap, the cleaning brush and the charging cord are 'outside' and they are easy to lose, especially the first two.

MY RATING

I am pleased with my purchase and Arcitec is now my 'regular' shaver. Losing the occasional red spots on my neck was very much worth it. Besides the comfortable shave the Arcitec comes with pretty good support (money back promise, 800 support number), looks good and, based on my prior experience with an earlier Philips Norelco shaver, is likely to last for a long, long time. Some of the marketing claims: quick shave, 50% larger (than what???) are a little bit exaggerated but... that's what our reviews are for.

I hesitated between 4 (I like it) and 5 (I love it) stars. If you expect the Arcitec to fulfill all the marketing claims, you may be slightly disappointed but if you know what to expect from an electric shaver and understand that real-world miracles are very rare, then a 5 star may be the fair rating. I will do a 4 stars at this time for a good quality, well designed electric shaver that appears to be an incremental improvement over previous generations but whose capabilities may be a little over-hyped.

text:

I really enjoy trying different parfums to help me find a new fresh scent or to combine with other scents to come up with my own combined signature scent. The seller does a wonderful job of delivering quickly and well packaged. The cologne is very pretty in it's design in a feminine curved bottle with black lace on the front which looks nice on my dresser or vanity.This perfume definitely smells great. It has a sheer musk undertone that is very inviting, you can also smell fruitiness and a slight hint floral and sweet undertones like flowers. It is a very feminine scent but also very seductive but not overpowering. It's difficult to describe scents but all I can say is it really does smell wonderful, it doesn't give me a headache and my fiance loves it. I find that it lasts longer if I spay it on pulse points. I receive complements a lot of times while wearing it I definitely recommend this wonderful perfume and would absolutely say try it. This is a 1.9 ounce bottle at under 13.00 delivered to your door. I purchased this product at a discounted price in exchange for my honest review. The discount I received will not alter my honest opinion in any way. Since I count on honest product reviews to make my selections on Amazon, I will always be forthcoming and sincere in all my reviews. No matter if the product is discounted or not, I will leave honest feedback that I base on my own personal experience with the product I receive. *One last note, I wasn't sure what the difference in Eau De Parfum and Perfume is, so I looked it up. Here's what I found on the web on perfume website:
Eau de parfum. "After the top notes have died away, the middle notes or heart notes of a perfume become noticeable. This is the focus of eau de parfum which makes it perfect to spray on hair or clothing. (Be careful with delicate fabrics such as silk, though, as they may stain.) The concentration of oils is over 15%, sometimes reaching as high as 20%. Since it is less intense than perfume extract, it is also cheaper, but it usually lasts well and is sold in small sizes." So it is stronger than Eau de Cologne which contains about 7% essence dissolved in alcohol of 60º or 70º, and stronger than Eau de toilette which contains around 10% aromatic essence. But not as strong as Perfume. This is the strongest of scents because of the higher concentration of essences – as much as 40% by volume.

text:
Disclaimer: I received this product at a discounted price in exchange for a fair review.

These tattoos are just like the temporary/fake tattoos we all played with as kids - just a grown up, chic version.

The package comes with 2 sheets of tattoos. One sheet contains 6 tattoos in different patterns that range 7-7.75" in length, perfect for bracelet applications or vertical placement on the side of your forearm. The other sheet contains 14 tattoos comprised mostly of feathers (bird, peacock) and other patterns that include a cherry, a diamond, triangles, and 2 tattoos meant to be necklaces. Each sheet comes with instructions with pictures on the back. There's also a separate sheet with instructions.

The tattoos are very easy to apply. However, if you're applying as a bracelet, it's best to seek the help of another so that your skin isn't stretched which helps the tattoo to stick better. Make sure that your skin is clean and dry, and free of any oils or lotions before applying. These tattoos are great for parties and stick on your skin even after a few washings. It looks like it's already been used for a week. I attached a photo of how it looks after me only using it twice on my face and hands. That is why this product gets 4 stars instead of 5. For $25, I do not feel that you're getting your money's worth.

With that being said, Korean skin care is always amazing. This lotion in particular smells like roses, but it's not overpowering. It's also light enough where it absorbed into my skin, which I am happy about, because I want to be able to put this on in the morning and put makeup over top of it.

It does not make my skin look shiny. It's not tacky or sticky. It leaves my skin feeling very, very soft and luminous, which does make me look very youthful and pretty. Overall, I think this product does what it claims to do. It's a great skin care product, and I will use this every day, but it will probably only last me about one month. I am in my 20's, and I do not have any major skin problems or wrinkles. I am not the best case study for a before-and-after, but I do like this a lot more than many other lotions I have tried.

I was going to go to the .99 store and get more but I saw the BAMBOO handle and thought, wow that is earth friendly! title: Aloe Vera Gel
text:
The description for this Aloe Vera Gel by CIMIY Skin Care confuses me a little. One of the uses suggested by the manufacturer is to put the gel on before going outside, “which can protect skin from sunburns.” This gel has hyaluronic acid listed as an ingredient, which can actually make skin even more sensitive to UV rays.

Aloe Vera is great for soothing sunburns *after* exposure. This gel absorbed into my skin after about a minute, without leaving behind a sticky or tacky feeling. I’ve used some aloe vera gels that have left me a sticky mess, but not this one. So I like the quick absorption.

The gel does have a slight scent to it. It’s a fresh-smelling scent that sticks around for a while.

This Aloe Vera gel would also be great for homemade hand sanitizer.

This gel is manufactured in China.

title: Good, but a word of caution for people with sensitive teeth
text:
The nice thing about this toothbrush is that it uses the same heads as most of Oral-B's other toothbrushes. This is a basic model, which probably cleans just as well as their other models. The battery lasted me about a week of twice a day brushing, and the battery indicator tells you when you'll need to recharge it a few brushing sessions in advance. Don't ignore it too long, because it takes about 18 hours to charge it fully, but charging it about an hour should be good enough for one brushing. The charger is small and doesn't take up much room in a drawer.

The small head really works well for cleaning the sides of your teeth and between them. Oral-B talks about the cupping action and it really works like the polishing tools most hygienists use. It even seemed to dig food particles stuck between my teeth(!), but you'll still want to floss where no toothbrush can reach. If you have gum issues, this may be the ideal toothbrush for you.

The dual clean head got my teeth acceptably clean faster, but it's noticeably bigger and the precision clean head worked better overall for me. It's nice that they included two different brush heads so you can see which you prefer.

Unfortunately, the slower pulsing action seems to irritate my teeth. A week or two after I started using this toothbrush, my molars started to ache. I ended up returning it and going back to my other Oral-B, whose head looks more like a normal toothbrush which vibrates up & down very quickly. It doesn't clean along the gum line quite as well, but seems to clean the grinding surfaces of molars slightly better.

Oral-B also sells softer toothbrush heads which people seem to like and may be better for my sensitive teeth.

I added another star for Amazon's good customer service and considering that most people don't seem to have sensitive teeth. In general, just about any electric toothbrush will do a much better job cleaning your teeth, removing plaque, etc., etc. - much better than a manual brush. Try one. If you don't like it, a different type may be better for you too.

text:

Summer is coming and his back is a mess. I bought him a puff on a stick and gave him this dude face wash and asked him to wash his back with it and see how it works.
Some of the ingredients are natural while some are not. The ingredients are- Aqua, Aloe Barbadensis (Aloe Vera) Extract Organic, Lauryl Glucoside, Decyl Glucoside, Cocamidopropyl Betaine, Sodium Cocoyl Glutamate, Certified Organic Glycerin and Aqua and Certified Organic Eleutherococcus Senticosus (Ginseng) and Parfum, Aqua and Glycerin and Paullinia Cupana Seed Extract (Guarana) and Citric Acid and Sodium Benzoate, Hamamelis Virginiana (Witch Hazel) Extract, Chamomilla Recutita (Chamomile) Extract, Citrus Aurantium Bergamia (Bergamot) Oil, Juniperus Virginiana (Cedarwood) Bark Oil, Pogostemon Cablin (Patchouli) Oil, Citrus Grandis (Grapefruit) Peel Oil, Lavandula Angustifolia (Lavender) Oil, Pelargonium Graveolens (Geranium) Oil, Melaleuca Alternifolia (Tea Tree) Leaf Oil, Helichrysum Italicum (Immortelle) Flower Oil, Coriandrum Sativum (Coriander) Oil, Glyceryl Caprylate, Potassium Sorbate, *Limonene, *Linalool, *Geraniol, *Citral, *Citronellol, *Benzyl Cinnamate *Component of Essential Oil.
The first day he came out of the shower complaining that it smelled like Patchouli (He despises the smell of Patchouli) I didn’t smell the patchouli but looked at the ingredients and wouldn’t you know it has Patchouli in it. He kept on using it anyway though thankfully. It has been 3 weeks now and there is a difference in the acne on his back. He is still getting some breakouts, but it is NOTHING like it was before. I think after continuing to use this for a few months most of the acne on his back will be gone in time for the summer. title: A beautiful, natural, dewy finish..
text:
Let me start by saying, I did NOT order this from Amazon. I ordered it from Sephora. The reviews here regarding whether this product was a fake or not made me a little leery. So, I'm reviewing the real Josie Maran Vibrancy foundation and not the Amazon version, real or not.

As usual, I ordered the lightest shade, RG5. It's a nearly perfect match. It's described as being for fair skin with neutral undertones. I typically prefer foundations with pink undertones, but this actually worked really well for me.

The consistency is on the thin, runny side, which isn't surprising since oil is an ingredient. Having said that, this foundation sits on the skin so beautifully. It looks like real skin. It's definitely not a matte foundation, so if that's your preference, this is not the foundation for you. This foundation gives you more luminous, dewy-looking skin. I don't typically care for dewy foundations, but again, I was surprised to like this one. It just made my skin look healthy and plump. It didn't look at all heavy, which is great because it didn't settle into my fine lines. I did notice it took a while to set. Again, not surprising considering the oil content, but you'll want to make sure you set it with powder before trying to blend blush/contour/bronzer, etc. Otherwise, you'll likely look pretty streaky.

Many reviewers here have mentioned a smell. I didn't notice that at all, which is another reason I think the product people are buying here might not be legit.

The only reason I gave this 4 stars instead of 5 is because my t-zone gets oily fairly quickly while wearing it.

I'd recommend this for more mature skin and dry skin types. If you're oily, you can definitely still wear it, you just might have to blot a bit more than usual.

Overall, though, a great foundation. Just make sure it's what you're looking for. It's a very specific look.

title: Pretty Metallic Looks More Bronze Than Rose, Sticky Formula, Feels Drying, Best w/ Gloss Over It
text:
This Beauty Bakerie Lip Whip Liquid Metallic Lipstick in Rosé Posé comes in a cute tube and is a pretty metallic color lipstick that spreads on with a sponge type wand. The color reads darker on me than I’d expect from the photo, but it’s a lovely metallic shade that looks like a bronze with rose hue or a little rose gold in it. I have light skin with an olive hue and rosy color lips, and this color is flattering but is probably even better on medium and dark skin tones.

But, while this lipstick initially spreads on smooth and velvety, it stays sticky and doesn’t fully dry down on me even with just one application. It doesn’t feel comfortable as I tend to get dry lips and it adds no moisture (and may be drying my lips more). Used alone, it accentuates lines and flakiness even used after a great lip scrub. And it doesn’t work applied over a little lip balm as it rolls off in weird little pieces. All 10 spray bottles included all the necessary parts, and the stem that draws up liquid was long in each one, none were short and I really appreciated that. You should be able to spray down to the last drop. I tested mine with rubbing alcohol, for sanitizing my phones. The funnel came in handy for filling the bottle. It made the job so easy! The sprayer does spray a very fine mist. I used it several times to clean some things then left it overnight with the cap on. Next day I tested it again. First off, the cap contained some of the rubbing alcohol inside it, which means the container will leak into the cap standing up. Not necessarily a huge deal breaker, but a negative for me. Holding it in my hand I got the rubbing alcohol on my finger too, so this may waste product just from this. Several drops every 24 hours may not seem like a lot, but if you make your own essential oil room spray then this could be an expensive waste. Lastly, I had an issue with the spray top, the angle is so slight I wasn't sure if I would spray myself in the face of I wasn't wearing eyeglasses. You have to be careful, ensuring you're spraying away from yourself. I did not get any leakage of the alcohol out of the cap, it seemed pretty tight. It did pool in the cap, didn't run down the bottle. I did get a rubbing alcohol ring when I set down the cap on my coffee table tho. Beware of that possibility whatever you use in these bottles.
All in all, a nice kit and I give it 4 stars.

title: Heats up quickly.
text:
[[VIDEOID:1998f82c98c1bbb520f99c753a936492]] The latest hair craze if the hair straightening brush, and I will admit to having one, using it, and loving it. The only thing that I have disliked about it is that it is a little heavy, and since my hair is super curly, I have to run it through my hair a lot, and my hand does get tired. Even if I'm rotating hands, it still takes a really long time. Even though my hair is short, it's just really thick and curly. So I don't love straightening it, and my go-to when I am straightening my hair had been the straightening brush. But I actually like this one better.
The LED screen is very easy to read, even while in use. The hair brush bristles are very nice, and seemingly durable as none of them broke off while I was straightening my hair. And again, it's not as heavy as the hair straightening brushes that has been the latest craze.
Its very user friendly, and it heats up super fast. The rotating cord is a nice feature, I don't think that I would ever straighten my hair if I had to constantly untangle the cord. That's just another frustration that doesn't even need to be added on, in my opinion. But that's a nice design.
When you are curling your hair, keep the black piece on the curler facing your head, otherwise it will be a MESS. If you have super curly hair like I do, it will be PERFECT for taming down your curls, which is exactly how I use it.
Also, don't use this on your hair if its wet. Just wait until it's dry, I get an eye twitch when I see somebody or hear somebody straightening their hair when it's wet. It does nothing but kill your hair, causes split ends, and you can't come back from something like that. So, just wait until your hair is dry.
Make sure your hair also has ZERO tangles otherwise it WILL get stuck and THAT is no fun at all. Tiny strands will also be best, unless you like untangling your hair...

title: i wish i knew how to use ALL the brushes...
text:
I was so excited to receive this set. I already had a brush set from Mary Kay, that I love; but, I it only has 5 brushes.
Since I like to contour and highlight (subtly), I mostly needed brushes for this.
Researching sets produced a huge price range. One could spend upwards of $70.00, with comparable brush sets. Yikes!! This set is much more affordable. The brush handles are solid and bristles are firmly attached. Some brushes are softer than others.

So, if they are quality brushes and the price is reasonable, why am I only rating them 4 stars? I had no clue what each brush was for, and the internet wasn't very helpful:(
If the brushes had been labeled, or there had been an insert explaining the function/functions of each brush--it would have received 5 stars. Add pictures/diagrams for tips on use, even better. I would be willing to pay a little extra for an easy to clean roll-up case for the brushes. A girl needs to keep her brushes clean. That is a feature, I believe many look for. I travel a lot, so my roll up bag (for my other set) is essential.
As it is, Cosmopolitan magazine's website has an article on how to use different makeup brushes. It was helpful for a few of the brushes, which I now use everyday.

What I love:
*The sponges are fabulous for applying foundation and blending after you contour/highlight.
*The large, angled brush is great for applying blush, so it looks more natural.
*The large, pointed brush does a nice job, when adding bronzer to contour.
*The large, round brush is what I rely on for swirling on powder.
*The small, pointed brush is phenomenal at applying color at applying contour eye shadow.
* I use the small, tall bristled, rounded brush to blend the areas of shadow on my eyes that need softening.

What I didn't like:
*Obviously, not knowing what each brush is for.
*The eyeshadow? brushes use too much product and application is sparse. I believe it's because the bristles are stiffer than what I usually use.
*No case to keep them clean, which leads me to look for alternative solutions. Leaving them out in the air, exposed, is a bad idea. Think of the germs in the air, especially if you keep them on the bathroom sink. Eww! Bacteria grows quickly and can cause infections, such as pink eye.
User Tip: I use baby shampoo to wash my brushes. It is gentle on your brushes and it gets the job done.
I received this product at a discount, in exchange for my honest feedback and unbiased review.

title: Has artificial fragrance, smells amazing
text:
TLDR: GET THIS mask if you know you dont react to fragrance and simply like the smell of honey. DO NOT get this mask if you are looking for a mask with lots of honey and no added fragrance ingredients.

My skin loves honey. I have therefore tried many honey masks in pursuit of one that my face loves the most. I almost returned this face mask because when I recieved it, one of them seemed to have leaked through the plastic package they were bundled in. However, after deciding that my face needed honey and it wasn't really worth it to return it, I decided to give these guys a go.

Let me first say that this mask is the best smelling mask I have tried yet. I cant believe how lovely it smells, it took me back a bit. This concerned me of course as when something smells amazing it usually has fragrance added to it. When looking at the ingredients, I found that it does have "fragrance" in the ingredients, though it is farther down on the list of ingredients so it is not very much.

Near the bottom too, however, is propolis. Which is the only ingredient related to honey in this mask. Which was rather disappointing as this means this mask has hardly any honey in it.

I probably wont reorder this unless my skin somehow loves it.

title: Not sure of the 5-Star rave Reviews here on Amazon for this Goat Milk Soap? It was not for me
text:
I just purchased an 8-Bar Pack of this Australian Botanical Goats Milk Soya Bean Oil Soap for $18.00 here on Amazon from A Seller Called, Asset Liquidation Sales. I expected allot better quality, moisturizing & clean rinsing Soap for my Face & Body with this Goat Milk Soap that is Made in Australia... The turnout from me with the first use of this Soap for just Three Days was not appealing nor was it moisturizing to me in any way! When I washed my Face with it in the Mornings & Evenings, it lathered up quite well. However when I rinsed it off, I could feel & right away noticed that it was not a clean rinsing Soap. It left a kind of sticky, oily residue feeling on my Face & Hands while rinsing it off. Then about 30 to 45 Minutes after washing with this Soap, I really noticed the unwelcome & unwanted Soap Scum residue left over from this Soap on my Face & my Skin was no longer even one bit moisturized but instead, dry, Soap Scummy Residue feeling & was becoming very itchy because of this non clean rinsing Goat Milk Soap. My hands were really & truly showing the left over Soap Scum Residue from this Soap as for they were turning very White scaly, dry Color about an Hour after use & cracking which they were not near this bad before using this Soap.

Therefore, in my opinion, this Soap is of not great quality, cleans Skin very poorly & does not rinse clean off of the Skin at all. Thus leaving behind a hidden but noticeably delayed Soap Scum Residue which from me does not earn this Soap no crazy rave 5-Stars like many others here have reviewed & given this Soap. I won't buy this Soap again or even this brand of Soap & am simply donating the remaining unused 7-Bars to my local Salvation Army Thrift Store just to get rid of it out of my House & Hands.

title: Aromatic bars of "Soap Shields" that gently scrub & cleanse
text:
These small bars of soap smell really good and perform well in terms of cleansing and not leaving skin feeling stripped. I like that they are made in USA, handmade in Ohio. These are not fancy soaps. They are small, but they are not necessarily travel sized. They just have a good size and shape that fits perfectly into the hand. That stood out to me on first use. I really like how well it fits in my hand. The bars are tear dropped or pear shaped. More specifically, it is shaped to be a like a defense shield. Get it? As this is meant to be a bit of an immune defense/support item.

The bars are thin, but not fragile. I can palm it and easily rub it all over without it falling out of my hand. I have been using one bar on and off for a couple of weeks now, and it isn't just disappearing. There are six loose bars in a resealable bag.

The soap has a slight intentional grit to it . This adds some scrubbing action. Creates a nice lather and rinses well. The scent is an intriguing mix of essential oils. Clove, Cinnamon, Oregano, Peppermint, Parsley, Eucalyptus and Rosemary essential oils Not overpowering. Really quite nice.

It has been an odd, but unexpectedly pleasant product to use. The price is budget friendly. I find nothing bad about them or my experience so far. I may consider them again when I run out. I really think they are worth the try.

That is basically the whole bottle... so if you can afford to spend $30 on every shampoo, maybe it will work better for you. I used one pump on the top of my hair, one pump on the bottom and then after I rinsed it out, one more pump to leave on my ends. The first two days it made my hair look supermodel perfect... after that, it was so disgustingly greasy that I couldn't handle it. I started to work back a shampoo into my routine here and there to help with that- but now every single time I use it, its nothing but grease and weighed down matted down hair. title: Smells Lovely But Very Weak
text:
I bought my first two Auric Blends perfumes two years ago and was very pleased. I bought another two last summer and two more just recently. The scents are lovely and I wish I could describe them in detail, but the last four perfumes I bought are more diluted each time and I can't pick up on the depth of the fragrances. I even wrote an email to Auric Blends politely voicing concern. I understand perfume ingredients must be expensive, but "watering down" perfumes with carrier oil to make the batch more cost efficient is compromising the product. I, and I believe many of my fellow Auric Blends fans will agree, would be fine with a small price increase if it meant the perfumes could be concentrated again. I sincerely mean that, because I like this company.

The latest two I purchased are Sandalwood and Divine Opium. Sandalwood is woody and sweet. Divine Opium has similar notes to my favorite Black Opium but a little brighter. Like I said, they're so weak that the full fragrance notes are hard to pick up on, and the scent fades quickly.

title: Does what it says
text: Out of work right now so cannot afford my "every 3 week" pedicures.  I have supination where I walk on the outside of my feet which causes excessive callouses to grow on my heels.  I always use a pumice stone after every shower but have had to have the manicurist use the heel razor. Now, our state has outlawed the use of the razors.  I find using this callous remover does help a lot.  However, if I go too long without getting my heels scraped, the right heel splits open and well...it is very uncomfortable.  Needless to say, don't use the product if you have any sores or cuts on your feet.  I used rubber gloves to apply then tied my feet up with plastic bags and let sit 20 minutes.  Then I used a foot rasp while product is still on the feet.  Was amazed at how much callous the product removed.  Afterward I washed real well.  I think this product is good for those times you cannot get a pedicure and you want to do it at home.  However, if you do have excessive callouses and feet problems, you might want to discuss options with a podiatrist as this product may not do well.

text:

The lavender scent is earthy and natural. It has a deep lavender scent that is fairly strong. As it is a more natural deodorant, it does not glide like the big name brands. It has a slight moisture to it and by warming the deodorant, it slide slightly better.

I have noticed that I need to reapply. Depending on my activity level, I have had to reapply two or three times throughout a day. I think the important thing to remember with these natural deodorants is to not expect them to perform like the big name brands. They provide minimal long term fragrance as well as sweat protection.

title: Not sure what all the fuss is about...
text:
I will be the first to admit I hate taking baths; it bores me out of my skull. But because I have chronic pain, I've occasionally taken Epsom salt baths or bubble baths with a fantastic product called Muscle Soak. I found the salts were no longer really helping, so I thought I'd try these magnesium flakes. I take magnesium daily but a boost through the muscles that ache sounds great.

I was floored at how quickly and completely they dissolved. The tub wasn't done filling and they were fully absorbed into the water. With salts, I have to get in and stir repeatedly to get the crystals to dissolve, often in water that's hotter than comfortable. So that was promising.

I got in the tub and lay back, focused on the flower print on the wall....and was ready to get out in 15 minutes, but I wanted to give it the full 30. I wasn't magically relaxed or calmed by the bath as other reviewers are claiming. (You literally can't tell the flakes are there, as the water isn't salty like it is with Epsom salts.) I wasn't whisked away to a lush garden in my mind. I was just lying in a bathtub with pleasantly hot/warm water. While I was in the water and for up to an hour after I got out and showered, I felt a limited, temporary reduction in the tightness in my upper back. I put on a compression shirt to help things along but had 9/10 pain. When I can next score some Muscle Soak, I'll be going back to that. The bubbles are at least something to play with! And it is more effective on achy muscles.

This is not a magic cure for stress or pain. I'll use it to soak my feet when they ache, but don't expect miracles. If Epsom salts don't make a big difference, these flakes probably won't either.

title: Salon Quality Gel Manicures at Home
text:
This is a nice set of six nail polishes, all in identical black bottles. I assume this is because the polishes are light sensitive and so the black bottles protect all of them from degrading due to harsh lighting. As a result, you aren't able to tell one from the other unless you open each one and then mark down the numbers for your reference.

I like the look of the red and gray finishes more than the others, but to dry your nails fully you have to purchase a LED nail lamp. I didn't have one especially made for nails but I had a table lamp that uses LED. It worked, but I'm sure if I used the LED Nail lamp the drying time would have been faster.

The colors are vibrant and I like the glossy finish. There hasn't been any serious chipping or loss of polish for a week now, but I've used other gel polishes that have lasted almost as long as the LED kind. And for those who like to change their polish often, preserving the same look for a week or two isn't a priority. So unlike you already have some sort of LED lamp, I would just stick to the normal gel polishes available out there.

I know I am because my husband tells me so  all the time, (never mind that he can't see more than 2 inches in front of him and doesn't remember my name!) but for all you young ones out there remember, "it's never too early to start taking care of your skin!".

This is the second dip powder kit I’ve tried. FYI I own a lot of extra buffing blocks and a nail drill that I bought separately.

Pros:
-comes in glass jars. These liquids are strong chemicals that get sticky, etc. so glass is durable. I’ve had plastic jars of this stuff that get stuck together and crack
-comes with extra brush heads and cuticle oil
-instructions are easy

Cons:
- doesn’t come with clear dip powder base coat even though instructions says to use it??
-the colors stain. My friend did red and it made her fingertips red
-the nude color is a bit too nude and looks like my skin tone
-the top coat bottle brush hardened almost immediately after using it for a few coats. I went thru THREE extra brush heads just to finish my top coat and ended throwing them all out because they all hardened within seconds.

Would I recommend?
Maybe if you know what you’re doing. Don’t think I’d recommend this color palette though. The other dip kit I used had its own difficulties too. I just think dip powder is harder than it seems.

title: solid balm to oil cleanswer melts away gunk of the day; soothing & hydrating
text:
Lovely gentle and effective balm to oil cleanser. I use it as my first step in dissolving the grime and skin care products I used during the day (mostly SPF, I dont wear makeup but rarely). I have dry skin, semi sensitive and this is soothing feeling as well as non irritating. The combo of Centella Asiatica (soothing, skin health) and Hyaluronic Acid (retaining moisture) are the clear winning ingredients in this awesome oil cleanser.

I dab this oil cleanser all over the face, then let the heat of my hands melt it into my skin. It quickly turns to a spreadable oil to massage in all over. I really like the solid balm to oils over the liquid oils as I find them easier to work with. They also seem to rinse away cleaner? I feel like I could use this Mizon oil balm as my only cleansing step, but I am rather used to doing a 2nd cleanse with a gentle cleanser to wash off any remaining dissolved gunk from the first wash. You'll have to try it out for yourself.

Currently using this gentle, clean, vegan cleanser by To Do List as my second cleanse after Mizon:
https://www.amazon.com/gp/product/B08NDJR7S4

I have a couple of double duty balm-to- oil cleansers that I like, and I would consider Mizon Cicaluronic as a repurchase.

title: Move Over Palisade!!! Save Money & Time!
text:
I continue to be sort of amazed at all the cool nail art supplies that keep coming out!! Born Pretty is my favorite Nail Art Brand. I have several Born Pretty items already, and my collection continues to grow! I am so very glad that I found this product!! The set includes 26 different pieces of Nail Shields, that come in 10 different sizes, to shield the skin around your nails and cuticles from nail polish. With all the different sizes included, it is very easy to find the right sizes to fit each of your fingers (my right hand is slightly larger than my left hand, & most people are the same, with one side being just a tiny bit bigger than the opposite side). There is nothing complicated about these at all, you simply slip on each Nail Shield like a ring at the top of your finger tips. Each Nail Shield fits each finger fully and comfortably. The right fit will cover the skin around the nails snugly but also comfortably. After you have found your proper sizes, you can apply your nail polish neatly and precisely, without getting nail polish stains on your skin to clean up after!

The directions say to wear the Nail Shields right-side-up, as shown in the pictures (with the curve facing up). This does a fabulous job at shielding the skin around the nail from polish. I find that it also works nicely if you turn them upside-down (with the curve facing down, going from cuticle from nail tip, like the letter U) and then they shield not only the skin around the nail, but the cuticle too!! I still have to make an effort to leave a little space between the cuticle and where the nail polish starts (should be slightly above the cuticle), so using the Nail Shields "upside-down/letter U" also makes a stencil which forces the little gap between cuticle and where polish begins, for a clean, precise, and professional look. (PLEASE SEE MY ATTACHED PHOTOS FOR REFERENCE!)

Perhaps most importantly, this latest neat and super handy innovation from Born Pretty is also Eco Friendly and Money Saving ++$$!! I have been buying bottles of Liquid Palisade to do the same job, whereas Born Pretty's Nail Shields can be re-used again and again. Palisade can get expensive... Palisade can also be a real pain to get off, depending on the quality (some are thin in texture and don't come off easily or in one piece). Using tape is even more cumbersome, messy, and inacurate. I'm SO glad I found these!! I was also really fortunate to be able to purchase this product at a discounted rate in exchange for my honest and unbiased review. It is a win/win situation, Born Pretty Is my favorite Nail Art Company because I love every item I have ever purchased from them! These Nail Guards will save me a bunch of money over time, and not just from having to purchase more palisade. They are practical, they work well, and I am really happy with my results! They save money, they save time, they are easy to clean up, and they last for countless uses! You really can't go wrong with these :D

title: Love Derma-nu
text:
Hyaluronic Acid? I never knew what it was until recently :) sounds like something you use in the brakes on your car. hyaluronic acid (also known as hyaluronan) is a glycosaminoglycan, a type of molecule composed partly of sugars. Hyaluronic acid is actually a natural structural component of skin, and, in fact, is present in connective tissue throughout the human body.

The awesome thing about Hydrolic Acid is its ability to retain moisture; it’s considered to have a greater capacity to hold moisture than any other natural or synthetic polymer. In fact, one gram of hyaluronic acid is able to hold up to six liters of water. The hallmarks of youthful skin is its moisture content. A dried up face will age you quicker then anything.

Hyaluronic acid can improve your skin’s moisture content and at the same time strengthen skin’s barrier; that is, the outer layers of your skin. A healthy barrier looks and feels softer, smoother, and plumper. This does all of that. Sense menopause I have suffered from dry skin. This has made a big difference in how my face looks and feels. Thank you Derma-nu for another 5 star product and Thank you for letting me try this at a reduced rate for my hoest review

title: Two 5 STAR and Two 4 STAR Fragrances- some are sure to please every man
text:
English Laundry Men's 4 Piece 20ml Coffret is a truly wonderful men’s cologne set. You are getting four fragrances- rated 4 and 5 STARS all in one box. The fragrances rated by me are based on my years spent working in a cosmetic factory. I will list each fragrance separately.

ARROGANT- With top notes of bergamot and cedar you get a woodsy freshness to the scent. The middle notes of coriander and lavender bring a warm, clean freshness. At the base are sandalwood, amber and musk bringing a warm, sensual, spicy scent. All together, you get a spicy, warm, woodsy scent with a distinctive freshness to it. This light, sensual scent lasts all day and smells wonderful on almost every man, so 5 STARS.

OXFORD BLEU- The top notes of mint and lemon add a citrus freshness. The middle notes of iris and geranium bring a very light floral scent. The base adds sandalwood and vanilla for a woodsy delicious scent. All together, this scent is light, with an undertone bit of floral and clean citrus and a nice light woodsy smell. This light, woodsy fragrance smells fabulous on almost every man and does last long for 5 STARS.

RIVIERA- With top notes of lemon, bergamot, lime and cedar, you get a refreshing citrus/woods scent. In the middle are jasmine, patchouli, vetiver, lavender and mandarin- most of these were used in the 60's sexy, warm, earthy scents. At the base notes are nutmeg and coumarin to add some spice. This is not for every man, but for a man who likes a more vibrant scent. These scents are very noticeable and not light, being a very woodsy, earthy, warm fragrance with a touch of zest. 4 STARS.

NOTTING HILL- The top notes begin with bergamot, lemon and lime for a clean, natural scent. Then the middle notes have bolder peppercorn and jasmine bringing a rose/herbal scent. At the bottom are cedarwood, sandalwood, amber and a powdery musk for a very potent woodsy, animal musky scent. This is definitely not for every man being very heavy scents. There is nothing light about this fragrance. 4 STARS.

With four interesting fragrances, two being light and two being heavy, every man is sure to find one he will like. Lighter scents always smell wonderful on almost every man and the bolder scents smell great on a man depending on how his chemistry goes with the bolder fragrances. 4 ½ STARS.

title: Okay !  Dislike the "plastic" taste!
text:
It's okay, but I'm not loving this water flosser and would not buy it again or recommend it.

Main reason -- Even after rinsing the "tank" several times before use, it makes the water have a "terrible" plastic taste. I did resolve this a bit by adding some of mouthwash to each tank of water before I use it, however I can not use it without adding the mouthwash because it makes the water taste terrible and did want to be able to use it with only plain water.

Secondly, it is rechargeable, but only via a USB connection, not a standard "home" electrical out as I had I expected (NOTE: It says it's 120/240V compatible) which is why I thought it would be charged via a standard electrical outlet versus a USB Port. USB is okay for those who own computers, (I do), but we certainly don't keep our computer in the bathroom. I have to charge it in my office, which is a bit inconvenient for a bathroom product.

On the upside, it does work pretty well, once you can get used the the water taste and it's nice that the are three settings. However, I feel the tank is too small and need to refill it for each use. One full tank is not enough to clean all my teeth, even on the "pulse" setting.

Overall, it's okay and does serve the purpose, but would be MUCH better if it did not make the water have the awful "plastic" taste and if the take was larger. If I could have returned it for a full refund I would have. But, since it's NOT defective and there is not a free trial period, I'm stuck with it. I'm going to use it for the time being and continue to look for a better product.

title: Better then most at this price point, depends on which one you get
text: So it's honestly not bad at this price point. It sheds a bit but all units have some shedding. For the mix brown I give 4 stars.The face front is about 2 inches and is meant to be cut and plucked for a natural look. I did neither in the photo. I just folded it under the the front as I'm afraid that cutting will make it look lifted in the front and obviously show it's a wig without some glue to put it down. The color is not exactly what I wanted. I was hoping it would be a darker brown. It's kinda a mousey brown and alittle strange in my opinion. It will need to be restyle in the front as some waves/curls flattened out by how it was packed in transport. The part is both a plastic fake skin and a mesh on top. You can see the mesh upon close examination. Makeup might help to conceal this.... Or make it worse. What I did like was the fullness and length. The weft was not too easy to be seen even when pulling hair apart. This is good compared to other brands where the wefts are often very visible, especially in the back and crown of a unit. Because the simulated scalp is narrow, you won't be able to change the part. It's also a bit flat near the part so it's gonna take some work to give a bit of volume. I would have enjoyed this much more had the color been a rich brown and if the scalp was a bit more realistic. Would I wear in public? Probably not. Would this be good for photo shoots or costumes ? yes. Would I buy other colors from this brand? Yes and I haven't done that with other brands on Amazon. For the purple ombre: I give 3 stars. It doesn't have the lace in front. This is more pure costume. The black is very shiney and the front of wig where the part is shows a bit of the black backing for construction. If it laid more flat and had the lace I would have given the purple ombre 4 stars. Dull the shiney with some powder like dry shampoo or maybe even dark eyeshadow. The fake scalp is actually better on the purple ombre compared to the brown mix. The ombre for the blonde is also a 4 star. Hair at the crown is a bit flat but the rest of the style is beautiful. The brown to blonde has the 2 inch lace like the long brown one. It's not as full on the head but you don't see the wefts unless you pull it apart a bit.  I feel the color is much more realistic. Hair feels pretty good for a synthetic. Note if you play too much , it will get a knotty feel. Again, good for photos. Some people might actually wear it daily but I don't know if it took take daily abuse. Length is great.

title: Suited More for 6+ and Older
text:
A few things here …

LES ENFANTS is French for CHILDREN

It doesn’t refer to infants or toddlers. For those who don’t know, a quick note …

Newborn – birth to 4 weeks
Infants – 4 weeks to 1 year
Toddler – 1-3
Preschooler – 3-5
Child – 6-13

That said …

It does state NOT TO SPRAY IT ON A BABY’S SKIN. “Applying gently on clothes” is the preferred method. Though to be honest, I’d say this is more for ages 6+

While baby cologne isn’t something I would use on a baby, it could be better for adults who want a light scent and not overwhelmed by a perfume.

For almost $30, this is an 8.5 fl oz spray. Compared to some perfumes and colognes, this is moderately priced.

Smell? It isn’t the greatest. I do like it as a light, after-bathing scent. It seems more suited to a room freshener than a perfume. But, it isn’t the WORST perfume/scent I’ve smelled.

The generous size means it will last a while.

Would I get it again? No. Nor would I recommend it either.

title: they're ok but make sure you get multiple packs
text:
These extensions are nice HOWEVER one package is not enough for a full head which is why I purchased 3. I have medium length hair, an inch or two past my shoulders. I bought these in 14inch (natural black) which is more of an espresso black. I should have purchased jet black. Normally, with high quality extensions like Bellami brand (for example, i do have these extensions as well which are close to 300$ at 200grams of hair, however they are VERY long which is why I found these because I needed a 14inch length) you can dye them darker if you NEED to. I would never trust dying these. They are soft, but don't feel durable and the strips are really thin. They do feel like real hair, and they are soft and shiny and look very very real, but using heat styling products on them and coloring them I would NOT do it. Also, I would recommend buying 4 packs if you have thick hair like I do. I'm going to keep them since I can use spare parts and lengths to go with my several other extension sets, but these just are hard to blend with your hair because they are just thin. I plan to use these to add length to my hair if I plan to put it up or something also.

Overall, they are good extension to have but I wouldn't rely on them to be your "go to full head" set. And DON'T order one package. Be sure to get 2 or more depending on the thickness of your hair. Make sure you also take extra care of them since the quality seems appropriate but they aren't top quality like some of my other sets. For the price you can't complain but I just have such a familiarity with extensions that I wasn't overly impressed with these.

They came quickly and were packaged nicely. The plastic case is reusable with a snap to store them. They were true to the picture and they come with the clips already sewn in. The wefts themselves could use more hair, maybe a second strip sewn to the clips.

title: Works Great with Dark Hair
text:
I’ve always had natural hair color because I’m super scared of frying my hair and losing my length and natural color. I wasn’t expecting much from this product - everyone knows when you have dark hair, color just doesn’t show in it.

So far, I’ve used the silver and the green. For the silver, I went all the way up in my hair, and for the green, I kept the top third of my hair undone. The color shows remarkably well in my hair! It can be brushed once the wax dries for a softer, less stringy look, but you do lose some of the color.

I definitely don’t recommend wearing white when you have this wax in your hair, the white collar on my jacket went bright green. Also, be prepared that this is going to flake off all throughout the day. If you have shorter hair, it might not be as noticeable, but when your hair goes past your hips, you will get flakes all over your clothes.

Overall, this is a great product to temporarily change your hair color without having to bleach your hair first. Does it do what the pictures show? No, but it’s definitely noticeable, easy to do, and a lot of fun!

title: Aloe Vera Gel
text:
This Aloe Vera Gel by Sdara Skincare takes a few minutes to fully absorb into my skin. I worried it would leave behind a sticky feeling, since I could feel it on my arm the whole time it took to dry. But once the gel finally absorbed, I couldn’t feel any residue left behind. I didn’t notice much of any scent either, which is another positive for me.

The gel is clear; the plastic bottle is amber colored to help keep light out. I wish the bottle had a flip top or squeeze lid instead of a screw off cap.

The list of ingredients is what gives me pause. I’m not sure why sodium bicarbonate (baking soda) would need to be added to the organic aloe leaf juice. The product description mentions “we perfected our serum by enriching with Vitamin E, & Citric Acid for improved nutrient absorption.” I don’t see Vitamin E listed in the ingredients.

I will probably end up using this aloe vera gel to make hand sanitizer. The gel is thick, so it should be good for that use.

title: High Quality Product That Delivers High Quality Results
text:
"Best shave I've ever had. Gives me a close shave with no tugging. Better than an electric razor".

That's the first thing my husband had to say after he tested SUPRENT's Matrix Cutter Head travel kit razor for the first time. And what a kit this is. A razor handle, 2-blade refills (each with the first of its kind 6 ultra-thin blades total!), a dock to hold the razor and a bottle of shaving foam are included.

The handle is sleek and heavy but easy and comfortable to hold. The head doesn't pivot but it doesn't need to thanks to the 38.5 degree shaving angle. It glides perfectly along the jaw line and chin areas without missing a spot.

The base is heavy-ish and holds the razor well. Doesn't tip or wobble.

He's not a fan of the shaving foam. Says he must 'really rub it in' in order for it to foam. He used it once and switched back to his regular brand.

Suprent has really come out with an awesome razor kit. The presentation is gorgeous and the product works exceptionally well. Without a doubt this is worthy of gift giving. The price is reasonable.

Highly recommended

title: What the HECK are those ingredients!?!?!?!
text:
I ordered this product seeing it was "100% natural" & "organic" in it's description, as well as paraben, GMO-, & toxin free. Even though it was not labeled certified organic in the USA, it did not have to be to contain organically derived ingredients to be organically constructed. However, when I received it, I patently refused to use this because there are so many chemical names in this I do not trust (polyether-26, propylene glycol, phenoyethanol!?!??!? How is THAT organic & 100% natural!?!?!?). NONE of the "natural" ingredients (such as rosemary extract, biotin, ginseng root, etc.) were even prefaced in the ingredients label as "organic"-- so.... therefore they are NOT. Typical of a product made overseas in Asia where definitions of "organic" do not meet USA standards. I would be very wary of using this product.
Two stars only because it arrived on time as promised & each individual bottle was packaged well in a cardboard box sealed in plastic.

Silicone scar sheets are available in numerous sizes, types, and shapes. Second, you don't need multiple packages as you reuse the sheets until they no longer stick after washing them.

This roll - at 1.5" x 60" - will last quite a while and depending on the length of the scar you're treating, may be enough for the period of time you will be treating it.

These perform very well. I use them to make my own essential oil (EO) bug sprays, after sun sprays, room refreshers, etc. They are small, spray well & don't leak.

The small size is great for portability. I take one of my bug spray formulas outside with me for while I work on my farm. Because I only use EO's the effectiveness wears off much faster than synthetic products. I keep the bottle on me to respray as needed. I have a bottle in my purse with a germ fighting blend for when stores are out of the cart wipes. I even made up a bottle of toilet spray. I use peppermint EO for that.

The funnel has a very narrow spout making pouring a slow processes but it keeps me from accidentally over filling the bottles. The tube that goes into the bottle is plenty long. It actually curls up in a C on the very bottom of the bottle. You can cut it if you want, but I leave it as is, I think they function better with the long tube. The stickers are a bit of a joke. title: Perfect for skin + hair on newborns- great ethnic option!!
text:
This was a great product made to be helpful For moisturizing but, also being sensitive enough for use on a newborns skin. The baby i had ordered this for, has a unique combo- half Icelandic and half African… Creating skin mixture that needs very delicate and natural products that still can provide plenty of moisture. This product delivered!!

After noticing a few dry spots on baby skin, I did some research on how to re-capture moisture necessary.. my concern was a bit of cradle cap and the use of Emelia’s baby bath oil on the scalp. Not only was it very sensitive and user-friendly, it took care of the issue within a few days.. The other concern was the possibility of getting product in babies eyes, if added to the overall bathwater.. of course, I used my best efforts to keep this from happening- but, I found dipping washcloth into the water and wiping off face… Absolutely caused zero problems- I was totally surprised and impressed!!

Knowing the African culture needs a bit of moisturizer in skin care as well as hair care… This has covered both needs in just this one product. I’m certain as this newborn grows we may need to adjust course and add more specific hair care regiment. As for now, this is doing just fine- and best of all leaves baby smelling amazing!!

So, if looking for a product that is gentle enough to use on a newborn… That has taken the precautions to keep their skin safe… Using only natural products- and has the ability to moisturize and even clear up cradle cap.. just a few drops of this to the bathwater- can handle the trouble spots no problem.. loving it!!

title: Good makeup removal but, not rinse free
text:
I was excited to try this product for makeup removal and, part of my morning cleansing step (skipping my face wash) to cut back on time.
C”est Moi products are verified non-toxic on the EWG SkinDeep database.
EWG/clean skincare products are important to me, as a breast cancer survivor.

I used this to remove my makeup and, morning facial cleansing before toner, moisturizer and makeup. The latter didn’t work well. See rest of review.
It does a good job at removing makeup (I’ll continue to use it for such) but, my face doesn’t feeling clean. It feels tacky. I decided to wait for 10 minutes to see if the tackiness would dissipate. It didn’t- I had to use my facial cleanser.

Pro’s
Good score on EWG (created report on SkinDeep)
Good at removing makeup (I used both a cotton ball and facecloth. Facecloth works better)
Works good as part of “pre-cleanse” routine
Didn’t irritate my sensitive skin- no breakouts, redness or reactions
Doesn’t leave skin feeling dry

Con’s
Leaves face feeling tacky
Not a rinse-free, one step cleanser product
Light scent...can’t place it. Not good nor bad. (glycerin smell?)

title: Tasty Coffee Drops in a Tin
text:
We love coffee in our house so when I was presented with the opportunity to try these coffee drop candies in a tin I couldn’t pass them up. You get 3 cute little tins full of the candies and each had a freshness seal around them. The tin was easy to open, there were no sugar pieces from the coating that fell out, and each tin had 21 pieces in them. I found the size of the coffee drops to be quite adequate, not too small and not too big. I saw where a couple people thought they were huge but they’re about the size of a jelly bean but not as fat. They have a smooth coffee flavor with some sugar added in to make them the perfect little sweet. I found them to be very tasty and enjoyable. One candy at a time is plenty for a treat. They arrived in a cute black box that makes them perfect for gift giving and the tins are the perfect size to put in your purse, pocket, desk drawer, end table or pretty much anywhere else that you want to tuck away some coffee sweetness. We thought these were so good that we’re going to try one of Cavendish & Harvey’s variety packs next.

title: 💕💃Retire that old blow dryer and brush💕
text:
WOW!! When I first recieved this I was really intimidated. Its HUGE! I was worried about even being able to use it. But I'm always up for a challenge.
First let me say I have fine but thick hair and shoulder length. Normally I use a blow dryer and a circular brush to give myself some volume.
This unit comes with 2 brushes, one for shorter hair,one for longer. The brushes have nice soft bristles that won't rip at your hair. So if you do get a tangle it slides right out. I used the shorter brush myself.
At first it was difficult for me to use because of a bad shoulder. The size was an issue for me. But with a little practice I got the hang of it. Realizing that it actually takes the place of 2 tools. The blow dryer and circular brush all in one ( still old school I guess 🙃) And in the long run I found it easier on my bad shoulder because I had to use only one tool instead of two! 💃
I also takes some real practice to use the rolling feature. If there was anything I would change, that would be it. There is one for this. And it's very easy to accidentally go the wrong way (😜 believe me not a good look)
Once I figured out to just roll it enough to get the hair on and let go of the button, hold it for a moment while the dryer works then pull it through. And WOW it gives you such volume that lasts all day. Leaves your soft and silky too. I'm so impressed!
I immediately made the room for this new tool in my bathroom.
I would highly recommend it. It's a little intimidating.. So worth the challenge tho!
I stepped out of my comfort zone and tried it... You should too! Sometimes new products are a real improvement on the old standbys.👍

text: I was very skeptical about this working when I first received it. I was sent it as a promotional item to review, but my reviews are honest. I typically use non-acetone nail polish removers (Julep) that remove my nail polish within seconds, and glitter within at least 20 seconds. This product removed my nail polish in 20 seconds, and I did not try it with glitter. It does work. It removes your nail polish in a natural and organic way. The only downside is that you're sacrificing time and convenience with this product because it takes longer to remove and you have to use the dropper, let it soak into your nails for a bit, then remove it with a cotton pad. It can also get messy with the liquid sitting on your nails, so you have to put a cloth under your hands when you put the remover on your nails. All in all, this product does work, so if organic, all natural products are a must for you, then definitely try this out! If you care more about convenience and something mess free, this might not be the product for you.

title: Great shave, great value - use with Letric Shave
text:
I tried electric razors ten years ago with a Braun model but my skin was too sensitive and I received nicks and cuts and a poor shave. Three years ago, I tried again with a Remington, and it worked great for my head -- not so great for my face. Lots of nicks, and spread a rash. I was especially disappointed that it didn't get my neck very well. Both shavers were straight foil shavers, as I thought they would shave closer than round heads.

Then, I purchased this Norelco over 2 months ago, and it has worked like a dream for me. While the first week wasn't especially close, it was convenient as I was traveling for work. By the third week, however, the shave was CLOSER than my regular Mach 3 blade shave!

One huge difference: I bought some Letric Shave pre-shave liquid, which makes the whiskers stand up, and also disinfects the shaving heads. I haven't had one cut, and no rash, in over 60 shaves with this unit. Since then, I have used the Norelco every morning, along with the Letric Shave, and have been thrilled with the results. I have also wondered whether my previous experience with an electric would have been better had I $3.49 to get the pre-shave splash!

I have to agree with one poster who complained about the plastic parts - the only reason I didn't give the product 5 stars. I don't really know how long this unit will run. I do know in 2 months, I have already saved more on this unit than disposable blades would have cost. And, travel is a snap.
