title: I really really like the DAELONG products
text:
I have been using the serum for a little over 3 weeks. I really really like the DAELONG products. Take a look at my other review of the hair treatment. It’s absolutely amazing. However, the quick grow serum didn’t work for me. Its consistency was too watery for my taste. You can definitely tell it has argan oil in it. There is something else in this product that causes it to be a little soapy if you apply more than 3 squirts.

I usually apply this product to freshly washed, but dry hair. Just to allow it to have its full effect. I also applied it nightly and something during the day if I remembered before work. I did not lose any more hair while using this product but I also didn’t gain any hair as well. I wish I would’ve taken some pictures to really be sure that I haven’t had hair growth but I watch for growth every day. I can guarantee I am pretty sure. I like products with a thicker consistency so what works for me may not work for you. I have very thick no porosity hair.

I received this product at a discount in exchange for my honest and unbiased review.

title: I have very thick, curly hair and these hold a lot of hair securely.
text:
I've been using these for a month now on a weekly basis (a few days each week) and I'm happy to report that none of them have broken! I've had some (from other brands) that have broken on me after just a week or two - these have not done that.

They're really great quality and can hold quite a bit of hair. My hair is really thick and tightly curled and I can easily part my hair into just 6 sections and hold each section tightly and securely with these; they're definitely strong and flexible. It's quite refreshing. Sometimes, depending on how I position them, these can be a little too tight actually. They never slip off or budge at all!

Also, these clips do not pull my hair or get tangled. The colors are very nice too. It's a nice change from the all black clips that I have. They can be a little hard to handle when your hands are wet or have products on them - they get a little slippery. Other than that, I have no complaints.

I received this product complimentary in exchange for my honest, unbiased review. All opinions are 100% mine.

title: Sucks the skin, but doesn’t really suck out pores!
text:
This is a great concept and I wanted this to work for me. I wanted to have a “Dr. Pimplepopper” moment where I saw my blackheads getting sucked out of their little crevices. It just didn’t happen.

I did pause and ask myself if maybe the issue is I don’t have any blackheads to suck out...but then I chuckled to myself because I definitely do. They aren’t robust blackheads. They are tiny but my nose definitely has them.

This thing does have some suction power so you can’t leave it in the same spot for too long or you can get a mini-Hickie. So the idea is once it sucks onto your skin you need to move it along somewhere else to avoid hickies. It does feel weird and my hope was I would look at it afterward and the little suction cup would be filled with all sorts of icky goodness but no such luck. When I use Biore strips I can definitely pull blackheads out and visibly see them.

At this point I was dismayed so I somehow convinced my husband who has no skincare regiment whatsoever...to let me try it on his nose and forehead. He’s such a brave soul and I think deep down he may have been a bit curious himself. And again....no blackhead remover. Not possible. I love him but he does have blackheads. Now I knew the thing wasn’t working. I mean it sucks with gusto but somehow just doesn’t seem to suck out of pores all that well.

Sad days. This was not the show I had hoped for.

title: Great polish and great deal! Even you get repeats!
text:
UPDATE 5/3/21: Got my second shipment today. All in tact! And great color selection!

This is a really great deal. If it is packaged right. The first time, unfortunately the bottles arrived smashed due to poor packaging. This is not the vendors fault as it was shipped by Amazon. I told them about it and they gave me a full refund. I really wish they would take a little more care when shipping. Hopefully my next round will go better.
**UPDATE** 5/3/21: Got my second shipment today. All in tact! And great color selection!
This is my guilty pleasure. It is definitely like gambling. But once every month or so I take the chance and roll the dice. Some times I get colors I do not have and other times I get 4 of the same. But guess what!?! You can mix these colors and get something that you like. That is what I do. I have mixed some shimmery colors with solids and came out with a beautiful shade that didn't exist before! And for around $1 each it is such a great deal!!! Dollar store price but top salon quality. This polish has been discontinued which is really sad because it is my favorite by far. It goes on smooth, love the wide brush and consistency. It helps my nails grow and keeps them healthy and protected. Also it lasts forever. I mean the polish in the bottle will last forever. Like no expiration date. I have some that I have had for over 10 years and they still glide like they were new.

** This is copy of my review from same product but bought different times and vendors***

This a great price for 20 polishes. Buying them in the store would be like $6 or $7. I have to admit this is my favorite guilty pleasure. It is like gambling lol. For around $1 a polish this is such a fun way to try new colors!

I absolutely love this polish. I have used it for years. The nice thing about these polishes is that even after years they still perform as well as the new ones. I love how easy it is to apply. If I am in a hurry, one coat is fine. I like to take my time with my nails so I have steps (below). I like to change my polish every week so chipping isn’t a problem for me. Also I wear gloves when I do dishes or clean to extend the life of my nails.
I love that this polish dries fairly quickly if you don’t put it on too thick. I mean, put on a coat while watching TV or on the PC. Careful not to touch anything! But let it dry thoroughly.
Then if you need a little more tint slap a little thin layer to make it pop. Also here are couple tips I learned through my years of doing my nails:

1. Use the SH Complete Care 7in1 or 170 Clear'd for takeoff as a base coat. (I am pretty sure that is why it’s called that... It makes sense to me) I know they say you don’t need one with this polish, but really it is for easier removal. It makes your life so much easier! Especially with darker colors that seem to get in the creases and under your nail that are a pain to remove.

2. Use a white polish (121 let’s snow for example) under any color to make that color really pop. You don’t need a really thick coat of white either. Just enough to give a canvas for the bright color to pop.

3. This polish is a little thick so mind that when you apply it. Put one streak down the middle of your nail (your first application to each nail) this will be a little thicker then go to each side and touching the outskirts of the middle line to grab some of the excess there to spread to the sides.

4. I use Sally Hansen Salon Manicure Top Coat as well to seal the color in if I am not using a Salon Manicure Glitter Overcoat. I think they both help preserve the color.

4b. I know glitter can be intimidating because it’s such a pain to get off. Don’t let that deter you. If you like the look of glitter go for it! There are polish removers designed for that now. As well as the polish remover in the jar that you put your finger in to remove color. There is one that has little ridges (or brushes) inside the center wall that help strip the glitter. Can’t tell you where or who. But I can say you probably have one in your town.

5. For those of you that like a little shiny nail but not necessarily color. I use the 170 Clear’d for takeoff and add some drops of any sheer color (Arm Candy, Sheer Ecstasy, Sweet Talker, Shell We Dance, Pink Slip) it just looks like a natural nail with clear polish only it hides blemishes! And your nails look super awesome! I get compliments all the time about how healthy my nails look when I do that.

I hope these tips help. These are things I have learned over the years. I love doing nails and I am glad to share the things I have discovered to save someone else some frustration or time.

title: Feels Lightweight For My Dry Skin, Better For Evening As Strong Lavender Scent & Retinyl Palmitate
text:
This Kneipp lavender lotion is thick, but it’s not a heavy or greasy lotion. This probably provides moderate hydration for normal skin, but for me it feels quite lightweight. I think it’s a nice cream, but I prefer a richer lotion or cream that comforts my dry skin more and provides longer lasting hydration. When I’ve applied this after an evening shower, my skin feels reasonably moisturized for a few hours but it’s not enough moisture to last all night so I need to reapply before bed. This seems best for those who don’t need heavy hydration and enjoy a lavender scent.

This lotion does have a moderately strong lavender scent that even lingers on my hands after washing. It smells nice and doesn’t bother me, but it may bother those sensitive to fragrance as this is just in the range of what I can tolerate as strong lavender has been a headache trigger for me. This lotion has retinyl palmitate, which is especially risky mixed with sun exposure. This lotion seems best for evening use given that lavender can be relaxing and retinyl palmitate doesn’t mix well with sun. Like it. 4 stars.

title: A sticky mess with an ashen yellowish color that smells funky but at least you are protected
text:
I really wanted to like this face moisturizer since I prefer using a tinted moisturizer over a foundation every day and this one on top of it also has an SPF 31 to protect your face from the sun. So to me that would be a win win situation.

It comes in a nice little pump dispenser that works very well. Unfortunately that is where the positive really stops in my eyes. The moisturizer is not too thick and almost runny but it isn't. It is very tinted so it kept up on that promise. I did NOT like the smell of it at all and that scent actually does linger while you apply it and some time after so that was definitely a bit no no in my eyes.

The applying of the moisturizer was not very pleasant since it was very sticky in my eyes. Distributing it evenly on my face took some actual work and I just didn't like that. IT was not like most moisturizers that just get nicely soaked up by your skin but because of its sticky consistency, which actually reminded me of a foundation, it took a bit. My skin also didn't feel great afterwards and I almost felt like I needed to set it with a setting powder like you would with a foundation. The color of it was also a bit off, some ashen yellowish brown that I found was not very flattering but thankfully it did not add a lot of color to my skin but actually blended into my skin after a little bit and you hardly noticed you added a tinted moisturizer.

At least while I was out and about my face was protected from the sun and I did not get sun burnt, so that was the other upside of this moisturizer. But all in all I did not care for the scent of it, the stickiness during application and that it left behind and how it really made my skin look. To me this is more a fail than anything else really.

title: Don’t love it but don’t hate it
text:
This foundation is a tricky one. There are things I really like about it and things that I don’t.
I bought it in the shade 04 Honey. In the bottle it looks like an almost exact match to my skin, but when I put it on it’s much paler with a decidedly pink undertone, yet it doesn’t look orange or too pink in my skin. I prefer a neutral undertone though since my skin can be both yellow and pink.

I love the bottle and packaging. It comes in a frosted glass bottle with a pink pump and pink cap that snaps on tightly.

The coverage is much higher than I expected and it is heavier than expected for a luminous foundation.

It covers blue tones better than redness. I have typically had to build it up in areas I have more redness (and we’re talking average redness, not anything extreme) and doing this makes it look much heavier so I end up using a concealer instead. The problem with this lies in the finish.

So this foundation’s finish is very confusing and hard to describe. It is very glowy and luminous without being shimmery but it has the heaviness of a matte. I know, confusing.
Areas can look too greasy or too dry. It settles into fine lines and creases around the eyes and nostrils. For this reason this is not a foundation I choose for the daytime. It’s much too heavy and shiny for the day, which is a shame because I enjoy it’s longevity. Once I set it with some powder around the eyes and my nostrils I really enjoy it for a night out.

I should also mention it is heavily perfumed with a floral scent so those sensitive to scented foundations will likely want to give this a pass. It’s not bothersome to me personally but fragrance can irritate really sensitive skin.

All in all I don’t use it as much as I hoped I would and probably won’t repurchase based on that and how heavy it is. At 36 I want a foundation with decent coverage but a lighter feel. It’s also not the easiest foundation to completely remove and when I wear it I have to use a cleaning oil and a cleanser both AND a miceller solution.

I have combo skin that can be prone to breakouts with certain brands but I haven’t broken out from this foundation.

I enjoy Holika Holika’s BB cream which is why I gave this a shot (and I like a luminous foundation) but I’ll probably stick with the BB cream in the future since it’s lighter.

text: This is my first foray into the use of beard oil. Over recent months, as I grew my goatee longer, I started noticing some flakiness on my chin (always clean and well groomed), and that my beard hairs were becoming drier and stiff. It seems time is against me, as the gray hairs in my beard are noticeably stiffer and scratchier. After reading reviews of several products, I chose the Fragrance Free Beardsmen Beard Oil. I didn't want any scent that would compete with anything else I chose to wear. I specifically chose Beardsmen after comparing ingredients with other brands. Formulations were similar, all using several types of natural oils to create a moisturizing product. Two things convinced me to try Beardsmen. First, the quantity. For less money than some other products, Beardsmen offers a much larger quantity of oil than pretty much anyone, so they definitely win the "bang for the buck" award. Second, Beardsmen is the only one that has a flow controlling dispenser, so you don't have to mess with ridiculous eye droppers and such. Oh... and the product itself? I LOVE it. No more flaky chin skin, and my beard is soft and smooth. This is obviously a plus as far as my wife is concerned. There is only the very slightest hint of a light "oil" smell when you first put it on, which is not strong enough be more than barely noticeable for a second or two, and definitely would never be noticed by others. After using this for about a month, and giving a small quantity to a friend to try, I still have most of the bottle full. This stuff will last forever, and when you finally do run out, you'll likely panic and jump on Amazon to get another bottle. I know I will

I took a guess and let it sit for one hour. I applied a line of the gel over the threshold of the shower where the door seal sits. This area often accumulates mold. The smell is not as strong as other cleaning solutions I have used, but there is a light chemical smell. It comes with a pair of disposable gloves but I did not use them. Since it is a gel it is fairly easy to handle without making a mess. After one hour I wiped it clean with a damp cloth. On the tile it works about the same as soap and water. It still required some scrubbing in certain areas. On the door seal it performed much better. The areas where the gel was applied cleared up not only the mold, but also the soap scum which would not wipe away with just the wet cloth alone. Overall it seems to work fairly well, but it is hard to say how well with no instructions provided. It may take some trial and error to maximize the performance of the gel.

title: Great on sensitive gums, doesn’t clean very well or last long.
text:
Bought these because I was looking for something to massage my itchy gums. Though my dentist has not said anything about gingivitis, I am pretty sure I’m borderline there. I have very sensitive gums and have been struggling for years to find toothbrushes that do not stab at them and make them bleed. One time, I tried the floss-tip toothbrush’s & they were SO sharp, they stabbed tiny holes in my gums & they got infected. Since then, I’ve tried Extra Soft Toothbrush from Di Qiu Ren (which was so dense, it did not dry, and got moldy very fast), back to my regular soft bristle toothbrush, which still irritates my gums and makes them bleed, and these silicone bristle brushes.

These silicone bristle brushes are very gentle on sensitive gums and have not cause ANY bleeding. Though, it does take longer to get plaque off the teeth, it’s great for my sensitive gums. The downfall, is if you brush your teeth too soon after eating oily foods, the residue sticks to the brush and it very difficult to get off. Most of the time, I just throw it away and use a new one. So far, one brush lasts about a month before it gets residue on it or starts smelling weird.

I don’t know if these are good for oral hygiene, but so far, my gums appear better and have built up a tolerance to contact & appear less sensitive to flossing and brushing. I will likely purchase these again to help with my gums, but will continue looking for cleaning alternatives for teeth.

title: Applies nicely... but
text:
I have been searching for a really good mascara for a little while now. I have always been a fan of Maybelline's Colossal mascara, but they decided to change up the formula a while back and it's just not the same, especially the waterproof one.

Decided to give this one a shot and here is what I have found so far:

1. It's definitely not waterproof, so if you have any kind of allergies and watery eyes, beware, it will smudge all over the place.
2. It applies nicely. Gives even coverage on the lashes without weighing them down with too much product. I would say it is mostly true to the name of length and lift as it does do both, just don't be expecting to look like you have false lashes on.
3. The wand brush is a little more streamlined compared to that of the Colossal, which I think helps with the lifting and lengthening. Depending on how you like your lashes to look, a coat or two with this and you're good to go.
4. Durability - here is where I had somewhat of an issue. I apply my makeup in the morning before work (even with working from home I never know when I will have an impromptu video call, so I'm always prepared). This usually occurs shortly before 7am and I need my makeup to last me ALL DAY because I usually don't get around to washing it off until 10-11pm. What I have found with the Almay is that even though it goes on nice and evenly, half way through my day I start to find my lashes feeling weighed down and notice they start clumping together. I thought it was odd, so decided to try again the next day to see what happened and sure enough, same thing. I don't know if it's just due to the formula or what but that has been my experience.
5. Washes off very easily. I use coconut oil to remove my makeup and then use my cleanser to completely wash my face and I haven't had any issues with removal.

Since I do actually like the product aside from it's durability, I've decided to play around with it and see if I can get it to wear a little better. What I've been experimenting with is applying this first to add length and then apply my waterproof mascara to sort of set them both (and so it gives me the waterproof protection I need) and it seems to be holding up when used this way. Can't say what the real issue is with why this doesn't wear well all day.. is it me or is it the product itself..who knows? I don't hate it at all, just wish it would wear better.

Hope this helps!

text:
I got this to help with my ear and nostril piercings. My ear piercings had tightened up after many years of not wearing jewelry. I could barely fit standard earrings in but the left side would hurt after a short time and I would have to remove it. My piercer stretched them just to a 16g. My nostril gets a little sore and irritated when removing and inserting jewelry for cleaning.
Even though I shower and scrub my ears and jewelry daily I sometimes get that funky yeasty cheesy smell. I found out that can happen when they have been stretched, even if just a small amount.
I also wanted something to make inserting earrings and nostril rings easier.
So enter Smelly Gelly. Something I tried to put on my skin and jewelry.
Pros
Cute little tin.
I would imagine even with this small amount that it would last a lot time.
After cleaning and applying in the morning I didn’t notice a cheesy smell at bedtime like I sometimes do. Although by morning it was back and yes I used fresh pillowcases.
Low product price

Cons
Shipping is an extra cost. Not prime and not free.
It’s a hard wax. Even warming it with my hands it stays just a hard, tacky wax.
It didn’t lubricate my jewelry to make it any easier to insert.
It smells like oil that has gone rancid.
I had to stir it up to get any scent besides old oil to appear.
The only faint scent that came out when stirred was maybe of eucalyptus.
When used in my nostril jewelry I was stuck with the rancid oil smell all day.
It did not help with nostril irritation from changing out jewelry.

I’m really bummed as I went back and forth deciding between this and similar products. I went with this because I wanted the essential oils that the other products were lacking.

title: Beware “Psychedelic” pattern: closer to pastel 😟
text:
I buy a lot from Amazon but write few reviews. I have to be either delighted or very disappointed to be motivated. In this case, sadly, it’s the latter. Please note that it applies specifically to one print: “Psychedelic”

For the price you can get a dozen or two in solid colors from other vendors, as I have done. But I was quite attracted to the supposedly “bright psychedelic print”. When it arrived just now I was terribly disappointed. They’re basically pastel, and I don’t do pastels. I might keep them as a gift simply because returns are such a hassle.

As far as the idea of these types of hair ties, so far so good. They do seem to hurt less and as I’m prone to migraines that’s a big plus. But they also stretch out after a few uses, but can be rehabilitated. Having bought a big lot inexpensively, I’ll just work my way through them then throw them in a pot of hot water to shrink up again. (The big batch I bought had instructions for shrinking: hit with a hair dryer or hot water. For a batch, the latter seems easier. As long as I only need to do that every few weeks, that’s fine.)

Good luck!!

Ohhhh: One more note: If you’re wondering why these are so much more expensive than other ties made from “telephone cord,” it seems to be advertising and presentation. That I learned about them through Teleties advertising might make me keep them. But I really didn’t need them to arrive in a solid gold-foil bubble padded envelope (which I didn’t even know existed!) Just in case you wonder where your money is going....

text:
I had hoped to use these small bottles for hand sanitizer to keep in my pocket for use at the gym, supermarket etc. The size is fine, the problem is that the small "flip top" either unscrews or pops open in my pocket almost daily. I have tried horsing these tops down with a small plier and they still come loose. When I can get the top to stay in the place, the little "pop top" pops open and sanitizes my junk.

If you keep these bottle on a desk top or in a drawer, they should be fine. I do use them for pure maple syrup so I don't over indulge in extra calories with my high protein pancakes (weightlifter) and sitting in the fridge filled with maple syrup undisturbed, they work well.

If you plan to travel with these in a carry on bag, put them in a plastic bag. Or get the version with a solid, fixed screw on cap or the small spout top that you pop open with your finger. Hard to give them more than 2 stars based on my experience with them. Hope that helps!

title: It Curls But Material is slippery, too much movement
text:
This heatless curler is ok, it’s as described and curls hair without having to utilize a curling iron. I find that it works best when using a light mist of water from a spray bottle and a texturizing spray.

It’s somewhat easy to use, but because it’s made of a silky material, it tends to slide around on my head and not stay in place.
The outside silky liner loosens, twists and loses its original shape after using it. I have a soft cotton one by another brand that works better, so in comparison, this one isn’t as good. It also doesn’t come with a headband to help keep hair wrapped and secure. It’s a bulkier wrap and leaves the top strands of hair looser which can cause the curls to not be as defined as they could be.

I started by putting the wrap at the top of my head, claw clipped it in place and moved strands of hair from the back of my head, underneath to the front and combined it with strands from the front, then continued to wrap the strands of hair around the wrap. I repeated this on each side until I was done. I used the hair ties at the ends to secure my hair in place. Getting strands of hair from the back to the front in sections can be a little complicated. With practice, it gets easier.

I let it sit in my hair overnight, it worked as described but left wavy/ loose curls rather than tight curls. It’s a good alternative for heat free curls.

text:
For Beloved Girl Extreme Moisture Mineral Cloud-Silk Facial Treatment Mask for Sensitive Skin, (25g x 1PC)-

I actually liked this mask quite a bit. It’s not quite up to par with the other mask I’ve tried by this brand (the other was a completely different style of face mask though). This is a good sheet mask. It is rather thin however it didn’t rip at all when I applied it. It is a little tricky to put on though. It comes with a plastic frame to help guide it when applying. I still did have that issue where the mask rolled up a little in the corner when I peeled off the plastic frame. I had to try to unravel the sections that did this after it was on my face which eventually I was able to do.

Pros-
Refreshing and hydrating.

Does moisturizes very well. They put enough of the product in that I was able to apply the extra over areas the mask didn’t cover.

My skin felt very soft after using this.

Cons-
Difficult to apply evenly. It’s not too much worse than the average sheet mask though.

I don’t like the full ingredients list isn’t available or at least not easy to find. I see they highlight the “key ingredients” but not the full list.

Overall I do like this mask because the results were very good for me. My face felt cleansed and hydrated. I do think it’s a little on the pricey side for the type of mask it is but it’s not by much so I would reorder this. The ingredients not being fully transparent is something I wish they would change. The results were good for me though.

The motor sounds like it's less powerful than my older model (which listed for a similar full retail price when new); even with a full charge it doesn't sound like the blades and spinning around very fast. That being said, the thing isn't particularly quiet either.

Gives an adequate if mediocre shave. Requires lots of passes over the same area of skin in order to get everything. All in all not a terrible buy, but not a great find either.

title: A Stylist's View: Has defects and is unusable. Bad customer service.
text:
The straight razor (shavette) I received is far from being professional quality nor could it be an heirloom that can be passed down in the family. It is made from cheap materials and has several defects.
The clasp is so thinly made, that it is easily bent just from disengaging it from the spine. There is a gouge on one spine that goes in on one side and out on the other. And, the razor blade does not stay seated properly once clasped. The wooden scales are not neatly finished. The blades that come with it are not the snap kind. They are full double sided blades, making them more dangerous to have to cut them without getting cut. They are also very thin and cheap. There's no way I can shave a neck, sideburns, facial hair, etc., with this defective razor.
I could have overlooked cosmetic issues regarding a razor of this price point. It is the physical defects that hindered its use that are major problems for me.
I contacted the seller, but was told that I could keep the defective product, and "we recommend another straight for you, better than that one in your hand", and I was given the asin number, so I could purchase it. This was not only poor Customer Service, but a lack of confidence in this, their own product. If they don't recommend this razor, I certainly don't either. It really could have gone much better.

title: scent is too much for me on this one, but there other ones are awesome; great nourishing scrub
text:
This is my second scrub with this company. The first was great, but I find that the fragrance is too much for me with this Honey one. These products do contain "parfum" as an added ingredient, but it is last on the list. I have included a picture of the ingredients as I do not see the list anywhere else. My other salt scrub by this company-bloodorange, and that scent is wonderful and fresh, in bottle, in shower, and on skin after (very light). This one is just heavy, rather perfume like. I have noticed some shea containing products have that, but the other one that I do like has shea as well but isn't cloying. So I don't know. I'm afraid it might trigger a headache for me. I may have to have someone else in the household finish it off. Love the other one I mentioned, though!

As for how it works- no problem. A thick frosting like creamy texture with a hint of grit. It does a nice job cleaning, polishing, and leaving the skin feel smooth and moisturized. It is a gentle scrub- very gentle. Definitely softens skin. I scoop out a generous 1/8-1/4 cup amount to use on my body. With that amount, I expect several uses from this squat container. I particularly like this one for my legs and feet as they are the most neglected in terms of skin care.

I really do like Natural Soultion salt scrubs, and it appears that there are 4 kinds. This one based solely on the fragrance is a miss for me, but another one happened to be a hit for me, which I will continue to use as needed.

EDIT: While a whiff from the container is too strong for me, the actual aroma in the shower continues to be pretty tame. It dawned on me to smell my skin after showering (something I didn't do with prior showers prior to initial review), and my skin doesn't have that strong smell that I note from the container. It smells pleasant and light, and I wanted to come back to say so.SO I just wanted to say that I haven't had a headache, and I don't actually smell like the scent from the container- I was concerned I would have that perfume smell. It isn't there, thankfully.

I'd boost it to a 5 rating, but the product descriptions says, "No Artificial Fragrances Or Perfumes", and "parfum" is on ingredient list- and doesn't say where that is derived from.

title: No growth, but an ok hair treatment
text:
I have actually tried the daelong shampoo and conditioner (with poor results in the growth category). When I saw that there was also a treatment cream I decided to give it a go. My thoughts on this hair growth treatment cream are a mixed bag. I like the scent of it a lot. I like that it isn't too heavy on my hair, glides easily and softens my hair after I've used the shampoo. I don't feel like it's causing any grease or oil on my hair. The container is also HUGE. This is easily the size of 3 regular containers of intense conditioner. The only problem I have (the bottle is pretty too) is that I can't really tell that my hair is growing faster than it was with other hair products. I see no difference in my hair length. I just don't. My hair feels a little more healthy but nothing substantial. I would pay around $14 for this hair growth treatment because I do like the smell and it doesn't make my hair unhealthy. I just don't see the results I expected. I give it 3 stars for being a good conditioner but had to knock off two stars because I'm not seeing growth.

The jar is an amusing shower read. Enjoy it!

I purchased this daelong hair growth treatment cream at a deep discount so I could offer my review of it. title: Not too happy with it
text:
I have heard so many mixed reviews on mud masks and decided to give it a try. I am not into the beauty scene, but I have been looking for something to help me with my facial skin problems. I suffer from dry skin after showering, and then overnight it gets so oily I look as if I put oil all over my face. Of course I shower, and the process repeats itself.

When I first got this product, I was unsure exactly how much to use of it. So I just used a little, barely touching anything. Then the next application I used more, probably more than needed, but again, I have never done this before.

The texture was weird, and when i shook it around in the container it was like rubber. It even felt rubbery. Not sure if this was just my container, or if all of them are like this way. The smell wasn’t too bad, smelled kind of like.. well dirt, which I would expect to be honest. The directions were easy to follow, and it didn’t leave an oily residue on my skin, but it did feel a little dry.

I used this product for a little over a week, I always like to give things proper time for trial. I don’t judge on one day. but after a week it should have worked right?

Wrong, my dry skin was so severe that I not only had dry skin on my forehead, but on my nose and chin too. I am pretty disappointed, but then again, every person and body is different. While it worked for other reviewers, it didn’t work for me. I will give them a 3 star because their customer service and prompt shipping is amazing, and their other products that I have tried are great too! But as far as the product itself, not satisfied.

My daughter was looking for inexpensive brushes to replace her old ones. They arrived in a multi chrome (purple to blue shift) fake leather, which has 10 slots in a few sizes. It has two metal clasps that keep it closed, and she hasn't had any problems with it locking or opening randomly. The brushes themselves are decent quality, but GREAT for the price. The ‘gems’ are little plastic diamond shaped pieces in two colors (depending on the color you chose), and they are small enough so they aren’t uncomfortable when you are holding them and they provide a better grip for accurate use. The one problem she has with the diamonds is that they are held onto the brush with what my daughter could only describe as a piece of double sided tape. There hasn’t been an issue with the diamonds falling out, but I surprised if they eventually did. The rose gold metal on either end is a nice touch and it doesn’t clash. The brush ends are quite dense (depending on what brush you’re using) so it picks up product well and doesn’t suck up too much foundation and concealer. (And the extra brush with the spoolie and think brush for lining is a nice touch.)

Overall, I’d say it’s a great product for the price.

title: Follain  Does What It Promises To Do
text: You know the saying 'kill two birds with one stone'? That is precisely what I had in mind when I ordered Follain Mattifying Moisturizer.  I have dry, sensitive skin but its not oily. My husband has oily skin. I have fine lines and wrinkles on my face. My husband does not.  Because Follain moisturizer promises to combat oily skin, as well as fine lines and wrinkles and is a clean, vegan product, I ordered it to find out if it could help the both of us with our skin issues.  I'm happy to tell you that it has helped the both of us.  The moisturizer is a bit thinner than I'm used to. I don't say that in a bad way because its not at all bad.  One pump of the canister delivers enough moisturizer to cover my facial skin. Its very lightweight and absorbs quickly without leaving a look or feel of oily/greasy skin. It provides immediate hydration and does a nice job of softening my skin. I am VERY happy to say I absolutely have a noticeable reduction in the fine lines and wrinkles on my face. They don't go away entirely, but there is a definite reduction in size and appearance. ( I can't tell you how much I needed to experience this right now as my 49th bday is this week...that means 5-0 isn't far behind and I'm kind of starting to freak about it! )  My husband also tried this for his oily skin with impressive results.  Follain controls his oily skin and prevents the shiny, damp look that comes with oily skin thanks to the mattifying benefit of this moisturizer.  We both use it as needed and not even on a daily basis.  Follain works and it works well. We're both very pleased and grateful for the results!

title: Does not fit recessed aerator faucets.
text:
This Seller needs to tell prospective Buyers that this product DOES NOT FIT the newer designer faucets that have recessed aerators, which are the most popular faucets now days. These are not like simple the aerators on other faucets. It's recessed and screws up inside the faucet tip. Standard aerators are just screwed on to the end of the faucet tip and can easily be removed by unscrewing them with a pair of pliers. My Delta faucet needs a special key/wrench to remove the aerator that you can purchase on Amazon, but it's likely this product won't fit anyway, based on the other reviews I read.

I really wanted this product to work, because I have a Shower Breeze (purchased on Amazon) attached to my shower head, and I love it. This product looked identical but made for sink faucets. The Seller needs to make an adaptor that fits recessed aerator faucets since none are available. I returned this item.

They are not a miraculous cure-all, but they do help flatten out the acne and draw out the stuff that needs to be drawn out (don't want to get too gross and graphic here). They are small (1 cm diameter) so the coverage is limited, but they adhere well.

There are a couple of cons with these that lower my score:

> They are harder to peel off the backing than others, and it's easy to fold over the edge of the patch when removing it, making it less effective. Other brands I've used have slits in the backing material, making it much easier to dispense a patch without damaging it.

> The packaging is very wasteful. Each sheet of 20 comes in its own box. You could easily fit several sheets into one box. Either the box should be made much smaller or each box should hold multiple sheets. There's no need for all this packaging waste.

Three stars (average). While these work as well as other patches, there are other options that are better choices.

title: Palm oil - pore clogging - failed applicator
text:
Not so good: Tube design failed, pore clogging, not 2-in-1
Good: color
Unknown: lasting?

I was glad I read a few reviews before I opened it, then I opened it carefully, pushed gently, and it burst out the sides all the same. I wasn't sure if it was because the on/off was marked on the lid but not the tube, maybe I just turned it the wrong amount? ½ turn seemed reasonable, so I turned it tighter and more came out the sides. For what it's worth, the instructions just have us dabbing a couple dots on with the sponge and blending with the fingers or brush. The sponge is an entirely unnecessary addition.

As you can see from the photo, this did allow me to put a nice and thick layer on my arm just in case anyone is looking to see how dramatic it can be. I do like the color, it's a good match, but I wouldn't use it on my eyes or my lips because the product says 'liquid blush.' There is a graphic on this page that says 2-in-1, despite showing eyes/blush/lips on the very same graphic, which I am pretty sure would be 3-in-1.

The last issue is the ingredients. The top ingredient is Ethylhexyl Palmitate, which is a pretty well known comedogenic (pore clogging) problem, so it's not great if you have breakouts. That's why I don't know how long it lasts or well it holds up over time, it's not worth the high risk of breakouts so I didn't wear it long. You might have guessed that 'palmitate' is also a derivative of Palm Oil, which is an industry that is destroying many biodiverse forests.

Two stars for color, texture feels nice, but I would only recommend this to people with clear skin that don't really have any desire to use the applicator sponge.

My tin is dented. It just arrived in a warehouse mailing bag. There was no protective tape, tamper sticker, or cover, or product box... so I am not sure what this product has been through before arriving to me. Ew. I know products are sold by weight not volume, but the container really does look like it is missing a portion, as it is half empty. It is probably all there. The container looks to be a 2 ounce capacity, with 1.7 ounces of product. The product is dense, so after settling, I imagine this is accurate. But still.. between the dented can and the lack of protective seal, I am reticent to use in on my face, and definitely won't be buying it as a gift (which I was considering as I ordered this for me, and figured if i liked it then I would buy it as part of a pampering gift).

Too bad because the container otherwise is attractive, the product smells good, and the ingredients are interesting; highly nourishing & repairing for the skin. I love self care products, and doing an occasional mask is relaxing.

1.7 ounces has 3.4 tablespoons. Probably use half a table spoon to cover face. So maybe 7-8 full face applications? I guess price it out like a sheet mask. $3.75 per treatment if assuming 8 applications. More or less depending on how much you use.

I hope the company considers adding a seal or tamper sticker.

text:
This product was okay for minor maintenance of hair loss, but at about the three month mark my hair thinned in gobs across my scalp. Given that yes, I have scalp problems that are not genetic, but other products have worked better. Redken is a brand that works. I have a few issues with this product that are not limited to the failure for it to help my hair problem.
Cons:
This does not increase volume and thickness, it coats the hair in a waxy substance that makes the hair feel disgusting. If that's volume, it's not worth feeling that way consistently.

This product has soy and wheat ingredients in it, both of which have no actual use due to the high content of phytates and lectins binding all nutrient content away. Any claim to nourishing hair is automatically refuted because of the science behind these seeds.

The price for an ineffective product is too high.

The ingredient list is a bit long, but not filled with artificial chemicals.

Pros:

title: Not Copal
text:
This is not Copal. I've traveled to the Yucatan and purchased both rock resin form of copal and a more convenient version in stick form. The hard resin form must have a secondary ignition source constantly present, like charcoal, in order to burn. The hand crafted stick version burns upon ignition just like any other stick incense.

This particular product is a stick incense labeled as Copal, but it is not. Perhaps it is a mixture that contains trace amounts of copal, if so, they are undetectable to my sense of smell. In other words, do not purchase this product if you are looking for a stick incense version of Copal that is traditionally burned throughout the Yucatan.

Business-wise, great seller (quick delivery, etc). Product is misleading and incorrect.

title: LOVE, LOVE THIS PRODUCT!
text: I purchased this product after severely cutting my heel with one of those blades used to cut the calluses from your feet. My husband had warned me of the dangers of using blades, and I've cut my feet several times. I read many reviews on this product and others before purchasing. It came in 2 days and had a charge when it arrived.  I keep it plugged in so it's ready whenever my husband or I are needing to use it. I'm very pleased with this product, and very happy that I purchased this.  It works very well and does a great job, and I use it at least once a week to keep my feet really soft. My husband also uses it about once a week also, to keep his feet smooth.  He was shot in the foot and the bullet fragments are still in his foot, and he gets calluses where the fragments are in his foot. I also purchased the extra rollers, but haven't had to change the original one out yet.  Those who complained about this product must not have used it properly.  When using don't press down thinking that extra pressure will help, it's not designed to be used like that.  Just lightly touch the area you want to treat and the file will definitely work well. For those who have a lot of hard calluses, you might want to either soak your feet first to soften the skin,  or use it everyday for a couple of days until you get the best results.  You don't want to over do it because you may cause your feet to be sore. I'm very happy with my purchase and highly recommend this wonderful gadget to anyone.  It will definitely save you a lot of money on getting pedicures elsewhere!

title: AMAZING PRODUCT but scent too strong and only found in small bottle
text:
I have thick curly coily AA hair.

It smells a tad too strong and perfumy, and does remind me of waterfalls and springs. It is thicker and creamier than other Suave naturals. It provides great slip, makes my hair soft and fluffy hours after drying, and my hair curls instantly, which lets me know my hair is moisturized.

Waterfall Mist is a great conditioner but not the best Suave bargain. You can find it in stores for as low as $0.85-$1, but it's only available in 12 ounces, whereas Suave Coconut is $1.50 for 33 ounces. So in the long run, this particular scent is not the best purchase for your money. My favorite Suave is Everlasting Sunshine and Coconut, which work even more amazingly on my hair but come in larger sizing with more pleasant scents. For this reason I would not repurchase this particular scent again even though I had a great experience with it. If you don't mind paying the same price for less product and really like the scent, then this is a great buy for you.

I like my nails to be as hard, lasting, and shiny as they are weeks after my salon gel manicures, so that is my goal! Will Update after I use a primer and UV lights.

title: Works well overall - but "bristles" vary in length year to year, become brittle and break off too easily.
text:
It is difficult to find a large barreled curling iron/brush. HELEN OF TROY offers a broad range of assorted sizes, and they work well. This is my third or fourth purchase of this same model in about 10 years. Even though I purchase the same model, I find that the hard plastic "bristles" vary in height from year to year. The short "bristles" sometimes place the hot barrel too close to my skin, especially when the "bristles" break off (which is fairly easy and common, possibly due to overexposure to heat). The models that arrived with longer "bristles" are more suited for longer hair, however they sometimes "tangle" in the hair -- and THEY, too break off all too easily. (I have recommended to the manufacturer that they add something slightly more flexible to the "bristles" to keep them from getting brittle and breaking, or perhaps design the barrels so that new sets of bristles can be installed, however -- why would they take my suggestion when consumers can simply replace the entire unit with a new one?) The heating elements in these units have never failed; only the "bristles" are problematic.

Overall, I like this model, but I find that I need to replace it after about 12-18 months of use due to loss of "bristles".

title: Worked perfectly!  And comes with two patterns!
text:
Latest update: I have to remove a star from my original five-star rating. The nail polish doesn't stay on for long :(

I saw this kind of nail polish some years ago and thought it was really cool. My wife wanted to get it but it was a bit too pricey at the time so she never got it.

Times have changed and we were able to finally get these. As UPS dropped off the package, my wife tackled him and grabbed the box because she was so excited. She ripped the box wide open and started doing her nails right there in the grass. Okay, okay that's not really true. But she was really excited and did try it out right away - the UPS guy was not harmed.

I'm a dude so pink is pink. I ordered pink and the product is pink. Looks good. In the bottle, and when it is first applied, it looks like regular metallic nail polish. No big deal, right? Well, they include two different magnets, each with a different design. After the polish is applied to the nails, you have to immediately place the magnet over the nail while being careful to not actually touch the nail with the magnet. Hold it there for a little bit (I think it said 15 seconds), then it magically has a cool design. I think it's really cool how it does that.

My six year old daughter was amazed just as much as I was. Actually, maybe a little less than I was. Lol. We told to get to bed early and then if mommy and her wake up early enough before school, then she can have her nails done with Magnetix. She's pretty excited. Yes we are very excited family tonight...haha. Seriously, it's pretty cool. My daughter said she can't wait to go to school to show her friends.

I received this product at a discount in exchange for me to try it out and leave an honest, unbiased review.

title: Turns the Tips of Your Nails Yellow
text:
UPDATED Review:
I took off one star because the tips of my nails turned yellow (and stayed that way for a few days) after using this product. Using ordinary nail polish didn't have that effect.

Previously:
These are convenient for travel but I found that using one pad just isn't enough to remove the nail polish from both hands, especially if you have glitter or gel. When you rip open the packet, the cloth is heavily saturated with nail remover and when you unfold it it's about the size of one of those wet naps you get when you eat greasy food. I draped the cloth over both hands and pressed my nails against it, but though I used every inch of the cloth and squeezed out as much product as I could, I still had leftover polish on the edges of my fingers. Not wanting to waste a whole other cloth to finish the job, I blotted the remainder using a cotton ball and my usual polish remover.

Overall, it's strong and will remove most of your polish, but the cost of this product is higher than if you stocked up on a few bottles of nail polish remover and used cotton balls. But if you're traveling, it would definitely be more convenient and I suppose that's what you're be paying for. But be prepared to use 2 cloths at a time to get it all off, which adds up to only 5 uses.

title: Bristles shed and get stuck in your hair. Nylon bristles are longer than their boar counterparts
text: I ordered this brush as boar bristle brushes are really good for thicker/frizzier hair. Boar bristle brushes help to smooth layers of hair as compared to nylon brushes that can leave lumps in the hair and not fully lay down and smoothen hair because of how spread apart the bristles are. This brush does have nylon bristles- which kind of defeats the purpose of having a bristle brush because the nylon bristles are longer than the boar bristles making it harder to let the boar bristle sink into lower layers of your hair. I was not too happy realizing how much longer the nylon bristles were comparatively. From the picture it looked like they would be the same length. The boar bristles also aren’t as sturdy as other boar bristle brushes I’ve owned- they do not glide through thicker hair as easily and tend to bend because they do not want to sink into the hair and rather glide across. I’ve owned many other boar bristle brushes that actually sink in a little bit to help untangle as well as de frizz and smoothen your hair. Lastly, it sheds…a LOT. I kept touching my hair after to make sure the brush was getting my hair smooth and I kept feeling something rough in my hair- there were a lot of little pieces of boar stuck in my hair! With each swipe of the brush it would loose 3-5 bristles, and those bristles would cling to my thick hair and get stuck in. The only way to get them out was to wash my hair and as this is an on the go style brush that isn’t a very good quality. I would not want tiny little bristles stuck in my hair if I do a touch up while I’m out with family/friends or touching up my hair before a business meeting. I did not enjoy my experience with this brush- because of the length of the nylon bristles not allowing the boar bristles to penetrate my hair and the fact that the boar bristles shed way too much. Personally, I do not recommend this product. There are other boar bristle brushes out there that won’t break the bank and are high enough quality that they don’t shed. You can even find other smaller travel ones like this that work better in my personal opinion. The size is great for a little on the go pick me up but the quality of the bristles is a setback.

title: Might be helpful, but not spectacular
text:
I am cautiously optimistic that this product will be helpful, but it's hard to say since I can't scientifically compare the "after" to the "before" . I've been using it for about a month. It certainly does no harm and might do some good, but to say that it's miraculous is a bit of an over statement.

My hair is damaged from old age and too many medications. The newer the hair, the less dry and damaged it appears. The tips are terribly dry, but it seems to me that, since using this product they are a little bit more flexible and maybe softer in texture but no different in appearance.

The shampoo lathers well and I leave it on for a few minutes while I bathe to let it soak in. However, since I can't find an Argan Oil Conditioner that doesn't have to be washed as in shampooed) out I'm not using a conditioner. It seems to me that having to shampoo, then add a conditioner, and have to shampoo it out is more time consuming than necessary. I haven't used any of my non-argan oil conditioners because I'm afraid they might undo whatever the shampoo is supposed to have done. To me, the idea combination is a shampoo and rinse-out conditioner that are meant to compliment each other.

title: Cant even cover my 2 yr olds forehead much less mine.
text:
I ordered this product to experiment on what I would look like with bangs before taking the big step and cutting off hair. This product did not confidently help in my decision making and I definitely would never wear it in public. It only covers 1/3 of my forehead width! It’s an inch wide, how is this supposed to look realistic??? I ordered the color brown- it is DEFINITELY not brown. It’s a vibrant auburn with more red times than anything. I was so surprised at how tiny this product was I tried placing it in my daughters hair…it still wouldn’t even cover a small toddler’s forehead. It looks great on one of her baby-dolls though haha. Not only is it spare in the width across the forehead but it’s also extremely thin- if you have thick hair it will look out of place.

Some things that are good:
The hair quality does feel nice, although they skimped on provided the right amount and size. The hair is smooth and silky but not overly shiny and fake looking. The clasp stays in place very well.

Things that need to be improved:
Give more hair! I feel this product would be fine to add volume to already present bangs but let’s be honest, most women who buy bang extensions don’t already have bangs. They want the extension so they don’t have to commit to bangs. It needs to be wide enough to cover an adults forehead and blend nicely into where their natural hair falls and frames the face. And the wefts need to be fuller to provide a beautiful amount of volume in comparison to the natural hair on their heads as well.

Overall:
I don’t recommend this product. As stated before- it fits a little babydoll but if you’re buying for a teen or adult it’s not going to be a decent product. The color is off from what is shown online- I usually expect small differences in color especially when it’s remy human hair but this is more than a few levels of color differentiation. After trying this product and realizing it was not a good fit I did some research on Amazon to see if I could find comparable prices for bang clips that seemed of better quality and they are out there! I’d recommend checking out others before purchasing this product unless you already have bangs and just want a small volume lift addition.

title: Left my face feeling tight & dry
text:
I received 1.7 ounces of product in a plastic pump bottle. The product has a shimmery gold appearance & has a light, very pleasing scent.

This product claims the following: "this unique effervescent mask delivers the essential benefits of oxygen to energize the skin and brighten dullness, instantly... Perfect to revive and rejuvenate dull, tired skin; it also replenishes moisture to give the skin a plump, dewy appearance."

I did my usual double cleanse and applied this product as directed by applying a thin layer to damp skin & left it on for 10 minutes. It sort of tickled my face as it began to bubble a little. I am not sure if my face was damp enough or if I didn't use enough product but the bubbly effect eased up & then the product dried a bit. After my time was up, I rinsed my face with warm water & I gently patted my skin dry. Usually this is when I would apply a toner but I wanted to feel my face once it was dry. I was hoping this product would replenish moisture to give my skin a plump & dewy finish. Unfortunately my skin felt tight & dry and left me feeling unimpressed because of this.

For the price point & disappointing results, I cannot recommend this product.

title: Tonica's Sparkling Oxygen Mask Feels Like a Work in Progress
text:
There's much to like about Tonica's Sparkling Oxygen Mask, a unique spa treatment in a bottle offering oxygen skin-energizing treatments in a less than two-ounce canister that one can do easily at home in a matter of minutes.

The experience itself is pleasurable, the canister's pump action offering a bit of the energizing mask that contains acai, resveratol, and grapefruit cell extract to infuse the skin with oxygen, help clear up free radicals, and brighten/even skin tone.

I will admit my initial impression was a bit low given the relatively small canister arrived with a slightly uneven label. This is something I wouldn't expect from what is undeniably a more premium product. I set aside that concern and enthusiastically tried the product. It seems like when the mask settles in the canister that it takes a couple of pumps to get it to dispense, though once it does everything is fine. These are minor bugs, but if they want to tap into the premium market then presentation matters.

It takes very little to apply and it smooths out evenly on the face and you let it activate over the next 5-10 minutes before rinsing it off. I could definitely feel it activate and I will definitely say my face felt vibrant and energized throughout my work day each time I've used it. I noticed on video meetings that I even looked more energized. So, that's pretty cool.

I'm not sure I'm seeing anything resembling a long-term benefit with the mask. This feels like something I'd use on a day when I have an important meeting or am really dressed to impress. The way that it brightens the skin makes me look healthier and more alert. So, it's not a daily use kind of product for me but it's certainly something I can see turning to when my face needs that extra boost because it definitely gives it a rather remarkable boost that looks and feels wonderful.

While packaging and presentation could use some tweaking, I'm still inclined to give this a thumbs up and it's a product I'll continue to use and then I'll evaluate any future purchases once I see how my face looks and feels once this canister is gone.

The look of the Lassie hair dryer is what caught my eye first. It just looks cool! I have the PinkGray color. The gray is a medium shade with a smooth finish that won’t pick up hairs and dust. The pink is a metallic magenta that really pops.

The speed controls are on the handle. The slide button doesn’t move easily, so there’s not a big chance of accidentally changing the speed/temperature without meaning to. On the back of the handle is the option for either cool or hot temperature.

The hair dryer doesn’t dry my hair any faster than any other hair dryer I’ve used. But I like that I can set the temperature to cool to lessen damage and not have to hold in a cool shot button.

The hair dryer isn’t as lightweight as some plastic models I’ve used, but it’s weighted pretty well. The weight of it is distributed evenly on both sides of the handle.

The attachments have little tabs that line up with notches on the nozzle, and then you twist them to lock them in place. I like it -- there’s less chance of them popping off while I use the hair dryer.

The bottom of the hair dryer says the rated power is 1800 watt, which is contrary to the description which says it is 2000 watt.

text:
If you are expecting Shave which is closer to Blade then stop. No Rotary Shaver will ever will do that. I have used Rotary Shavers for last 20 years for beard and I purchased this product with those expectations only. I bought this product for its high ratings, 5 blades vs 4 blades and digital display for battery life. I bought it for my head not face. I still use my Norelco for Beard and quite happy with it.

It started pretty good and deserved all the high ratings when I started using it new.

5 Blades seem better than four but now I feel four is more practical. It is pain to open blades for cleaning. I can still manage outer four with little effort but middle on is pain in fingers. You are supposed to push outer blades backwards and open those first and then rotate middle one counter clock wise to open it but there is no grip to do that. It is just too small and flushed with bottom surface. Same happens when you try to put it back after cleaning. Guys stick with 4 blades

Battery: This is where it let me down after 2.5 months of use. Battery and its digital display worked just fine for a month and a half and then out of blue it went from 30% to 9% in the middle of shave. Then after a few days I turned off shaver after use with battery level of 27% and couple of days later it won't turn on and forced me to charge. You cannot use this shaver plugged in so if battery dies on you you would need about an hour before you can use it again. I wish I had that luxury in morning.

Now after 2.5 months of use I can hear freshly washed/cleaned shaver struggling even in air. Doesn't look like it will last very long.

I feel that I didn't get the worth of money I spent on this product.

title: Sadly let down by this liner.
text:
I wanted to like this eyeliner pen, I really did...but I just couldn't. If you can get it for super cheap or almost free, it might be worth your time, but only if you don't have watery eyes AT ALL.

I have several issues with this eyeliner:

1. It isn't labeled as waterproof so I wasn't expecting it to be such, but I was expecting "water resistant". I mean, eyes are WET, and this product is meant to draw an artistic line on the eye area. Nope, it melted right off the second my eye got the slightest amount of dampness in the corner. Wing disappeared almost completely within 5 minutes of application on one eye.

2. The color dries a bit more muted than the actual color appears to look upon first inspection. The plastic housing the felt eyeliner is a very vivid and bright blue, so I expected the product to be similar in color. As I drew it on my eyelid, it appeared very bright...but sadly dried down to a deeper and less bold shade of blue. I didn't want one shade lighter than "navy", I wanted a color that would truly stand out.

3. If you miss a spot and have to go over an area that already has eyeliner, expect to have to redo the entire eye. Touching up a small area removes all of the color from the surrounding areas where the brush even gently grazes. Get it right the first time or redo the entire eye, there is NO layering with this brush eyeliner. Most of my liquid eyeliners are a bit more forgiving in this area.

So bottom line...not what I hoped for. I expected more from a major brand like Too Faced. I guess there is a reason why it has been discontinued and is almost being given away with such a cheap price. The idea is nice...it looks like a writing pen. You can even put it in your shirt pocket like one, and it's adorable packaging. You may have more luck if you have very dry eyes, or if you want to use it as a bottom lash eyeliner...but don't expect to make fine-lined wings or artistic designs with it. I have ultra cheap Wet N Wild eyeliner with far more staying power.

title: Like the way it makes my natural & nappy hair feel
text:
This has the very, very *very* faintest plant-like scent (which is clean and pleasing). It's also thicker than I expected - almost like a whipped lotion. Before I used it on my hair, I rubbed some into the back of my hand to see if I'd have any kind of skin reaction. I did not. What I noticed is that once this absorbed, there was absolutely zero residue. I don't know what that means, but I was just curious. When I rub in other types of hair masks & treatments, I always get a sense of something left that I need to wash off. When I used this on my hair in the shower, I left it on for about
2 to 3 minutes after I had massaged it in according to the directions. (I have to stop and mention that I was also using the Daelong shampoo and conditioner set beforehand. That might be why I got my results.) This rinses out extremely well. My hair felt conditioned but with a lot less of the residual slip from other conditioners. That kind of worried me. I like to know that a treatment is doing something & the only way to tell until you've used it for a while is by the way your hair feels. Where I became so happy with this is an hour after rinsing it out. I have coarse and "nappy" natural African American hair. My hair tends to be extremely dry - especially after washing. A good conditioner keeps things in check until I can apply my leave-in products (oils, butters, sprays, etc.), but this time, my hair stayed soft and easy to comb through for at least 2 hours. It might have been longer, but I went ahead and applied my usual leave-ins. Still, I know that this did soften my hair (the day after, my hair is retaining softness without any more leave-in applications) without making it feel fragile. With they type of hair I have, I have to worry about breakage. I realize that I have probably been clogging up my scalp by over-doing it with the oils and butters. I like that I haven't had to use more of them for my hair to feel manageable. As a test, I'm going to try easing up on using so much leave-in stuff while I continue to use this.I think these guys are on to something here. I will have to come back and update this review as I use this for a while but, for now, I love the way this makes my hair feel, even after just one treatment. Normally, I only fully wash my hair once every four weeks or so. I will do a co-wash about every other week to keep it clean without stripping it. While I am testing this out, I plan to use it at least once a week as my co-wash. Like I said, I am also using the shampoo & conditioner of this brand. That might be a big part of why this worked so well for me, but I think that this would work just as good on its own. By the way, I'm going to alter my washing regimen for a while to use the shampoo and conditioner at least every other week. I almost forgot to mention the other thing I was concerned about: the label says that this makes the hair "straight and silky" - which is exactly what I, personally, DO NOT want. I love my texture and want to keep it. My texture is the kind that is prone to slow growth (because of breakage) so... I'm not worried about losing my naps. I'm thinking that this aids in stopping breakage more than anything.
I got this at a very steep discount.

text: I got this wig yesterday and wore it to a family event and some people didn't know it was a wig. The color is about as dark as my hair would be if I dyed it soft black, which I do sometimes. The hair is very soft and doesn't irritate me like my synthetic wigs. However, I think they sent me the wrong length, but I'm not upset about it - for a human hair wig that's this versatile (read: can be worn by a white girl) this price is really great and I understand that on their end things might be hectic. I got a bad haircut a week ago and wasn't able to leave my house, was super depressed, crying all the time when i saw a mirror. This wig is a great solution as the semester is starting in one week and I absolutely have to be on campus. It's less hot than other wigs I have, and I feel confident that this looks natural enough to pass as I start meeting new people at my new school. title: Good features for medium duty requirements, but 7xxx series might be a better value
text:
I've owned this for a year and am quite pleased with it. But, if I were to buy again, I would probably go with the lower-cost 7xxx series. There are a few more features on the 8140XL -- the charging stand and full charge LED -- but basically Norelco makes a decent electric shaver. Upsides:
1) One significant benefit is the LONG time before the battery needs to be recharged -- perhaps a combination of using a good battery and low power requirements. I have taken it on a week-long business trip without bringing the charger.
Downsides:
1) $45 for a set of replacement blades is high. However, after a year, the original blade set is still adequate.
2) A "needs charging" LED would be useful.
Note that my shaver gets relatively light usage -- my beard is not overly thick, and I use a Gillette blade after not shaving over the weekend -- a blade gives a much quicker and better shave on a couple days' growth. This Norelco gets used Monday-Friday. Overall, I'm happy with this shaver and am glad to see Norelco back with a quality product.

That said, I only had my toes painted so it was not really possible for me to stick my toes in the jar and rotate them so I took the sponge out, gave it a squeeze to get to the excess nail polish remover off and went to work with on my toes.  It was very easy and very fast.  This nail polish remover is at least 3x better than what I have in bottles underneath my bathroom sink.  I think as the nail polish remover is used up and/or evaporates I will refill it with more nail polish remover.  The pink sponge was soft, yet still rough enough to get the old nail polish off.  At first I was thinking this thing was going to be a bust, but it has turned out to be extremely useful.

title: Smells good but …
text:
Have you ever heard of the saying hair like a ‘rat’s nest’?

Waited a few days between washing to try this variety of shampoo.

Bought one of each of the four bars. By smell picked this as my favorite. Tried it first.

Made certain to lather my hair well. It's long to mid back. I'm in my mid-fifties. Sharing this because of hair texture and type change as we age.

This may not work for me, but can be for your hair.

Currently, use Loreal hair color every few months. Sharing this because this may affect shampoos.

Anyhow, used that bar on the top and under the back and made certain my hair was soapy, and rinsed it completely.

My long hair was matted to my head.

This is not normal. I've tried other bar soap to wash my hair before and the effect is similar. I'm wondering if it's because of the ingredients of soap.

I slathered lots of conditioning balm on my now gauze-textured hair.

In about five minutes my hair was soft and manageable. Able to run fingers through it.

If I was a man this would work probably. Maybe other women with different textured hair would function better than mine did following shampooing with this bar.

I've got three others to try, so who knows.

My preferred shampoo is this brand in the bottle in the honey variety.

Prior loreal no sulfite shampoo began acting weird.

I've consistently used a chlorine filter in the shower and tub so not sure other than my hair texture has changed over time or the city water maybe.

Seeing Drew Barrymore mention this shampoo gave it a try since we have similarly textured hair.

It's amazing. My hair looks awesome. A huge relief from what the other stuff failed to do.

Having the Whole Blends sulfite-free delivered on the sub and save in Honey Blend. Hoping it does as good a job.

In regards to the shampoo bars, they make nice soap. Depending on how the other few works may end up changing the soap bar jobs.

I don't like two of the scents. But if it works on my hair may use it anyway.

⭐️ because this product doesn't function in a way that cleans ad softens my hair. Rather than creating a pot of spaghetti twisted and stuck together after being drained, but not rinsed.

If a comparable conditioner in a bar is available I’d pay to try it. Until then, will not use this variety in my hair again. Though, am going down the list of the other three bars in case they work better

title: Contains no actual liquid eyeliner. A glorified, dried-up marker :/
text:
Yes, this product causes irritation - it made me QUITE irritable the first time I used it.

First off, this is not a liquid eyeliner pen. There is no liquid eyeliner in it whatsoever.

It is, in essence, a glorified, dried-up marker - not even a sharpie - more like the cheap markers that come with the coloring pages at Walgreens or the dollar stores. I'm not knocking E.L.F. but this is quite sub-par. I'd be miffed if I hadn't gotten it on sale for like $1.86.

The 'marker' tip actually retreats into the pen itself when you press with any pressure whatsoever, which is awkward and you have to then pull it back out and just hope it doesnt keep happening.

Not easy to apply. Mostly because it's not easy to apply dried up ink from a cheap marker tip, to your (slightly moist) eye lid area!

I was not able to achieve any type of dramatic, dark eye liner with this pen. It looked like i had tried to put it on with a ... you guessed it, dried up marker. :)

You shake the pen and hear nothing, because there is nothing in there to be mixed by the shaking. It is literally just a dried up marker.

It is, however, just as waterproof as a dying Sharpie.

title: excellent ingredients, could use more packaging info, works well w/ shamp & conditioner
text:
I like the shampoo and conditioner a lot- leaves my hair soft, manageable, and healthy looking. I added in this serum as I hoped to gain hair density or at least reduce loss (or reduce cycle frequency and/or duration). I dont have trouble growing my hair, I have trouble keeping it. So my hair is long, but much less dense than previous years. I transitioned from minoxidil to this. I wont do that again, as any gains I got from minoxidil were lost-- and I do contribute some of that to not using this as consistently as I did that. I'll explain what went into that below. This serum helped the condition of my hair and scalp, so I think it works well with minoxidil instead of in lieu of it. I likely wont continue with the serum for a few reasons.

1. there was no instruction as to how to use this product. It is a dropper bottle, and I pretty much just used it like I did with minoxidil-- massaged whatever I pulled with dropper and distributed all over scalp, primarily at crown. Was this the correct way to do it? no idea. *

2. It does say to apply to clean hair. Well, many of us do not wash our hair every single day. I have long curly hair that leans dry and there is no need to wash it daily. So I am either applying this to unwashed scalp daily or it only gets applied a few times a week. Hence the lack of consistency. So right here it eliminates some would-be users if it has to be on a fresh washed scalp.

3. the dropper is uncomfortable. I do not want to drop it from the dropper. I want to run it across the scalp so as to keep it from getting on my hair. The dropper is a little sharp feeling (at least my bottle that I received). I like the dropper style, and my thought is that if I were to buy this again, I would use a dropper from an old minoxidil bottle instead.

4. How long should this bottle last? Since I had no idea how much I should use, I often wondered if I used too much or too little. Any new hair treatment needs to be given 4-6 months of consistent use to see results, if any. I know the shampoo and conditioner helped, and this serum has great ingredients that will help existing hair and scalp health.. but the inconsistency on my part from lack of instructions as well as expectation of using on fresh washed hair made it impossible to see if I could get benefit from it.

* "It is best applied to damp hair after showering. We recommend visually splitting your scalp into 4 sections/quadrants. Depending on the amount of hair, use around 3-5 drops per quadrant. I like to drop into fingers and work into scalp. The remaining amount on your fingers you can work through your hair. It is perfectly fine to use the serum many times a day. That being said, it is important that the scalp/hair is clean" (--I saw this written in the community question section of this page. Including this on box or in a leaflet would have been greatly helpful)

The ingredients are of quality, the products work well together. I have since gone back to minoxidil, and once I have stopped the current shedding phase, I may buy another bottle to use as a support product. For that, I give it 4 stars.

title: Excellent BBB
text:
You get what you pay for when buying a boar bristle brush. This brush has a great feel to it, the handle and weight of the brush in my hand work well to guide the brush through my long hair. The purpose of a BBB is not to detangle; it is to stimulate the scalp, spread sebum throughout your length, and use as a finishing brush. One should use a detangle brush or comb before brushing with a BBB. I use the GranNatuarals Boar Bristle Brush in the morning and at night, and I never use it on wash days. It is not a brush to use on wet hair. So, if you know this about a BBB, this is an excellent choice in BBB.

Also, the weight and shape of this brush make an excellent hair brush paddle choice.

I highly recommend this brush on both counts.
