title: Organic ingredients are the best, but they need to smell good (or not at all)
text:
I chose this because it is organic and pure ingredients. The ingredients are the most important part of a product for me but smell ranks quite high as well. The ingredients that are organic and pure usually still smell good to me but not this. I have hyperosmia, which means smells are stronger for me and I smell what others may not. For me, this did not smell good and I cannot continue using it as it's just too much for me to put so close to my nose. It may not smell to others, but for me, it's a deal breaker. So, if you have a hypersensitivity to smell, I caution you. If you have normal smelling abilities, or better yet, less than normal olfactory skills, you might love it. I want to stress that not all organic things smell bad! I have plenty of organics that actually smell really good. This just isn't a smell I can put on my face long term to get the benefit...I'll have to keep my wrinkles.

title: Cute Until You Wash It
text:
First let me say that my comments are about the 4b/4c texture version of this product. I ordered and received this very tightly curled ponytail and I really liked how easily it matched my 4c hair. It's not as full as the picture at all, probably about half the fullness but it's still cute. I wore it for about 4 weeks, using the same products and care I do to my own hair. Again, no problems. I decided to order a 2nd one so that I could wear the pair together and get the fullness I wanted. Meanwhile, I decided to do a full co-wash and this thing became a tangled unmanageable mess! I spent about 2 hours un-matting it and trying to recover it. After it dried it was stretched out, very little curl definition and kind of a mess. So once again I sectioned it, deep conditioned it, and put my normal defining products in it and then that was all she wrote. Completely unsalvageable. I am so disappointed. Now I do have the 2nd one but can only wear the one so I still don't have the fullness I wanted and I pretty much know that once I wash this one that'll probably be the end of it's days. So my suggestion is to use minimal product. Try to do more of a spray wash vs a full-on wash and get as much use out of it as you can.

I will mention however that when the 2nd one came it was more of a 3c texture and when I contacted the seller to let them know I needed the tighter curl they sent one out to me super fast and with no hassle so the customer service is good. I do still have the looser curl but I am not currently wearing it so I don't know how that one will wear. From what I understand the 3c version is the one they now send with this listing.

I found there is some range in colors but not a big one. There are some darker colors and some lighter colors and then the rest all was somewhat similar. I was a bit disappointed by the colors really, but then again, for the price can I really say anything about that? There weren’t really any nudes in there.

The lipsticks were easy to apply but not that creamy. However they feel ok on the lips. They are not very sticky or anything but also don’t feel super smooth or creamy on the lips either. They feel just ok really. They don’t taste or smell of anything. Their staying power is ok, they wear off as you eat and drink like a lot of lipsticks do really. So considering these costs $10 for 12 of them, they are not horrible. They feel ok on the lips, the color range is limited in my eyes but they are not bad at all, all considering. Keeping everything in mind, I am rating them at 3 stars.

title: Lady Passion For Women, Eau De Parfum 3.3 Fl. Oz.
text:
[[ASIN:B01EW8Y4FC Lady Passion For Women, Eau De Parfum 3.3 Fl. Oz./100 ml - Inspired By Paris Hilton By Paris Hilton Perfume]]

I wanted to try a new parfum for a new signature scent, but didn't have a whole lot of money with paying for a wedding next month. The seller does a fantastic job of packaging and delivering quickly. The cologne is very pretty in it's design in a feminine pink bottle that looks similar to the brands original and that's pretty on my dresser or vanity. This perfume is definitely smells nice. It has a sort of sandalwood undertone that is very inviting, but you can also smell apples and peaches and a slight hint of floral and romantic undertones like flowers. The scent is not overpowering. It's difficult to explain how scents smell but all I can say is it really does smell wonderful, it doesn't give me a headache and my fiance really enjoys this perfume on me. It lasts a lot longer if I spray it on my wrist and other pulse points and lingers in the air. I receive complements from women and men while wearing it , and several women even asked what I was wearing. I definitely recommend this wonderful parfum and would absolutely say try it. This is a 3.3 ounce bottle at under 11.00 delivered to your door. I purchased this product at a discounted price in exchange for my honest review. The discount I received will not alter my honest opinion in any way. Since I count on honest product reviews to make my selections on Amazon, I will always be forthcoming and sincere in all my reviews. No matter if the product is discounted or not, I will leave honest feedback that I base on my own personal experience with the product I receive. I am in no way affiliated with any supplier or manufacturer of goods.*One last note, I wasn't sure what the difference in Eau De Parfum and Perfume is, so I looked it up. Here's what I found on the web on perfume website:
Eau de parfum. "After the top notes have died away, the middle notes or heart notes of a perfume become noticeable. This is the focus of eau de parfum which makes it perfect to spray on hair or clothing. (Be careful with delicate fabrics such as silk, though, as they may stain.) The concentration of oils is over 15%, sometimes reaching as high as 20%. Since it is less intense than perfume extract, it is also cheaper, but it usually lasts well and is sold in small sizes." So it is stronger than Eau de Cologne which contains about 7% essence dissolved in alcohol of 60º or 70º, and stronger than Eau de toilette which contains around 10% aromatic essence. But not as strong as Perfume. This is the strongest of scents because of the higher concentration of essences – as much as 40% by volume.

title: Does a passable job, but not a great one
text:
I bought this to replace a Braun shaver that was about 5-6 years old. I've used it for about a month, and here are my pros and cons.

Pros:
-I love the trimmer. It's far enough away from the cutters to make trimming easy, and it does wonders for my skin as a pre-shave in case I missed a day. That might actually be the best part of the product.
-It's very quiet. I can shave at night without disturbing anyone. My last shaver sounded like a wood chipper, so this is a welcome feature.
-Cleaning isn't much of a hassle. (This isn't a great pro, but it is worth mentioning.)
-Affordable, which is probably why I'm not sending it back. If I spent $100+ on it, it wouldn't be in my house right now, but the current price is what attracted me in the first place.

Cons:
-To be honest, it doesn't really come through with a complete or very close shave. It still leaves many hairs, especially on my neck, and I can still feel a little bit of stubble, even after going over my skin enough times to chop it to bits.
-Irritation is still a problem. I have the unfortunate combination of coarse hair and sensitive skin, so it's very hard to get a close and comfortable shave. This doesn't help. I end up cutting myself about half the time in order to get a full shave, and in some cases, the razor burn is brutal. I find myself applying aftershave at least twice after a regular shave.
-The design makes it difficult to shave particular places, like under my sideburns and above my mouth. Having a wide face is good for shaving a larger surface area, but it makes finer shaving a bit clumsy.

Honestly, this unit should be better. If I didn't need a new foil on my old razor (which would be about $30 after shipping), I would almost be financially obligated to send this one back. For its main functions, it really isn't an improvement on my old razor, which is disappointing when you consider that this is new and carries a trusted brand name. Some of the other features provide added convenience, but I didn't buy this just to have a quiet trimmer.

title: Favorite Palette Ever!!
text:
I purchased this product in a store, but I am such a fan I had to write a review. Ever since I purchased this palette, it has been my go-to for everyday makeup. I am fair-skinned with dark hair and hazel eyes, and the colors are perfect. I don't always use every color in a palette and I don't always place the colors as directed, but in this case, Stila knows what they are talking about!

The large color on the left is your all-over base, and I apply that first. Next, I go to the top right corner and apply this grayish color from crease to browbone. Third, I take the darkest color and place it quite heavily (but narrowly) in the crease and a little in the corner and lash line. Next, I put the highlight (lightest) color just under the brow and also outside the inner corner of the eye. Finally, I put the shimmery gold-like color in the middle across the lid and blend all the colors with a blending brush. I use the darker blush normally, but use the light one as a highlight if I want the added effect. I love that when I am doing my makeup on the run, I only have to grab this one container and my makeup brushes (I have the EcoTools Eye Enhancing Duo Brush set with four tips on two brushes, so even there you don't have to take as much with you).

The quality of the product is excellent and it blends well. Other than the darkest brown, the eyeshadow pigments are not super intense, so you can go light or apply more for a deeper intensity.

They had a good idea.what could have been a very simple design was taken too far by adding the stop valve and flip cap on the bottles.
Why not just have a bottle that screws shut. Unscrew to use, screw cap back on to seal???? These have a good and tight fitting screw on cap but the issue is the cap has a simple flip up section, much like a ketchup bottle does. That part of the cap is what leaks. Then, as if that is not bad enough, the design of the bottle is to store it UPSIDE DOWN....
Take the cap on the bottle now and throw it away, replace it with a simple screw on cap and now you will have a full 5 star product. Now though it is below 1 star because of leakage. Will be returning them.

title: Poor Quality Cushion Flattened Out Immediately
text:
I have been battling with coccyx pain for several months and needed a cushion that would support me while suspending my tailbone above the seat. This cushion was no help at all, because the foam was so squishy that it completely flattened out the instant I tried to sit on it. My tailbone was subjected to the same issues of compression and pain that I have with no cushion at all. In fact, it actually made the problem worse, because the foam in this cushion has so little substance that it crawled around underneath me and bunched up under my bottom, creating a large, uncomfortable lump right at the site of the pain! I desperately needed a cushion made of dense, firm, high quality foam, and this is simply not up to that standard. I returned it immediately.

The fortunate thing is that the seller was easy to deal with, and was both cheerful and prompt with my refund. THEY EVEN REFUNDED MY RETURN SHIPPING! So, even though I cannot recommend this specific product, I would not hesitate to recommend the seller for anything else they are marketing on Amazon.

I am sorry that I cannot give anyting better than one star to this cushion, but it really was worse than nothing for my particular problem. I am just glad that Amazon gives me the chance to review the seller's actions in a seperate forum. I was happy to give Cosmetic Solutions the highest rating possible!

title: Weightless, Skin Feels Silky, Makeup Lasts Longer, Blurs Lines-Odd Smell, Skin Gets Weird Sensation
text:
This Grown Alchemist Anti-Pollution Primer has a gel texture that feels weightless on my skin. This doesn’t have a lot of ingredients and lacks chemical fragrance, but I find the scent is moderately strong. I assume it’s mostly from natural lavender, rose and grapefruit oils. I really don’t love the scent as it smells odd to me, but it mellows out and doesn’t really bother me. The lavender and grapefruit oils are potential irritants, but my sensitive skin hasn’t had any visible reaction or real discomfort using this primer.

I have dry skin and when I apply the primer my skin feels a weird initial sensation that reminds me of alcohol, but so far it hasn’t caused any visible dryness. I do always apply a hydrating essence, serum and cream before the primer and I see the primer has glycerin, so that may be why I don’t see dryness or maybe something in this just feels mildly irritating to my skin. This does have benzyl alcohol pretty low on the list, so maybe I’m feeling that but the good part is that I haven’t had any real issue. I can’t say if daily use might dry my skin.

This primer is super lightweight, so sheer it’s invisible and I don’t feel any sticky residue. It makes my skin feel silky, and my cream and liquid foundations spread smoothly and evenly over it. I do notice a blurring effect, especially around my mouth area where I need all the help I can get. My makeup holds up well all day even though the weather has been so really hot lately. Other than that weird sensation I get that does eventually pass, my skin generally feels comfortable. Like it. 4 stars. Made in Australia.

Ingredients: Aqua/Water/Eau, Sodium Acrylates Crosspolymer-2, Acetyl Heptapeptide-4 (Prebiotic-Peptide/Peptides Prébiotiques), Caprylyl Glycol, Glycerin (*Plant/Plante), Fructose, Withania Somnifera Root Extract (*Plant/Plante), Ganoderma Lucidum ( Mushroom) Extract, Citrus Paradisi (Grapefruit) Peel Oil, Lavandula Angustifolia (Lavender) Oil, Rosa Damascena (Rose Absolute/Rose Absolue) Flower Oil, Benzyl Alcohol, Dehydroacetic Acid. (*Plant Derived/Dérivé des Plantes).

title: Fragrance and Performance Both Surprising
text:
I admit I’m a shaving hobbyist. Soaps are like Pokémon, gotta catch ‘me all.

But we hobby shavers end up using these soaps once or twice and if they aren’t in our top 20 we put them up on the Reddit shaver trading boards. This way we can try ten soaps for the price of two, keep the ones we like and trade the rest looking for more winners.

Ladies and germs, this is a winner. My first Ogallalla product, I tried it on the recommendation of a guy I frequently trade with whose tastes are similar in many ways and who likes and demands the same performance characteristics of his shaving soaps. When he recommends one I sit up and listen.

So let’s talk performance. This soap, with my 26mm synthetic shaving brush, makes a ton of lather. A surprising amount. I kept adding water to get it down from “cake batter” to “pancake batter” to the soft whipped peaks and glossy sheen that lets me know it’s hydrated enough for maximum slickness. A nice thirsty shaving stick. Hooray. The ingredient list is vegan. I generally prefer soaps with tallow bases and added lanolin but I’m open minded about it. There are some vegan soaps in my keeper drawer.

Slickness was very good. Not quite what you can get from B&M’s “Reserve” line or good old Mitchell’s Wool Fat but very close. Lather, once worked to a good sheen and soft peaks, did not dissipate on the brush or dry on my skin. Maintains hydration well. Once again, B&M does it better, but for over $4 an ounce it ought to. For $1.50/oz. this stuff performs very well indeed. And as a bonus they include the plastic stick dispenser you won’t get from Arko or Speick. I just found my go-to travel shaving soap.

Scent: clovey but not as clovey as Ogallala’s matching aftershave, particularly the double strength. I found following my shave with Ogallala Bay Rum + Sweet Orange aftershave, regular strength, left my face smooth, disinfected, hydrated, and smelling like a Christmas tree but in a good way. The traditional clove top note fades on the dry down, leaving you with a really good scent for the rest of the day.

Some guys hate cloves. They get their bay rum fix from B&M, which uses no clove in its bay rum products. I like that too.

But this is a fantastic shaving experience for a shockingly low price, with added travel benefits. I’ll especially use it as the weather cools. I’m not keeping it because it performs well relative to price. I’m keeping it because it performs well regardless of price. The low price and portability are bonuses.

If you are a spice aficionado like me I recommend you try this shaving stick and don’t skimp on the water.

title: Great shave, light, easy clean up, slow to charge
text:
I've used Norelco shavers for years and I like them. After about 4 years my most recent Norelco stopped holding a charge, so I picked up this one.

Pros:

* It gives a great shave! They've changed the heads a bit and added some holes. Whatever it is, my shave is about 30% smoother better than my older Norelco and with less time.

* It's quiet. I can actually have a conversation with my wife while shaving. This wasn't possible with my older shaver.

* It is significanly lighter than my older model.

* Cleanup is really easy. You just flush the head with hot water once a week. Once a month or so you're supposed to take out the shaving disks in the head and brush them clean but my guess is that once a quarter would be plenty. Since cleanup is a major hassle, this is a terrific feature.

Cons:

* It takes 8 hours to charge. Yikes! Eight hours. My old shaver never took over an hour.

* It's hard to tell how much charge you have left. My older model had a gas gauge type indicator right on the front. This one just has a green light that goes on when you turn on the razor. When it runs low on juice you'll get a flashing red light when you finish shaving. This isn't nearly as handy.

* The shape isn't as ergonomic as the other model probably because of the water rinsing feature. There are little plastic fins that stick out from the handle presumably to help you hold on when it's wet. It doesn't feel very good in your hand.

* There is no case to store it in. This is a drawback if you use it to travel.

* The head is supposed to be replaced once a year. Huh??? This is apparently the case on all new Norelco shavers. These heads aren't cheap, folks. I certainly wouldn't replace one unless I was having problems with the shaver -- and then I'd probably buy a new one.

The bottom line is that I'm very pleased with this shaver. It does the job very well and it was quite inexpensive. I would certainly recommend this model over the higher end models if price is a consideration.

title: Love Hurts and flakes
text:
Love Hurts,
This lotion is a bit different than most tingle/bronzers.
The consistency is thick and it flakes off after tanning, I reccomend using an alcohol and fragrance free moisturizer post tan.
You will either love this or hate it, I know of nobody that falls in the middle.
The tingle is not overly intense and it gives you a very deep dark reddening that doesn't look shocking.
I like this lotion, but I do not like that the color you gain in tanning is temporary , it goes away the same day.
I usually mix this with a lotion intensifier to boost color stay and reduce the flaking off of the lotion.
If you are looking for a low fuss lotion, this might not be for you as it requires attention to keep flaking at a minimum.
If you have time to re moisturize and you don't want to look unusually red after tanning this is a good choice.
The scent is nice and the price is ok, but adding in mixing with others adds up.
I would love to give this more stars, but due to the fuss involved in tanning with this lotion I am not.

title: Practice makes perfect
text:
My wife has always wanted to try magnetic eyelashes, so she decided to give these a shot. They really do work! But, with these practice makes perfect.

They come with 2 tubes of magnetic eyeliner (black), and 10 sets of eyelashes along with the application tool. When you apply the magnetic eyeliner, you have to be precise. The eyeliner is black, and will look very dark if you do too thick of a line. I would do thinner lines if possible, with about 2 layers so that the eyeliner is not overwhelming. Once the eyeliner dries, use the application tool to put the lashes on.

It does feel a bit strange at first (if false lashes are new to you), and it may tickle around your eyes when you blink. But yes, these really work! With more practice my wife will get better at this.

The only thing is that the magnetic eyeliner does not come off easily. You will need a good eye makeup remover to get this off as it’s waterproof!

title: Cooling - but messy
text:
The box says "rapid repair formula." Two weeks and a full box of patches later I'm still waiting; fine lines look the same - but then, I didn't really expect miracles. More importantly, I'm trying hard to get rid of the dark circles that have recently developed under my eyes and they're getting worse! On the other hand, I will admit that the texture of the skin under my eyes has improved a bit, so it hasn't been a totally wasted effort.

The thing is, the patches are super-thin and flimsy and the gloop they're in is drippy. I need to open the package, carefully peel the patches apart, and then apply them over the sink. Then I rub the drips into my skin and hold the patches in place as I make my way to the bed to lie down for 15 minutes. The cool, gel-like gloopy stuff does quickly improve the dark circles - but a cold washcloth does that, too, and with a lot less mess.

The recommended usage is three times a week. I really wanted to love these, but I feel like there isn't enough improvement to warrant spending $6 a week and 15-20 minutes for each application/clean-up to warrant getting more of these. Too many other easier-to-use options that do as well or better.

The Good: the overnight product was absorbed by the lips, and seemed hydrating the next morning. Will update this review after a month or so for a longer lasting impression of effectiveness.

The Bad: Avacado, almonds, apricot seed oils seemed so... natural. Except the first 4 or more ingredients are chemicals. We are still looking them up to understand what we are putting - well, make that WERE putting - on our lips.

title: One came incomplete! It was missing 1 of the 3 decorative peices.
text:
My daughter and I liked the 4 set we got, so we got this matching set. We were disappointed when we saw one of the peices, it was missing one of the 3 decorations on the small clips.

These are clued on with a glue gun, sometimes you get glue strings that you may have to take off while that is not such a bug deal, one of the hair clips only had 2 of the 3 peices of decorations on it. The peice was not even in the bag either, if it was we could have found a way to reconnect it but was not even there, so we were extremely disappointed. 😞

If you order these, just know that you may need to skim them over and remove any loose strings of glue. These are cute and stylish. Great for teens or for photo-op.

(As long as there are no missing pieces, like we had! But, I do not know if this is a common occurrence or not. It could be uncommon for this to happen, maybe the person glued it on and it fell of before packaging? It seems as if that is the case, because the peice was not in the package with the clips. I know the makers are human and mistakes happen, but I thought you better know about it, so you would be better informed before purchasing the product.)

Other than the fact that there was this missing peice, these does seem to be nice and my daughter and I both like them as well as others in my family.

Note: I think the one clip, that was missing the peice should had not passed through quality control and got to packing and shipping.

(I also believe the worker needs to pay more attention to what they are doing, to me it seems as if someone was distracted and forgot to clue the 3rd peice on.
It doesn't seem to have had any glue in that spot, from what I can tell.)

I just want people to be aware of what they are getting and make their own choices on if they want to proceed with the purchase or not. (This is the 2nd item I have gotten, the 1st one was the 4 peice set just like this one.)

We personally Like these Items,
dispite one being Unusable.

Note: We are thinking of modifying it and removing the two other decorations off of it and using a Glue Gun to clue 3 new Decorations onto it. -- It would personalize it and make it our own; my daughter's birthday is coming up and I may do that for her BD. title: Nice, silicone back 'brush' bit too soft. Good handles.
text:
We gave this 3 test uses for an initial assessment of this back scrubber/brush. It is designed nicely, with handles that make usage very user friendly. If they made this out of elastic, you could shower and do resistance band exercises. hehe. Seriously, the handles work well, and act as convenient loops to hang the device to dry out in the shower.
There is an issue with using silicone brush heads, they tend to be soft/flexible. So, if you use this brush, do not expect the same experience as a loofah or bristle brush. And, you have to really work up a lather in your hands and then transfer it to the silicone brush head. Attempts to create foam/lather by rubbing body wash or soap on the silicone just wasn't satisfactory.
As mentioned, the brush surface tends to be soft/gentle. The 'scrubbing' side does rub, but nowhere near deep cleaning or exfoliating level. The bumpy side, for massage, does provide a textured rub, but is even less effective for soaping and cleaning your back.
Maybe I'm too old school, liking my cleaning brush to be able to really scrub.
Attached are photos to show real world images, with a ruler for size reference.
Did not use the included hooks, because we used the shower caddy that already had hooks for shower accessories. The bonus bath sponge looks fine, but did not use that yet. Again, maybe I don't pamper myself enough while showering. haha. If the significant other uses it, any pertinent information will be added to this review. However, I think the majority of people will be concerned about the effectiveness and quality of the back scrubber.
So, the product does match the description and depiction in the product details. However, my opinion is the softness of the brush hinders the effectiveness as a shower back scrubbing device. I do like that it is very resistant to mold and is extremely easy to clean and maintain. Maybe I have to learn to adapt to the softer texture of this type of brush. Based on our experience, this silicone brush garners a 3.5 rating. If you already use and like silicone back scrubbers, this is a quality product worth considering. If you are old school, this might disappoint expectations.

title: It's changed a bit
text: It has been several years since I used up my last Ramy B1*&@#-Slap blush, and with Spring coming on full force (it's in the 80's down here in the tropics, I am not making this up) I found myself craving another B-Slap blush for the Spring and Summer months ahead. So I ordered it, thinking that I already know what the color is like so I didn't need to worry about seeing it in person first before buying it. So when the compact arrived, I was surprised to find that the color had changed a bit. Instead of being a neutral/natural pink, it definitely has become a light, cool-tone pink. Now, this really isn't a problem because it's just the right shade and tone that will work very well on my cool-toned complexion, but it ISN'T the B-Slap blush I remember from 6 or 8 years ago. And I feel a little disappointed. I really liked how that almost-but-not-quite warm/neutral pink looked on my complexion. I will still wear it; it's a lovely pink, but it isn't "the old" B-Slap that I remember. Warm-toned girls who used to like the original blush color will have to look elsewhere for this color because this incarnation will look a little too blue-pink on you.

title: Light moisturizer with a lemon scent
text:
I like supporting small beauty brands because they typically do not test on animals or sell in countries that require animal testing. It's difficult to find independent companies these days. LDR appears to be a new, independent company that sells on Amazon exclusively.

The Biomarine Hydro Boost Moisturizer works for me. It is smooth going on and not too oily. It has a light lemon odor, which dissipates quickly. I normally can't wear anything that is scented, but from what I can tell, the scent is a byproduct of the active ingredients and not something purposely added to the product.

After applying this product, my skin feels smooth and soft. The canister is easy-to-use and not messy. The price point is a bit lower than other, similar formulas. I recommend this product to people with combination type skin. I think it's a little too light for someone with dry skin.

title: Piece of junk
text:
At the risk of sounding like a petulant child, I would like to say: I literally hate this thing.

How are people giving this good reviews?

So I've never used a straightening brush before. I thought I'd dip my toes in with a budget friendly option. I'm sad I wasted even a cent on this item. When I use a flat iron, it smooths my hair. Makes it sleek. Tames the frizz. This straightening brush did none of those things. My thick and coarse hair looked like moderately straighter thick and coarse hair. Straight up (pun intended) it didn't even make my hair all that straight.

I took my time and worked in sections and layers. I went over each section repeatedly. When all was said and done, I spent as much time as I do with a flat iron and still just had to get out my flat iron to make it right. I feel like it needs to get a decent "grip" on the hair, so to speak, in order to do anything, but the hair just slips right through it for the most part.

If anyone knows a straightening brush that actually works, please point me in the right direction. I'd love something that helps cut down my styling time--ya know--the whole reason I thought to try one in the first place.

title: Not bad, but the lighting system needs help
text:
My old eyes are in need of a bit of help at close range for hobby work. I bought one of these about two years ago (for a LOT less money, BTW) and the magnifying lenses do a pretty good job. The class act in these devices use glass lenses, these are plastic, scratch easily, and are of fair optical quality.

My biggest gripe is the lighting system; two old-tech incandescent bulbs which are poorly focused on the work. The light's focus does not coincide with any combination of the lenses. Even worse, the lights are not "aimable." They resolutely point straight ahead, illuminating on either side of where I'm looking, not on the object itself.

If you are serious about close work, spend the extra money and get something with glass lenses (Optivisor comes to mind) and buy a clip on LED light or one of the dedicated light kits.

Dave

Before it was super rough and unruly, and now it feels softer and lays flatter.  I love that the Beard Wash and Beard Rinse are sulfate free, as this is a priority in our household. title: Meh as a primer but great for added hydration for sensitive, dry skin; OK for Normal, NOT FOR OILY
text:
I have sensitive, combination skin. My forehead is dry, my cheeks are normal, and my nose and chin are oily. Talk about a headache... Over the years, I've been searching high and low for a "one size fits all" primer that can smooth out any dry patches, keep my natural oils at bay, and of course, be grippy so that my makeup can actually be long lasting! Unfortunately, I've yet to find one that can cater towards all of my skin's needs...this primer included.
As a primer, the product is honestly so-so. A primer, to me, needs to provide a great base for your makeup but also let your makeup be long lasting. This primer is great for sensitive, dry skin as a BASE. First off, it has the loveliest of scents and a very lightweight texture that seems to make your skin feel very fresh and bouncy. It smooths over dry patches and seems to fill it in to the point that your texture is nice and smooth. On it's own, it provides a beautiful layer of hydration and glow.
Though the hydration is nice for normal skin, I don't find it good as a primer as it can make you feel borderline oily, and that's something that I simply don't like.
For oily skin, BEWARE! This will make you look as if you have spent the day running a marathon as it has the ability to pull out all of your natural oils, even if you do set your makeup with powder!

title: not entirely convinced on how baby safe this is but maybe better for pre teens or adults
text:
I was curious about a perfume for baby because we've been taught not to use anything on the little ones except the gentlest of lotions and body wash. I decided to give this a try because I was curious about the scent and the execution of a product like this.

First thing I did was smell this, and while it is a pleasant smell, this particular scent isn't my favorite. It is too floral for me, almost artificial. I may have liked and felt more comfortable using a citrus and fruity type of scent on my little one. I also looked at the ingredients list and while they may be free of parabens, phthalates, synthetic colors, dyes, GMOs, and Gluten Free, there are some potentially irritating ingredients for the very sensitive of skins. Ingredients like Linalool, Citral, Citranellol, Limonene can be an allergen. It may have prebiotics which is good but one good ingredient does not negate a potentially irritating one. I'm all for someone coming up with a safe and good cologne for baby but I'm not entirely sold on this product just yet. I did read up on some additional information but I need more convincing for me to be on board with this perfume for infants. I do love the story of why the founder wanted to create these scents for little ones but I'm just not fully on board with some of the ingredients used.

I'm not sure I will be using this on my baby but I think a more appropriate age is pre-teen or teens. I may have been a little more open to a "cleaner" perfume for that age range as I'm sure there's a market for that. From what I read, the founder is going to be launching perfumes for that age group, so that might be more appropriate.

My baby actually smells nice from good hygiene so he doesn't need anything else but I understand the concept behind these scents. Fragrances do invoke certain memories, just like music. There are certain scents that I get a whiff of and it immediately transports me back to that day, the person, or the memories of that particular time period. All that said, I will be holding off using perfume on my baby and will be spritzing this stuff on myself. I think the concept is great but I would like to see even "better" and cleaner ingredients if I am to use it on my baby.

I didn't see the ingredients list posted on this Amazon page yet so here it is:
Ingredients:
Alcohol Denat., Aqua (Water), Parfum (Fragrance) Niacinamide, Glycerin, Lactitol, Xylitol, Linalool, Citral, Citranellol, Limonene, Hexyl Cinnamal, Gernaniol, Amyl Cinnamal, Limolene, Hydroxycitronellal.

title: Tricky to assemble and don't work well
text: I have previously purchased a different brand of printable temporary tattoo sheets that worked perfectly. These are not good. That or perhaps the package I was sent were old or not kept well. The instructions say to print the tattoos on the white paper on the glossy side (make sure to reverse your designs - which the packaging neglects to remind you) with an inkjet printer. That part seemed to work fine. Then you have to take the yellow sheets and peel the yellow part off and carefully (this part took 2 people) lay the very sticky adhesive sheet over the printed tattoos while carefully squeegeeing out the air bubbles or being careful not to create them. Even after burnishing down the clear adhesive sheet as much as possible, it did not seem to completely adhere to the ink sheet. After leaving it alone for a day it seemed better but when peeling the clear layer off (to apply the tattoo) it was taking the tattoo right off the backing (the part that is supposed to come off with water). In my experience with the other brand, I was able to use the tattoos as soon as they were assembled! I would really not recommend wasting your money because these do not work very well. And the learning curve for assembling the two sheets will probably cost you one sheet.

text:
I'm very pleased with this face cleaner. It is a medium thick consistency that has a creamy texture. It lathers a bit slowly at first, but builds up a nice, thick lather after a few moments. Not much is needed per use -- just a dab will get the job done. It cleans very well but doesn't leave my face dry. I've had zero irritation from it even though it's a good, deep cleaner.

The scent is very enjoyable. It's a light floral/fruity scent that is unique. It is not overpowering, and doesn't linger after rinsing.

The tube comes nicely packaged for protection during transit. It's in a reinforced box cardboard box that is shrink wrapped. Even if it's sent in a padded envelope there's very little risk of the tube leaking in transit.

No complaints at all. It works very well, has an enjoyable, unique scent, is packaged well, and since so little is needed per use, the value is pretty good. Five stars!

title: Not bad... not the best... decent middle ground pillow
text:
The pillow is ok... nice to lounge on. It is pretty soft. The outer material is also soft to the touch. The pillow retains its shape really well.

I have had this pillow for months now and I sort of like it. I had to stop sleeping on it and go back to the pillow I was trying to replace since this one started giving me really nasty neck pain... but I have neck issues... finding a comfortable pillow is a bit of a challenge for me. I was hoping this one would work for me since I do know other people who use these and love them... nope.

My husband had the second pillow but he, too, switched back to his old pillow because this pillow is too thick for him and he just couldn't get comfortable on it... especially if he was on his stomach or side.

As far as the description goes - this is NOT a "jumbo" pillow. It is a standard size pillow. With a standard amount of filling. The filling does not compress much though... so if you buy it hoping it will get flatter over time, it really hasn't done that for me.... but it is not overstuffed with filling. The description makes this pillow sound HUGE or Cal King size... it is not. Standard regular normal pillow. The dimensions listed are also standard size pillow dimensions and the pillows I got were standard size pillows... so it bothers me that they claim these are "jumbo" in any capacity. Just had to point that out.

I think next time I will try to find a down alternative pillow. This pillow seems to me that it would be great for a guest room... for non-regular use by someone... or a backup pillow... It just didnt work for me to my everyday pillow.

title: Super moisturizing unscented hand cream

As a landscaper, I have a few fingers that remain cracked and peeling for a good portion of the winter, and I've tried a number of different brands of hand cream to fix this. I was really impressed that after only a few days of use, my sides of my fingers of already healed. I didn't expect anything like that, and while I usually prefer to use hand lotions that are scented in some exciting fashion, I am partial to smelling of cupcakes or essential oils, I'm happy to have this simple work horse of a hand cream if it's going to do such a great job.

title: Overall, I did find this product helpful on my trip.
text:
I have a love/hate relationship with this product.

I LOVE that it's travel sized and travel friendly; I brought it with me on my trip to Dallas and it took up like no room in my luggage which was nice since a hair straightener/curler is definitely a must need for me. I love the pretty rose gold color it comes in. I love the packaging, it's super girly.

I HATE the process... for lack of better word. You twist one way (and make sure you click it in place!) for straightener and you twist another way for curler --- this concept I actually love --- but I hate how the middle part you twist to choose which side you want feels like cheap plastic. It took me a few tries to figure it out because I didn't know you had to make sure it clicked into a specific place, I thought you just twisted in that direction. I also don't like how flimsy the barrel itself sort of feels. I don't know if it's because of the material or because of the size but it felt a little flimsy to me.

Overall, I did find this product helpful on my trip. It got the job done of smoothing down my hair or curling it and like I said it's a pretty cute and girly product. I'll definitely still be bringing it along with me on my trips. I sort of just wish that the barrel was a little bit bigger.

When I purchase items from Amazon, which I do buy a lots of items from here, I rely on your reviews. title: Surprisingly Good For A Costume Wig
text:
So I wear and review a lot of wigs and I have started breaking the review down into sections that I think will be helpful.

Color - The color is very similar to the person pictured wearing it in the examples but not the one that is on the mannequin look. This wig is very light silver / grey. It is not that fake, overly shiny texture, and is the same solid color throughout.

Styling- This has an adjustable headband and is fairly easy to fit and style. As it is a costume wig you have to be careful if you are looking to pull it back for anything as the amount of hair in the wig is really designed more for it to be worn as is (which is normal for this kind of price point)

Comfort - This wig is light and comfortable and there is plenty of airflow. This was a little weird around my ears (because my head is a little smaller) but nothing too difficult. This would be suitable to wear all day although I personally wouldn't.

Overall - I really liked it but for what it was - a costume wig. If you are looking for something for a Halloween type look this is perfect.Great for pictures and videos but not one I would probably wear out (other than possibly to a costume party if it completed the look) just because I have others that look way more realistic.

title: SO Many Uses For Both Oils! I LOVE Them!
text:
I am finding SO many uses for Shiny Leaf's coconut and sweet almond oil! I do have some experience with coconut oil but this is my first time using sweet almond oil. Thanks the labels on the bottles, reviews and internet searches, I'm finding SO many ways to use these oils...sometimes together, sometimes individually.

Because I have terribly dry, sensitive skin, my main goal was to see how one or both oils could help protect my skin, especially now that winter has arrived and my skin is REALLY taking a beating. Both oils work well to hydrate and moisturize, so I mixed a few ounces of each in a mist bottle. After I bathe, I mist a combo of the oils over my skin to help hydrate and moisturize. The oils absorb quickly and do not leave an oily/greasy look OR feel to my skin. I'm already seeing a decrease in my dry skin/itchy red patches of skin. I experience NO discomfort whatsoever when misting these oils onto my sensitive skin. Both oils also work wonders on hair by moisturizing, hydrating, improving hair texture/strength, stimulate hair growth /thicken hair, and nourish the scalp to prevent dry, itchy flakes. In addition to using my combo of oils after bathing, I also give my hair a spray or two with the mister and sure enough, I'm seeing less hair in the drain and on my hairbrush after brushing. My hair is soft, smooth and shiny WITHOUT looking or feeling oily/greasy from the oil combo.

I use the coconut oil (alone) to help remove makeup, under and around my eyes to soften and reduce fine lines, I rub a small amount into my scalp (as does my husband) to help stimulate hair growth, on the kid's faces after their baths to soften (especially in cold weather!), on my nail beds every couple of days and a light amount on any patches of eczema/red skin. (It relieves the itching/burning and redness from eczema quickly!)

I use the sweet almond oil (alone) on dark circles under my eyes, a SMALL amount on split ends in my hair, a drop on chapped lips, I'm just starting to tinker with it for aromatherapy purposes. I recently learned that it can help fade scars so I've begun to rub some sweet almond oil into a scar on my finger to see what happens. If it helps, I'll then move on to a small facial scar I have. I'm also trying something on my own; just started doing this a few days ago. I get nosebleeds every single day, at least once a day, throughout the winter when the heat is on in the house. This started when I was 2 years old, I'm now 49 so I've experienced this my entire life. I now rub a small amount of sweet almond oil under my nostrils before bed. Since starting this, I continue to have nosebleeds. Yesterday, I had only one and it involved just a few drops of blood. I didn't whip through numerous tissues like normal. ONE tissue took care of it. (that's huge for me!) I have NO clue if its just a coincidence or if the sweet almond oil is helping in any way but I'm going to continue using it.

These oils are phenomenal! Both bottles are 16oz. I love the fact that they have normal caps on them but pumps for each bottle are included as well. The liquid of each is thinner oil than I expected, which I prefer. Both absorb quickly. Neither has a scent. I've found SO many uses for these oils, I can't wait to discover more. ( I'm SO happy with these oils, I recently purchased Shiny Leaf's biotin hair conditioner and cannot wait to try it! ) I find the price to be incredibly reasonable, especially since you're getting TWO bottles of oils! HIGHLY recommended!

*FYI...the mist bottle on the end in my photo is NOT included! I used one of my own mist bottles to combine both oils. You will get both bottles AND pumps that you see in my photo, NOT the mist sprayer!

title: Good...IF
text:
This is a potentially excellent product--IF you don't need it to be completely stable. It wiggles some, though if you put your weight directly over the leg and push straight up, it's fine. Just don't expect it to be rock solid. I have a regular grab bar on the right side and use the left support rail only--and that's fine because the two rails are not directly connected so you can use one rail or both. But as a big guy (230 lbs), I'd be nervous if I didn't have the grab bar even though it's rated for 300 lbs. it would be perfect for a smaller person who just needs a boost, but it could be potentially dangerous if a larger person with serious balance problems fell sideways.

Note, too, that this will NOT work with a 1-piece toilet that curves upward from seat to tank. The connector piece needs about 2 inches of flat space behind the seat.

Pros: Sturdy aluminum tube construction; designed to bear weight directly over the support; easy to put together with a screwdriver and maybe a pliers (depending on your toilet seat hardware); adjustable for height and width.

Cons: Works only with a traditional toilet; "wiggles" to the left and right; adjusting width and height might be difficult or impossible for a person with poor hand strength (the spring loaded buttons are stiff); made in China (but what isn't these days).

title: Fun and easy, quick nails.
text:
I did my own acrylic nails for years. A few years ago I just got tired of the maintenance and let them go. It took over a year for my nails to grow out from the damage; they were so trashed.

Recently I had started doing poly gel nails but truthfully, they are a pain. They're are pain to get on, and they're a pain to get off, although they look great and last forever when you get them (when you get them right).

I saw these and had flashbacks to the '70s press on nails. They were ghastly. And they flew off at the worst possible times. But I figured what the heck.... as cheap as these are, why not?

Again, I'm trying to let my nails heal, so I used the tabs and not the glue. I love these tabs. Super easy. Super sticky. And the one that I didn't get on right just rolled off super easy.

The glue tabs included were a little narrow for my nail beds so there's a little color variation by the cuticle where there isn't any glue. But I also ordered some other tabs that were a little more substantial and I will use those next time.

Within taking these out of the package I literally had a full set of nails in probably 8 minutes. And they don't look half bad, considering I didn't file them to make them the perfect size etc.

I accidentally ordered the short which are way too short for me normally but, I'll wear these until they come off because they look cute. Even short they look better than my trashed/split/broken nails. I will update when they start popping off.

title: Purchased this item in Marshall's for $6.99
text: So as I have stated in previous skin care  product reviews, I am EXTREMELY vain. That is probably due to the fact that I suffer with Adult Acne. Never had acne until I reached my mid 20's. So as a fair skin woman in her mid 30's my focus is to lessen the severity of my outbreaks, and to keep my skin looking youthful and CLEAR! Like other women in my predicament I have spend loads of money on what seems like millions of products sometimes they work, then after a couple of months they cease to have any effect. So besides incorporating multivitamins into my life (B complex, Flaxseed oil, MSM, DMAE, etc) which I take pretty consistently, I drink plenty of water or as much as I can take, eat fairly healthy (no soda, no juice, no candy, no chips, little to no fast food) and of course I exercise. All these things will play into how healthy your skin will and can be! So on a recent trip to South Carolina, I ran into a Marshall's and I always check out the skincare section. Now within the last couple of months my skin will begin to clear up completely then BAM I will get a medium red nodule, or inflamed whitehead.... UGH! And though you are not suppose too I always pop mine to relieve the pain and pressure. I always do it with clean hands, and typical wash my face with my 10% sulfur soap I purchased here on Amazon. So when I ran into this Brightening product for $6.99 it caught my eye. With all the sulfur and scrubs and acne drying products my skin was looking pretty dull and kinda flaky. I needed something to help diminish my acne scars, moisturize and smooth out my skin... and the fact that this product claimed to help with anti aging was the icing on the cake... so I took it home and gave it a whirl.... its been about 2 1/2 weeks I have used this product 2x a day each day as it is not heavy and provides the extra moisture I need. I have noticed significant difference in the color and size of my scars. my skin feels smooth and soft. I feel good about this product sofar I have had no adverse reactions to this serum. With any product it takes a keen eye and diligence to becoming successful in your skincare goals. I will see how I feel about this product once I finish the bottle. If this product continues to show me positive gradual results I might purchase another product as this is cheap and effective. As we head into a new year I am looking to go more organic in my skincare products and spend alil less than I have this year and previous years.

text:

A couple of things to note – – you have to hold the power button for three seconds to turn it on, and you will immediately see the temperature light up on the back of the brush. You can change centigrade to Fahrenheit temperature by holding down the plus and minus signs buttons at the same time. I was pleased with how quickly the brush heated up.
My hair is not really long yet, but it gets little squiggles right in the ends, Which this brush does help to smooth out. All in all, I think I will be very happy with this brush, Especially as my hair gets longer.

title: Another good sponge from Real Techniques (I like their others equally well.)
text:
I like this, but I don't love it. It works well, but I don't think it really stands out as a revolutionary shape or as a favorite among my sponge collection.

The feature of this sponge that I like best and used the most is the pointed tip (which has more point that is currently pictured). The point is excellent at getting into little creviced on the face.

The other sides a re a little gimmicky but usable (although I never use the smaller rectangular facets for anything!). Overall I think I prefer using their brushes with rounded sides, and I think their shape feels more natural in the hand as well. Still, I have no complaints about this one, and I really like the texture of it. The pleasant point to this one probably renders this a tie. Basically, I think you need a Real Techniques Face Sponge, but I don't think it matters which one; since the other is cheaper, I would probably go with it.

It is a very soft sponge, pleasant feeling on the skin, and it seems made from quality material. It washes clean and dries well.

title: Closes firmly, somewhat squeezable, tall and narrow
text:
This set of bottles come in a six-pack with blue, green, purple, pink, and two clear. They're fairly standard plastic travel-bottles; they squeeze but they're just a little bit thin and brittle in your fingers. If you want something that will stand up to serious compression, you'll have to look at the more expensive bottles with a more rubberized texture.

The pull spout is a good one; there's a ridge inside that holds it closed, and it takes some significant effort to pull it open. This could actually be a drawback for someone without a strong grip, but it does ensure the bottle won't leak easily and I like the feature. It will wear down over time, but I expect it to last a few years at least which is about as much as you can ask for this price, and the whole lit screws off for refilling and cleaning.

I would have given these five stars, except that the current image is not very accurate. The bottles are taller than it looks in the picture. That was fine for me, since the tall narrow shape fits perfectly with the rest of my travel bottles, but other buyers should be aware that these are about five inches tall.

title: Incredible sheet mask that makes your face really happy
text:
This is a very nice sheet face mask. It is very easy to use, basically a sheet mask that you put over your face. I like the fact that it comes in two pieces so you really can make it fit perfectly to your face. The one pieces are just one fits all kind of masks and lets face it, not all faces are the same scie or shape and therefore they just don't all fit. With this one you have a lot of nice wriggle room which is great.

It is very easy to put on. Once it is on you let it sit for about 15 to 20 minutes (btw, if you go longer you get more of the goodies). So just have a good show on tv or a book handy to read. I did notice that it is fairly heavy though but it amazingly did not slip on me but I was afraid that it may.

This mask smells beautifully of roses and for once not overpowering of it. I am not the biggest fan of the smell of roses but this one was pleasant since it was not this cloying smell of it. This is a collagen mask and when you remove it you can tell how soft your face is. I really liked this mask but it is on the more expensive side. You get 4 masks in the box for $25, so each is about $6, so that is a bit on the higher end of sheet masks but they are very nice.

title: Vitamin C serum with some positive results
text:
I normally stick to one brand for my skin care routine. But, I have wanted to try a Vitamin C serum, (without sticker shock of my normal brand).
—I’m using this product for middle age skin- collagen loss, wrinkles and uneven skin (rough patches).
—My skin facial skin is dry. Very little oil production.
—I’m new to Vitamin C serums. I began using this product daily. It dried out/irritated my skin. I cut back to 2-3x/week (after a skin a little break). The dryness and irritation went away.
—For those accustomed to Vitamin C serums- this might not be an issue.
—I also followed the recommendations to refrigerate after opening to prolong longevity (Vitamin C is very unstable in liquid form)
—I’m into Naturopathy and clean skin scare products. There were no questionable ingredients on the box label (via EWG SkinDeep website).
—I’ve researched different forms of Vitamin C: serums and powders with and without feurlic acid to understand what to look for in a Vitamin C serum.
Pro’s
EWG SkinDeep database check came back Good. (ingredient list label is difficult to read. One ingredient wasn’t recognized in EWG)
Dark glass bottle with screw on lid. Comes with dropper that also screws onto bottle.
Clear and semi-watery serum (Vitamin C serum should be clear, not yellow, brown or cloudy). No oiliness....very liquidity.
Ample size- 1.01 fluid ounces
Easy to apply- 2-3 drops is sufficient
Sinks into skin quickly
Improvement of rough patches (face feels smoother)- thinking of trying this on back of hands.
Works with my current skincare products (facial wash, toner, facial oil, mask 2x/week)
Solution has not turned brown or discolored (kept refrigeration)
My skin feels tighter (firmness)

Cons:
A slight odor, I can’t place
Not a significant difference in wrinkle improvement (50- beginning of smile lines, chin and forehead wrinkles).
No feurlic acid (this has been shown to work synergistically with Vitamin C)
Lasts 3 months and needs refrigeration (expiration date is on box)...since very little is needed and use is 2-3x/week- I expect it will expire before all product is used. Would love to see this in powder form for longevity.

Conclusion: A lot of thought was put into formulating and, bottling this product. If opting for “serum” over “powdered” Vitamin C- this is a good option. I’m always hesitant to try products that are not EWG Verified. But, the ingredients listed, received a good score on EWG SkinDeep Database. It just takes a little more time to to investigate each ingredient.

title: My skin feels good - not greasy. It's easy to dispense from the bottle. And 2 compliments from friends after using it for 1 week
text:
I bought this to begin (and win!) the fight against the wrinkles that are appearing around my eyes (crow's feet). I guess the best solution is not to laugh, but then what fun would life be...

What is Hyaluronic acid? According to WebMD, "Hyaluronic acid works by acting as a cushion and lubricant in the joints and other tissues. In addition, it might affect the way the body responds to injury."

(+) Does it work? I've used the Hyaluronic serum every night for a week now. Not sure if I can say 100% that I have noticed no fine lines around my eyes, but I've had 2 friends remark that my skin is looking great. As we women know, that's a good endorsement right there.

(+) Texture: As you can see in the photo, the Derma-nu serum is a clear, slightly viscous consistency that goes on clear. You can feel it on your skin for quite a few minutes afterwards. It does NOT leave your skin feeling greasy (big pet peeve of mine) when you wake up in the morning.

(+) Smell: This is not a scented beauty product. There is a very slight almost medicinal scent - that's the best way to describe it. It is not unpleasant, it is extremely mild, but it smells like it has some ingredients that 'have a purpose', vs. beauty products that have fragrances added.

(+) Packaging and ease of use: The pump is well made - it dispenses a small amount of serum, which I am finding is enough for applying to the corners of both eyes. I'm having to "prime" the pump about 2-3 times before it dispenses the serum, so be careful, you don't want to double pump the serum unless you are OK putting possibly 2x the amount on your face than you might have intended.

(+) A little goes a long way. I travel a lot, so the compact bottle and efficient dispensing from the pump are bonuses for me.

(/) Organic. The bottle indicates that 72% of the ingredients are organic. It doesn't clarify which of the ingredients are/are not organic. It would be nice to see this get to 100%.

Bottom line: So far, my skin has felt good, I've had a few compliments, and I'm pleased with the way Derma-nu packaged the Hyaluronic serum so that it is easy to dispense.

*I received the serum for evaluation and review

title: Twice As Much of A Waste As One Bottle!
text:
The current version of Tsar is a pitiful, inert, dullard of a fragrance that smells markedly like Old Spice. No need for anyone save masochists to stockpile!

Per other reviewers considering vintage bottles, this fragrance used to be an interesting powerhouse. Unfortunately, as IFRA (regulatory agency) restrictions on perfume content and overall manufacturing costs have increased, many manufacturers have simply stopped trying to inventively reformulate older fragrances, so what the buyer ends up with is the modern version of Tsar: a weak not especially complex or interesting scent with minimal projection and average longevity. When applied, I get a burst of alcohol and green, and then in about 10 minutes, some hint of pine, amber, and florals (carnation, geranium, lily of the valley maybe?). I smell no leather, no oak moss, no vetiver, no tonka beans, and only the slightest hint of patchouli. This becomes a skin scent really quickly, i.e. no projection, but it does last for about 6-8 hrs as a skin scent. This long duration is really the only major advantage Tsar has over Old Spice, which sells for half the price and smells oddly similar!

On Fragrantica.com, there are like 27 different scent ingredients listed for Tsar (or at least claimed for Tsar by its manufacturer), which is simply absurd. VC&A are either having some fun with us, citing historical formulas that are 10 years put of date, or have succeeded in generating the blandest possible result from the most ornately Byzantine of recipes. In comparison, Terre D'Hermes, with a mere 8 ingredients cited on the same site, smells like it is several magnitudes of complexity higher, a symphony compared to Tsar's hummed nursery rhyme.

Frankly, I think most buyers should spend their dollars elsewhere. Many of the old vintage powerhouses have not been reformulated into the same decreptitude that Tsar has; Azzarro Pour Homme, Lapidus, Aramis, Havana, Tuscany, Yatagan: all still around, all smell great, though maybe not quite as good as they used to. Even Grey Flannel, which is currently much cheaper than Tsar, smells much better and still has some of its cojones attached. So if you want to see what the 80s (or earlier!) smelled like, you have a lot of options. Tsar certainly won't appeal to most young modern male fragrance buyers who love calone, seaweed, and apple. And if your tastes are for more refined "older" stuff, the dull ghostwater found in bottles of Tsar holds little appeal at the current price point. Get Azzarro PH or Lapidus for less money and have more fun!

On the plus side, Tsar is certainly workplace friendly, as no one will smell it on you unless you are giving them a piggyback ride or are lying on top of them, both of which circumstances are uncommon enough in the workplace so as to preclude their likelihood of occurrence.

Other exhibits in the realm of the Former Powerhouse Roll of Dishonor are worse than Tsar: the current Halston Z14, Ungaro III, and Paco Rabanne all have been even more neglected / manhandled into smelling weak / unpleasant/ or both. And even weak Tsar smells better than many modern fragrances, alas, but that's beyond the point. Bottom line: unless this falls in price to the level of Nausea Voyage, there are many better options for less money.

title: Yes, these really work...but keep a few things in mind
text:
After very minimal and barely noticeable success with whitening toothpastes and gels, I finally decided to give Crest Premium Whitestrips a try. Previously, I had found the cost to be prohibitive, but the fact that $5 or $7 coupons are offered in our Sunday paper with some regularity made the price a bit easier to swallow.

Just like the commercials say, I definitely did begin to see some improvement after about three days. I would describe the effect as more of a lightening than a whitening per se: the darker yellow spots on my teeth began to fade and to become less apparent. Now, after using the product as prescribed for a week, the color of my teeth is clearly improved; I wouldn't say that my teeth are bright white, but they are definitely more of an ivory or a paler yellow color. According to the package insert, you can immediately begin a second course of treatment for even better whitening effects, but I haven't yet decided if I want to lay out another $30 in order to do this. Also, I should mention that the effect is not so dramatic thta anyone has noticed (UNLIKE in the commercials!).

Now for the caveats. First of all, I found these strips to be a bit difficult to use. It can be hard to remove the strips from the protective backing without them becoming mangled, and it is very easy to get the gel on your fingertips (which causes a temporary whitening effect). Also, the strips are not ideally shaped for your mouth, and I found that they covered my front eight teeth only. Finally, while the top strip adhered fairly well, I found that the bottom strip was more tricky and tended to slide around, especially if I moved my mouth at all. The only solution I found to this was to wear the strips while commuting to work, which luckily gave me a 30-minute period when I did not need to talk. Otherwise, it can be difficult to find a good time to wear the strips, as the insert information advises against wearing them immediately after you brush your teeth, while sleeping, and while you are eating/drinking.

Unlike other reviewers, I did not have a problem with the taste of the strips: I could not detect anything while wearing them, and after taking them off, I thought that the gooey paste left behind was virtually tasteless. I did experience some sensitivity in a lower tooth which I had capped over 20 years ago. Although this sensation went away in time, it was uncomforable enough to make me cut the lower strip to fit around this particular tooth.

In summary, I did see clear--although not miraculous--results from this product and I would be willing to try the strips again, especially if the price were to come down a bit. Ultimately, I would rate Crest Whitestrips three and a half stars, as there is definitely room for improvement.

title: Some good points, some not so good.
text: I'm not sure what to think of this. Overall, the necklace looks pretty much like the one in the picture, but there are some differences as well as some non-cosmetic issues. In the main picture for the product, you see light green and wine-red beads alternating along with a whitish crystal flower with a wine-red center. What I got was darker green and very dark red (not very translucent) alternating beads along with a crystal flower. The center bead is dark red and not the wine-red you see in the main picture. That may not sound so bad, and up to a point, it's fine -- the dark green is nice. But the crystal flower is kind of a sickly color. It has a metal finding in back of it that turns the crystal's color into something that looks just... off. Plus, there's a part of the cord that is knotted in back of the crystal and that sticks out, so that could poke into your chest. The cord looks like it does in the picture, but the portion that goes around your neck, where you're supposed to be able to pull the sides of the cord to make the necklace tighter, is so tight that it's hard to get the cords to move. One bonus, though, is that both the crystal flower and its center rotate, so if you need something that you can spin and fidget with, this would be perfect. Overall, though, I think I'll see if I can replace the cord and do something about that sickly color from the metal showing through the crystal. Shipping was very fast.

title: Takes some practice to get right
text:
I've seen these type of curlers around for a while now and had been curious to try them out. However, upon opening them, I was disappointed by the size. If you have long hair and a lot of it, one pack will definitely not be enough, as is the case for me.
I was confused as to how to put them on. However, luckily for me, my sister knew how to do it since she had seen someone else try out this same style of curlers, but from another brand. Since she knew how to apply them, I told her to try them out for me and let me know, because I knew I'd end up frustrated.
Here's her take on them: They are tricky to apply at first and it takes a while to apply them, so make sure you have something else to keep you busy while you do this. However, once you know what you are doing, they're no longer tricky, but they are still time consuming. It takes time to section out the hair, put the curler in, roll it up, and repeat. Also, it is best if you do this at night if you are someone who has a sensitive head and is prone to headaches from wearing certain hairstyles. I put these on at around 3 p.m. and wore them for the rest of the day. After applying them, I was lounging around and watching a movie. Since I was laying down, I didn't notice any discomfort. However, once I was sitting up, it wasn't long before I felt a tension headache coming on. So, I would say that these are not good for someone who is sensitive to pressure from hairstyles. They don't look heavy, but there is a certain weight to having your hair "pulled" into the curler which can cause discomfort. I decided to sleep with them on, and was able to sleep just fine, since I didn't have any of the curlers directly on the back of my head. Upon taking them out, I had some nice curls, but I also had some wonky ones. I don't know the exact cause of that (rolled wrong, hair not pulled in correctly, moved during sleep, etc). However, I still liked the results and the curls held up for me, despite not having using any curling cream, gel, or anything.
All in all, they're a good product to try out and they allow you to get some curls without heat styling, but they can be tricky to use.

title: Performs like "ToothSoap" but just too expensive.
text:
I would like to get behind this product, but I just can't. I've been using "ToothSoap" brand for about 10 years so I thought I'd give this new one a try.

First of all, you only get 0.3 ounces of product (Tooth Saviour) so it just not a good value. They claim there are 70 shreds, enough to brush twice a day for two months.

OK, well, I counted them, the 70 shreds claim is accurate. But the problem is, in REALITY, it DOES take about THREE shreds to effectively brush with these. MAYBE if you get two get quality shreds, you could use two, maybe. The picture of the shred posted here is very deceptive inmy opinion, the shreds, are very small, soft, and most are broken into tiny pieces. In any case, there is simply no way you are going to brush your teeth 120 times with 70 shreds, its just not going to happen, even if one shred would allow you to brush your teeth EFFECTIVELY (which it doesn't). In comparison "ToothSoap" shreds are longer and the "soap up" better than these. I use two "ToothSoap" shreds because I like to be sure, but if I had to I could use one, as long as a started out with some water in my mouth.

You get 4 ounces of "ToothSoap" brand for $20-$30 if you order from Amazon. (And I never order from Amazon, I signed up to the mailing list at the "ToothSoap" website and I always wait for them to offer me the buy one get one free deal, which they always do about every 6 months or so.

Even IF I were paying the Amazon price, this stuff is at least three times more expensve than "ToothSoap" brand. Yeah, it cleans as good, but its just not justifiable cost wise.

title: Soft & smooth, lightweight matte lip cream that doesn't dry out the lips 💋
text:
PeriPera is kinda known for having amazing lip tints & stains. When I saw that they were offering lipstick bullets now, I thought these would have that same effect. I was mistaken. This is a soft textured matte lip cream developed to attain the look of blurred lips, a popular Korean beauty trend. What exactly does "blurred lips" translate to in the West? It means skip the harsh lip liner & soften the edges of your lip borders. The goal is to achieve a gradual gradient of color.

I got shade n°8 "City Pop Chili", which I would describe as a burnt brick red color. It feels very Autumnal and will be best complemented by those with warm skintones.

The texture of the lip cream itself is soft & smooth, sorta like a mousse. It's very lightweight, easy to blend, and feels comfortable on the lips. It has a matte finish, with just the right amount of moisturizing properties to keep it from completely drying out my lips.

I found that it's best to apply this product straight from the tube. I tried to build up opacity by using a lip brush to apply it, but every time I'd swipe the brush across my lips, it would actually remove product and leave bald spots. The formula isn't as long wearing as I was expecting from a matte lipstick, either. After a couple hours of eating, drinking, and expressive mouth movements, the color wears off entirely and I have to reapply. I really wish this wore down to a stain, but that's not what PeriPera was going for.

The frosted, translucent pink lipstick component used for this line of lippies is understated, but pretty. It looks very feminine. The actual lipstick bullet has a slim silhouette and an angled tip. You get exactly one inch of visible product inside the tube. This formula is free of fragrance. There is no scent at all that I can detect.

Expiration date printed on my product packaging is Aug. 2024
(2 years & 10 months from when I purchased it in Oct. 2021)

text:
I have used this before! I had used several GoMay products about a two years ago. I have liked them all, and there are some products that I have repurchased (love their aminos face wash). I remember really liking this night cream, and so when it came up as an option to try, I thought maybe it was another version, but no it is the same. I think the change has been in the company. They were entirely a Chinese brand, and now I see USA labeling- but I think it is still a Chinese beauty product. Same stuff that I know and love. Same press down dispenser container. I am copying over my old review as the info is all the same, and my experience is the same. While I dont rate on price, I am pleased at its effectiveness and how it is half the price of similar items I have used.

Safe, effective moisturizing product with promising ingredients. I am used to using several of these ingredients, and I must stress that it is important to use SPF when using anything with retinol. I saw that this has quite a list of ingredients that I am not totally familiar with, so I went through each one and looked them up. I included a short description of each (and included EWG rating for those that like that sort of information). You will note that most all have a very GOOD rating of 1 or 2. The only ingredient that has a higher number (bad) is for the retinol- and that is because of the degree to which retinol/vitamin A, by nature can absorb into the skin (toxicity) and how our skin is more sensitive to UV rays. So again, wear your SPF when using any retinol based products.

--GoMay is a Chinese (turned USA) beauty company and from everything I have used, the products have been impressive in formulation and the thought and safety put into creating it.

--Awesome, attractive container. Has a press down lid that pops out some product. Keeps it clean and safe! BUT if you want to get into the container, the lid does come off.

--Minimal scent- naturally occurring. Can't quite put my finger on the aroma. It dissipates quickly, and it is really faint. Like green tea and plain yogurt.

--The cream absorbs quickly. It just soaks right into my skin. I have skin that leans dry, and I do follow up with either a hydrating sunscreen, or if used at night I add a thicker emollient. Your experience may vary.

3% active retinol-- age eraser, give it time (at least 3-4  months of consistent use)
2% hyaluronic acid-- excellent humectant
Vitamin C, Vitamin E--antioxidants, skin brightener

title: Very easy way to add volume and bold color
text:
Very Juicy and very easy to create thick beautiful brows. I eyebrows with a nice shape but they are very thin from years of plucking, and very light from sun exposure and my natural coloring. So I am always paying to have them dyed and even that only helps darken them a little, it does not bring up the fullness. This product adds both color and fullness, it goes on with only one or two bold juicy strokes. These must be properly placed, it takes a couple tries to get the right angle. I found that the first stroke should be the very outside third of my brow, where I need the most volume. Next I do one more half brush on the middle of my brow and it is done. Once it dries, I have thick, dark and dramatic brows.
This product create volume once it dries, so if you get it on properly, you end up with more eyebrow. It can be tricky and the first couple applications were messy for me, because I had never worked with such a juicy product. The dry time is slow, not the kind of thing you can do just before you run out the door.
Using this brow gel eliminates the need for me to get my brows dyed at the salon, so I am very happy with it. It is very solid and does not smudge or run. It washes off with cleanser and I recommend it for anyone who wants more volume.
