The original Guerisson 9 Complex costs truly fraction of high-end department store brands but the packaging belies this. Its glass jar, embossed metal lid, applicator, and elaborate round box in Hermes orange gives the appearance of a much more expensive product. And the cream fulfills that promise.

The new Guerisson Delight cream comes in an atteactive plastic jar in a thin cardboard box, more reminiscent of the better drug store brands. (I've included a picture of both.) However, the high quality of the product is the same.

This is a rich but substantially lighter version of the original, perfect for the summer months. Very lightly scented, this new contains the botanicals and hydrating ingredients of the 9 Complex, including the controversial one that earned it the amusing nickname "creme de la mare."

In this case, dont pre-judge the treatment by the jar. Great results this far; will update the review as needed.

title: Try this trick to easily use this great floss.
text: Have trouble holding this great floss? Try this: cut a piece about 14 inches long. Double it over then tie a simple overhand knot four to five inches down to form a loop slightly wider than your hand. Gently try to floss a tooth. Adjust the knot to an ideal size for you. The magic is that the knot is easily moved by separately pulling the ends. Once it's optimal tie a second knot and tease it until it sits on the first knot. They will now be locked into position. You can apply loads of force without deforming your loop.

title: Underwhelmed - didn't work for me
text:
I have tried a few products by this line by Laloirelle. This Luminous Face oil comes in a dark glass dropper bottle like a lot of facial oils do. It is not cheap at almost $100 to be honest. When you use this you will need about a drop for each side of your face, so a little does go a long way, but this is still not an inexpensive product so handle this as such.

This particular one is filled with pomegranate oil, cacao oil infused with white peony root, marigold flower and lotus leaf. This particular blend is supposed to be brightening, soothing, regenerating, purifying and reduce the appearance of dullness. When you use this you will notice this oil definitely has a fragrance to it that is reminiscent of an essential oil. They recommend to use it morning and night, however in my experience when you use this it does absorb fairly quickly. It does leave an oily residue on your skin though. If you wear makeup and especially right now with wearing masks, I would not recommend applying this facial oil in the morning. For a makeup application that could cause trouble and I found with facial oils I sweat heavily when wearing masks.

It provided some moisture but I didn’t really see a brightening effect to be honest, however I did feel that my skin felt oily which is why I prefer using this in the evening. In the morning my skin felt nicely moisturized. Is this really worth the price? In my eyes not really since I have other brighteners that do the same thing and cost a fraction of this oil while not making my face greasy.

title: Nice Shave...but beter than a razor?
text:
At various times in my life I have rotated between using a razor vs a cordless shaver. While I prefer the closeness of a razor a cordless shaver does save time and money. The Arcitec 1090 is Norelco's high-end cordless shaver that has oodles of features.

Likes-

- Time display showing remaining battery life.
- Ease of cleaning the heads after use
- Suction cups on the base to hold the unit firm to counter-top
- Nick-free shaving
- The charging pod makes an ideal traveling case

Needed Improvements and/or dislikes-
- Not the closest shave - after shaving my face feels similar to what it is like 12 hours after using a razor
- Not sure why there is such a large cost difference between the Arctitec 1090 and the 1050. The 1090 has a time display and the charging pod, but I have hard time seeing that as to justifying the cost difference.
- Not sure if this product is actually an upgrade from the older "Lift-and-Cut" technology they previously advertised. My impression is that the new shave is about a wash with the old one.

Final Summary- While I enjoy the ease and comfort of the Norelco Arcitec 1090 I am not sure if the added features make it worth the additional cost over the 1050 - and thus costing it one star. However, as a whole I have no problems giving the product a hearty endorsement!

text: These all look the same when they’re listed, so I just went with this one as it was the cheapest. Bad move? Maybe. There were seams of jagged plastic that my hair got tangled in. The “hands” didn’t line up perfectly, so there were weird gaps in the holes where the air came out, which my hair got stuck in and ended up losing a few strands. I then got my nail file and used the coarse grit side that I never use on my nails to “sand down” the rough edges from the seam, and around the holes. I had to keep sanding because I’d test it, feel the area that snags, and then file again. By the time I finished, the whole thing was sanded down and looking awful. Can’t return it now! I used it once it wasn’t snagging all my hair and breaking it off, and it did work. Heat was coming out of the “tips of the fingers” and my roots were dried, and the rest of my hair could air dry in all its undisturbed curl pattern glory. But it was still kind of snaggy and I was just so over sanding this thing as it took way longer than it should have, which honestly, it should have not had to be done at all! If I had to do it all over again, it’d just buy the bright green name brand one that was double (maybe more?) the cost of this, and not waste time screwing around with sanding this thing.

title: Not for humid or hot climates - bar will not survive it.
text:
I love many of their other products, and the scent was within my favourite 'scent-zone', so I bought it.
It's not an antiperspirant, and it seemed fine for regular days. Hard labour in the garden days...not at all. Which is fine. since that's not what it's promising. But the bar itself is so temperature/moisture sensitive that unless you live in a cool, very dry climate, this will just puddle itself out of existence before your eyes.

Mine is kept in an air-conditioned room...probably around 73 degrees and around 50% humidity. It's not in the sun. Today, the bar was sweating...the individual water droplets on it were 2-3 mm in diameter.

Tomorrow I get a sealed container and try keeping it in the fridge. Maybe that works. But for now, factor this into your purchasing considerations.

title: Whats the deal with the hype of this? AVOID!

First impressions:

I also noticed this product had a very astringent smell -- similar to alcohol.

Usage:

I assumed it was due to a niacin conversion on my skin, but after a couple weeks, I started breaking out more than ever. I noticed that my skin was completely sensitive, red, and everything would sting my face. I did not think it was this product at first, but after i stopped using this product completely, the redness and sensitivity stopped.

Conclusion:
Do not buy this product. In my case, this product made my skin worse than it has ever been along with being super crazy sensitive. I do not recommend this to anyone, but perhaps I received a bad batch? The lot/manufacturing stamp on the product is "8LB" if anyone with the same lot/manufacturing stamp is having a similar issue...
However, if you are looking for a niacinamide+zinc formula, I would recommend Revolution Skincare Niacinamide+Zinc from Ulta instead. I have now been using that for about 3 weeks without any of the same issues from the Ordinary.

title: hydrating gentle creamy foam, cleanses & rinses well, includes EGF for skin repair
text:
Easydew is skin care that is functional, effective, and always seems to live up to the expectations. I happen to like EGF (epidemal growth factors), and if you don't then just don't purchase Easydew DW-EGF products. I recommend doing a quick search to learn more about "EGF in skin care". I've been a fan for awhile now, so I was stoked to try this face wash. I use other Easydew products with success.

My 40 something dry skin benefits from the gentle, hydrating cleansing. It has some creamy lather, kinda foamy, feels nice to massage in, and rinses clean. Skin feels good. Not taut.

Dont need much. First couple of times I squeezed out what I was used to using with some other cleansers. This is thick, and once you add in a little warm water it takes off with lather. If you end up not loving it for your face, it would make for a fabulous shaving cream and/or body wash. This tube will last a long while no matter what you use it for.

I use a two step cleansing process most nights of the week. So that means starting off with an oil cleanser to help dissolve stubborn grime and products (primarily my SPF, but make up too), then using a gentle water based cleanser to actually wash away was was broken up and left behind. Some nights I can get away with just a water based cleanser. Mornings I use just water based cleansers. So really I can use this any time.

title: Consistency is an issue, but when it works, it is fantastic
text:
I am always looking for new primers to use with my foundation and concealer, especially in the summer when my makeup seems to disappear after walking outside. I had not heard of this one and there weren't any reviews, so I thought I would give it a try.

~•~•*PROS*•~•~
1) No fragrance or perfume added to irritate your skin or sinuses
2) Sheer, lightweight formula goes on clear and seems to 'blur' or soften uneven texture of the skin (just like the filter on your camera)
3) Long-lasting...I put this on at 7am and it kept my makeup in place until I took it off that evening at 8pm

~•~•*CONS*•~•~
1) Consistency in this formula needs to be adjusted...from the beginning mine was clumpy and I could actually feels little balls or clumps of something in the first few pumps...some was dried completely and unusable (not sure if mine was just an older bottle or maybe the product had been on the shelf too long? Or it got too hot or cold during shipping?)
2) Wasted a lot of product trying to get the first pumps of what could actually be used
3) The pump on my bottle does not work every time, maybe a squeezable tube would be better to get a consistent amount of primer each
4) Does not shrink pores, clear skin, moisturize...this is definitely just a one purpose primer...not necessarily a 'con' or a negative, I'm just used to using multi purpose primers
5) Consistency of this product is definitely lacking and needs some work or the addition of something to keep it from clumping
Overall, this is a decent primer and does what it is supposed to when using under makeup or alone. However, there are definitely some glitches with the formula and delivery system. It needs a little tweaking. It is entirely possible I received a bottle that was old or exposed to too high or too low temperatures for too long of a time period and this caused the issues with my bottle of primer. If not, maybe the addition of another ingredient to keep the primer smooth so it applies evenly and does not clump so easily. I will continue to try to use primer and see if it was just the first half or all of the bottle with these issues. I will update if anything changes.
I received this product free in exchange for my honest opinion while testing and then my subsequent review, whether positive or negative. I hope you have found it helpful. Thank you!

title: Works really well, although don't delude yourself that it won't hurt.
text:
I'm a tweezing/waxing maniac. Although it does hurt to wax, it doesn't suck as much as having to shave all the time, so I prefer it over shaving. The downside to that is that it is so expensive. In my town, an underarm wax can cost $22 plus tip, and since the hair will grow back at different times you may end up wishing for another wax just a week later. You also have to wait until it's long enough too. Since I was tired of the cost of waxing and I don't mind the pain of waxing or plucking, I thought an epilator would be a good buy. I did a lot of research on each type and finally settled on this one about 6 months ago based on the positive reviews. I made the right choice, for sure, and it has paid for itself at least 5 times over by now.
Pros:
*It is actually better not to let the hair grow long, so that means you don't have to be hairy for long periods of time
*You can do it at any given time, if there is anything to pull, which is way better than a once-per month trip to the waxer's shop.
*It doesn't hurt as bad once you are consistent with it, just like with waxing.
*It is fairly easy to clean and easy to recharge
*The flashlight is a great tool to help see those hairs you would miss just off the ceiling lights.
*You can use it almost anywhere, or anywhere you have help from another pair of unwary hands. Bikini line, chin, upper lip, underarm, leg, arm, you name it. My underarms and bikini line are my favorite places to use it.
*You can use it in the shower
*The battery lasts pretty long, like an hour
Cons:
*If you try to give yourself a brazilian wax with it by yourself, you are gonna have a bad time. I tried and failed. Luckily, the top part came off before it could do any damage, so it was really just a bit scary. It jammed when that happened, and wouldn't turn back on, but I just plugged it in for a charge and it was back to normal.
*It hurts pretty bad. As opposed to waxing, which takes it all off in one go, it pulls hairs one at a time like tweezing, but at a fast pace. That means there is a lot of breath holding and holding of skin to keep it all tight because you don't know when or how many hairs it will find and pull out. I suggest taking 600mg of Ibuprofen a half hour before you intend to do it... or maybe a few glasses of wine if you'd rather not use traditional drugs.
*The hair will fly EVERYWHERE, but where else would it go, I guess?

title: Beautiful cobalt blue bottles; great caps; so-so sprayers
text:
I love the look of these bottles. They are cobalt blue, and really stand out from the usual amber tints. The bottle itself is well-made and sturdy. The included caps (2 were provided) are of excellent quality, with polycone inserts to maintain an air-tight, leak proof seal. The included sprayers (2 were provided) are functional, but rather cheap in terms of build quality, especially the trigger. It also comes with a tiny little funnel that is way undersized and pretty useless given the bottle volume, and a few black labels (which require a white pen, which is NOT included).

Each bottle comes in a bubble pack sleeve, but the box itself is rather thin with limited protection. These are a notch below other bottles I've received when it comes to manufacturer-provided protective packing. Still, the bottles did not break or chip in transit.

The bottles needed a good wash before use since the outside had some type of greasy-feeling film. I would have washed them regardless of their condition, but these definitely needed a good washing before use.

Taking everything into consideration I'll rate these as 4 stars. Well worth considering if you need a more colorful option than amber and don't expect to be using the sprayer much (or at all).

title: A Nail Techs view: Perfect kit for the beginner! Great customer service. 5 stars⭐
text:
This Belle polygel kit is a great starter set from beginner to expert levels. It has some beautiful neutral colors, along with a white, and gorgeous glitters. They are all half ounce size tubes that will create a few sets of nails each, or you can mix and match the colors to make them go farther.
This kit includes; Six .5 oz. polygel colors, primer, gel base and top coats, a nail strengthener, cuticle oil, slip solution, dual forms, polygel brush with spatula, nail clips, and alcohol wipes. It comes nicely packaged in a lovely black box with cutouts to hold everything in place.
At minimum, you will need to supply your nail prep and finishing tools and liquids, such as: cuticle pusher and possibly nippers, a buffer, and nail dehydrator/alcohol, but these are things you will want to keep in good supply, anyways.
This polygel is so easy to work with. It is not too hard nor too soft. It's very easily workable with the provided slip solution. Even a beginner will have no trouble using it. Just remember, that if your surrounding temperature gets too cold or too hot, it affects the viscosity of the polygel, so work in a room that feels nice.
I did two nail swatches; one solid glitter and the other a French manicure with a shimmery twist. As I said, the polygel applied so easily, it also cured as expected without any problems, and the end results turned out beautiful.
I have to say that when I received my Belle polygel kit, there was a small issue with my order. I contacted their customer service and was met with such kindness and prompt service. They answered all my questions very quickly and respectfully. They're promptness in solving my problem, and their patience in dealing with my questions, shows me that they really care about their customers. Knowing that they were not privy to my customer status lets me know that they will treat all customers the same.
The colors are all so beautiful, and the glitters really make a statement. This set would make a great addition to anyone's collection and would also make a wonderful gift. Knowing this polygel kit is also backed by Belle, a wonderful company who really values their customers, makes a great product even better. I would most definitely recommend it!

title: Great trimmer
text:
I've had this trimmer for probably 6+ years and it is still going strong. Just a hint if you have one and are looking to replace the G380 due to battery loss give this a try once a year:
Run until the battery discharges fully. By this I mean when the battery is getting weak I take the attachments off and turn on the power switch. Leave the switch on until the gizmos stop rotating then turn off. Wait about 20 minutes or so and then power on to deplete the rest of the battery (you can try this a few times to make sure it is fully drained). After discharging, plug it into the charger and let fully charge (I think I let mine charge overnight). This unit is now back to original power, and I haven't had to recharge in over 3 weeks of normal use and it functions like new). Just a tip to save you some money before deciding to buy another unit which I almost did. I could not find a replacement battery when I thought the battery was the issue.

title: Very Comfortable, Well Made, Throw In The Washing Machine
text:
These are very nice gloves. I've been having a reaction to dish detergent lately. I have a cortizone cream I put on once or twice a day and then put a glove on to keep the cream from getting rubbed off or getting near my eyes. I also put a moisturizer on at night before going to bed and then wear a pair of gloves to keep the moisturizer from wearing off. So far they've worked great.

The quality of these gloves actually surprised me. They are well made and the material is substantial. These aren't flimzy at all. I have small hands so I got the medium size. There's just enough elasticity to the material to give me a nice snug, comfortable fit. They won't fall off. It's also easy to handle things with them on. I haven't washed them yet but I'm sure they'll wash well by hand for at least a few washings.

Feb 24 1018: I washed several pairs of the gloves yesterday. I wasn't in the mood to hand wash or baby them so decided to throw them in the washing machine with my dish towels. I dried them in the clothes dryer on medium heat. The gloves came out perfectly. There was no fraying, shrinkage that was noticeable. They came out soft, comfortable, and totally unharmed. I REALLY like these gloves!!!

text:
This is a nice Retinol cream that is a little expensive considering it contains only 0.5% retinol. I have others that contain 3 times as much and cost half of this one. One word of caution, please keep in mind when you use products containing retinol to use sun blocker and to apply them in the evening since these can make your skin sensitive to sun light.

This serum comes in a stunning little plastic squeeze tube looking like upside down pump dispenser. It has a pleasant and mild scent that I really like.

The serum is lightweight and absorbs quickly into your skin. There is some residue for a brief while but that goes away pretty quickly. It leaves you with nice soft skin that is smooth and feels great. All in all I really do like this even though it is a bit more on the expensive side for what you get. My skin does like it though and with the lower concentration of the retinol this may work better for people who are more sensitive to retinol.

title: These work very well
text:
This mask is very nice. I have never used a mask like this one before. It's heavier than the usual thin almost paper or gel like masks that a lot of them seem to be. This one definitely has a bit more to it. It's also a two piece mask which is great in some ways because sometimes I looks like a one person comedy routine trying to get the masks on right while they flip and flop all over.
With this mask you put the bottom part then the top by your eyes, it makes it a lot easier. Then you leave it on for at least 20 minutes ( though it says to leave it on for 30 so I did that). When you take it off you gently pat the left over into your skin.
It leaves your skin feeling so soft and really well moisturized. I feel like it did a very nice job with firming up the skin as well. I have only used two of these so far, one a week over two weeks, and have really liked the way my skin looked and felt after each use. I would recommend giving these a try if you can. Perhaps in summer as they have a nice cooling feel to them that I bet would feel great in the summer heat!

title: Good upgrade over the Oral B 1000 if you need the features
text:
We have owned different Oral B power toothbrushes over the years with the latest being the 1000. I have no complaints with the 1000 it works.

When determining if one should purchase the 4000 or the 1000, one needs to look at the additional features the 4000 provides.

If you have sensitive gums then you will need to purchase the 4000, there is a gentle mode. Additionally, I would not recommend purchasing the floss action heads if you have sensitive gums.
While there is an in handle display in the 4000, it is not a digital display. It is a light next to the feature you are currently selecting

I do not see any difference when using the polishing mode in the 4000, however, I do not have stains to determine if the feature works.

The one annoyance for me with the 4000 is that I accidentally change the mode instead of turning off the brush from time to time because the button are close enough to do this.
While I recommend the Oral B 4000, I would suggest using the 1000 if you do not have sensitive or stained teeth.

title: Pretty but Catches and pulls out a lot of hair
text:
This blingy headband is so pretty. It makes me feel like I am living as a tudor or in elizabethan or renaissance times or something. Would actually look great wearing to a Renaissance Faire.

The problem is that the thing is not made in the best way. First, when it arrived, it had already lost a stone – although it was floating around inside the plastic bag. Try as I might, I can not get it to reattach as I think the prongs are now broken. I will try instead to glue it back in. Makes me wonder how long it will take for the other stones to also fall out… Usually with jewelry, it is preferable to have prong set stones but apparently not in a headband as all those prongs grab and catch like every hair available on your head. It pulled so much of my hair out when I tried simply removing it from my head. (My pictures of the hair caught was AFTER I pulled most of the hair off the prongs. It was easily 4 to 6 times as much stuck on it originally.)

Because of the issue stated above I can only recommend for like one time use – knowing you are going to lose a bunch of hair because of it. Otherwise I can not recommend. : ( Maybe if you have VERY short hair that has no way of catching… (It also came with a freebie hair clip which I will give to a child and a sweet, cute paper origami heart - love that!)

title: White-Out for lips; gives you the true color your lipstick was meant to be!
text:
This is going to sound really stupid, but I could never figure out why certain shades of pink lipstick never looked the same on my lips as they did in arm swatches. I really never connected the thing is that I have pigmented lips, and because they pull red, any color always has a reddish cast to it. And definitely no pink lipstick, especially anything lighter than medium, ever looked right.

I started looking around to see if there was some product I could use, since foundation is just drying and causes flaking. I was told that MAC makes a good lip coverup, but it's $20 (why is everything at MAC $20 and up?) I don't have a problem spending the money, but since there's no freestanding MAC store near me, I thought I'd give this Etude House concealer a try.

And it's good. Unlike plain foundation, it's very glossy when you first apply it. It truly blots out your real lip color; it's like lip White-Out. In a mirror, you look like you're looking at a photo negative!

This stuff is way too glossy to put anything over it without blotting. The dry down takes forever without blotting, but I was pleasantly surprised to see that once I blotted, the white out effect was still very much there, just not glossy, and so, ready for lipstick. The one thing it does really well is block out the red of my lips and give my lip products a much truer color payoff.

I was very pleasantly surprised at how well it turned out. The only caution I'd say is you don't need to put on as much of this as I did; you'll just be wasting product, and there's no dry down when you overdo it!

title: I LOVE What Easydew Does For My Skin!
text:
Should I start my review by telling you how incredibly creamy Easydew Daily face wash is? How it makes my skin feel great as I'm washing with Easydew and even better after I've rinsed it off? How much I love the scent?

Don't worry, I'll tell you everything! This is my first ever Easydew product. In fact, prior to seeing this face wash in my VINE offers, I'd never even heard of Easydew brand products. I'm so happy I ordered it.

A nice, thin line of the wash dispenses from the tube. (The tube is very sturdy and durable, for those interested in packaging) Now, the wash starts out like a kind of lotion but it lathers quickly and easily into a light, whipped foam. ( A dime size amount is all I need to sufficiently cover my face/forehead. ) The whipped foam is SO creamy and it just feels so darn good as I apply it and when its on my face. IDK if its possible but I swear I can feel it cleaning, hydrating and moisturizing my skin pretty much immediately. After I rinse with lukewarm water and pat my skin dry with a towel, my skin is soft, smooth, clean and has a bit of a glow. It looks and feels so good and healthy. It feels fresh. And it feels that way long after I've used Easydew. Easydew leaves my skin feeling like it did when I was younger-before I used makeup, before I spent too much time in the sun unprotected. It feels revived and I just love that feeling! Everything about this daily wash is perfect in my book. It works great and makes my skin look/feel great. The ingredients and what they do for skin is impressive. (I recommend taking a minute to read the info above regarding the ingredients!) The scent is wonderful (though it vanishes VERY quickly). And I have no issues using it on my dry, very sensitive skin. The price is more than reasonable, especially with the results the wash brings and the fact only a small amount is needed when I wash my face. Easydew is officially a part of my daily skin care routine now. I absolutely recommend Easydew!

title: The "Dirty Brown" is good match for Ash Brown. If you like a messy look, this is a good choice
text: My natural hair color is light to medium Ash Brown, depending on how manufacturers label their colors.  (Unfortunately, there's not alot of uniformity in the industry when it comes to color labels).  I look for #8 if the color number is given.  Even then, you can NEVER be sure unless you see it in person, and Ash Brown is particulary hard to find.  The picture of the "Dirty Brown" bun looked to be a close match to my hair, but the pictures often lie, too,....and "Dirty Brown"??  In all my searches for ash brown hair pieces, this is the first "Dirty Brown" color label I've come across. I took a chance, and it is ALMOST a perfect match to my hair color.  Even though it doesn't say that the Dirty Brown piece is ombre dyed, IT IS, and the lighter ends would not be my choice. Still, the darker "roots" of the piece are almost perfectly matched to mine, so I think I can pass it off as real.  I have very fine hair, and I do NOT like thick hair pieces. That's another hard thing to find,....hair pieces that aren't unrealistically thick and "weighty"!  This piece is full, but not TOO full, not so thick that it looks fakey or heavy.  The "messy" feature is definitely very messy, the hair is completely straight and a bit spiky looking, yet very soft to the touch.  The center opening is too big, the elastic to loose for me to wear it over my own ponytail or bun without additional fasteners.  I use a couple hidden bobby pins at the top of the piece to secure it to my own hair.  It's easy to do and unnoticeable but can sometimes get a little heavy and "pulling" if worn for hours.  I change the position of the bobby pins, move them off to the sides, if it starts to bother me, so it's not a deal breaker.  This messy bun (more like a mess pony) is very well suited for around home, when running errands, or for any casual event with casual dress.  I don't think it would work well (and I would not choose it) for more formal events or dressier attire.  I really, really like this piece!  95% of my life is "casual", and I know I'll get alot of wear out it.  These things don't last forever, so when I find an affordable piece that matches my natural hair color and my life style, I usually go back and get a "spare".  That's a winner in my world, and this one got a medal, so I'm back to buy the spare!

title: My confidence is back!
text:
For as long as I can remember I have suffered from excessive sweating; it was eating away at my confidence and causing unnecessary stress in my life. I couldn't buy any shirts that were too tight around the underarms and forget about buying shirts/sweaters/blazers that were certain colors, like gray, green, or light blue. I would sweat through three layers if that's what I was wearing that day. I sweat during the coldest winter days as well as in the summer. No deodorant worked for me; not degree, not overnight dove sport, not certain dri, not even a prescribed hyperhydrosis deodorant prescribed to me by my doctor.

I have been using Odaban for a couple weeks now, and I was finally able to wear my green blazer in public, lift my arms, and not be sweating! I can't believe how well this works. There was a two day period of slight underarm irritation but it has passed. I have changed my shower schedule around a bit but if that's all it takes, then I'm staying with this. As long as you follow the specific directions, this will work for you. I don't even use it everyday anymore, I use it MAYBE twice a week. Spend the $10.00 because this will change your life around if you suffer from hyperhydrosis.

title: First time trying snail mucin, but it won't be the last. Excellent Stuff! 5 stars⭐
text:
This is my first experience trying anything with snail mucin in it and also some of the other ingredients, like peptides and adenosine. I can't say which one it is for sure, but I suspect it's the snail mucin that made a noticeable and immediate difference in my skin.
My forehead skin has a few dimples and I have some fine lines and wrinkles under my eyes. I am 50 years old, but I've been using Retin-A for several years now. I've had a mostly natural skin care routine, other than the Retin-A, but recently decided to try a few of the K-beauty products out. This one was the first I used, and with the first use I can see my forehead and wrinkles were much smoother, along with the rest of my skin, as well. It also gave my skin a brighter look. With each use, it just gets better and better.
A little definitely goes a long way. Its texture is slimy, but I've found that I only need a very small amount to cover my face, and it massages in so easily. I also apply it to my neck & decollete.
I'm so glad that I tried this, and now I will just keep adding to it until I get the full K-beauty routine down. I would gladly purchase this again and I highly recommend it!

title: Deeply and Gently Cleans Pores
text:
I love how easily and quickly Tinazana's Pineapple Deep Cleanser becomes a creamy lather that feels really nice on my face. A very small amount of the cleanser does a great job of deeply cleaning pores and removing dead skin cells. My face feels fresh and clean after cleansing. But it does dry out my skin a bit. Because I follow up using toner and moisturizer, this isn't a huge deal for me and doesn't prevent me from continuing to use Tinazana cleanser. There is a light, faint, fresh scent that I enjoy. Surprisingly, it doesn't smell like pineapple to me. It also doesn't last; when I rinse the cleanser off, I can no longer detect the scent at all.

Due to skin sensitivity issues, I sometimes have issues with citrus based products. I know pineapple technically isn't a citrus fruit but I was a bit concerned it might be too harsh on my skin. Its not. No burning or itching at all.

I like this cleanser a lot. Does a great job, even with drying my skin a bit. The price is reasonable. This is a cleanser I will continue to use and I recommend it.

My overall rating is 4.5 stars.

title: Black mold is revolting
text:
I got this brush because my dentist recommended it. I tend to brush too hard on the corner teeth and was creating notches. I was very happy with this -- for awhile. After using it for awhile I started to notice a nasty smell. I cleaned the outside of the brush and that didn't help. Next I unscrewed the base from the brush and it was pretty bad in there. There was black mold as well as thick white gunk. I cleaned it thoroughly with bleach, getting into corners with q-tips. In no time, the smell was back. This time I investigated further into the brush head itself. Gaaaaack. There was a lot of gross mold growing in there. I soaked that in clorox, then gave it a shake. Chunks of mold came flying out. I cleaned it as well as I could and reassembled it. The brush head no longer worked.

I change the replacement heads pretty regularly, even though they are very expensive. I am going back to a regular brush with soft bristles that I can buy for a couple bucks and toss when it gets old.

title: Overall Pleased!
text:
I purchased this unit on a Prime Day. Reviews were mixed, but I was willing to take a chance at the sale price. Very happy I did. It looks a little less than 150% when flat ironed, but I like it that way because it looks more realistic. Having too much hair makes it look wiggy.

I immediately washed it, let it dry naturally, then flat ironed it. I'm more of a straight hair girl. The hair is very soft and took to straightening well.

I didn't experience much shedding; a strand here and there. It's only been a week and 1 wash, so we'll see. Some shedding is always to be expected eventually though with any wig; just not crazy shedding. I also haven't experienced any tangling. title: READ AND FOLLOW THE DIRECTIONS!!
text: [[VIDEOID:ffaf5d7e162f6f006c929357f2756230]] Apparently, a lot of the people who give  this stuff a bad review are just stupid and unable to follow simple directions. I received the holographic powder this afternoon and just finished my nails about 5 minutes ago. This is NOT a nail dip powder like Revel. The tiny small jar will probably do at least 100 nails based on the amount I just used for 10 fingers . Steps- You do your gel nails exactly like you always do them, and after your topcoat is cured, you take the eyeshadow applicator, barely dip it into the powder, and buff it over your nail like you are putting on eyeshadow but rub it in really well like blending. You do NOT dip your finger into the powder. You do NOT put it on your wet nail You put It on the dry topcoat, and buff it in, wipe off the excess with a dry brush or a cotton ball, then do another topcoat and cure that. The only reason I am not giving this 5 stars is because I am not sure how it will wear. I will update my review later. Please look at the online directions for this and don’t be stupid! I used several different colors of polish to test it out, and it even works over just the clear. I am going to try it with regular nail polish later and see how it works with that.

title: The Messiest and Most Effective Handcream I've Found
text:
I wash my hands often, especially since Covid 19 appeared on the scene, and this dries out my skin and causes the fingertips to develop cracks that are as painful as paper cuts. I have tried every kind of hand cream I could find to remedy the situation, from those purporting to prevent such cracks to those advertised as ultra-dry skin salves to petroleum jelly. Nothing works. Then I decided to give Dr. Naylor's a try and bingo! I've used it for about 2 weeks, and everything has healed. Even my hand doctor--this is the absolute truth--noticed the difference! So I love Dr. Naylor's Udder Balm and am a convert for life.

However, the reason I didn't assign 5 stars to this product is that it's the messiest stuff I've ever used. It's like an ointment, but it comes in a can, and the can arrived leaking the stuff, even though the can was sealed. It's both sticky and gloppy. You need only a little bit to put on your hands (or feet) in order to get full coverage, so I imagine that the tin I bought will take years to use up. I have actually set it inside a small cardboard box to absorb the mess that exudes from the can. If you can accept this fact about the product, you will appreciate its benefits. If not, Bag Balm is less messy (but I can't stand the smell). The scent of Dr. Naylor's is, unlike Bag Balm, not heavily camphorated and not overly medicinal. The smell also evaporates as soon as the cream is absorbed.

The bag is very lightweight, which is good for a backpack or small suitcase, but the thin materials of the bag appear as though they will wear out pretty quickly, especially when frequently loaded with heavy bottles of body wash, shampoo, and the like. I like that I can hang this bag on the back of a bathroom door (see photo), but the hanger on the bag is plastic, which limits the amount of weight you can hang in this bag.

I seldom fly or make long trips, so the Gonex bag meets my needs on short, overnight trips. If you are a person who camps or takes long journeys, you may want to try something a bit more sturdy and durable.

title: Effective
text:
I've been watching as every personality is raving about rose quartz and jade and microneedling etc. I did some research (from reputable sources) and there is actually some science to the use of these products. The microneedle blade is small enough for use. It makes little tiny, non-noticeable holes in the surface of your skin (in effect damaging it) so it will produce more collagen. While I wouldn't use it more than once a week, and just until my skin starts to get red, it does appear that my skin is softer and smoother after the treatment. So I'm find on the micro-needler. (Just remember gently, gently). The quartz roller is supposed to reduce redness, smooth the surface of the skin and help with lymphatic drainage. I'm not sure it actually does all that but it does feel nice and has definitely helped with under eye puffiness so it appears to be working. I'm very pleasantly surprised by the effectiveness of these devices and will continue to use them.

The packaging is fine and makes them giftable but I'm not sure the quality of the pieces will actually hold up. I've been using them for several months and so far so good but if they do fall apart, I'm willing to invest in more expensive products. For a starter set, I would give this a try to be sure it works for you (and you are willing to do it).

I have curly, coarse, thick hair that tends to dry and frizz very fast. I use several products to keep my hair under control.
I in in love with this hair treatment from TEDDIE ORGANICS. I have several essential oils from Teddie Organics. This is a wonderful company with great customer service. I have been impressed by the quality of their products.
I was already a firm believer in argan oil for my hair; I have been using it for months. This formulation of hair treatment from Teddie Organics adds rose hip oil and jojoba oil; both beneficial for hair. This is a winning combination. I use several drops in my hair when it is wet and comb it through to distribute evenly. to make sure I get the ends of my hair . I was given the opportunity to test and try this product, and I am pleased with the results. Perfect for curly girls.

This stuff is great for Making Cannabis Tincture. Great price for a gallon anywhere online and also anywhere in store. I filled 3 huge jars and still have a bunch left for next time. This is also Kosher.

My tincture instructions:

Fill jars with leaf matter
Fill with Glycerine Tincture
Leave a little space at the top.

Screw on Caps. Mark dates on top of caps.

Leave for 60 Days.

Put jars in the over for 20-60 Minutes on 100 degrees Fahrenheit ( some people argue to do this first. )

Filter out Leaf matter with cheesecloth and funnel into dropper bottles.

title: Strange smell, white substance (mold?)
text:
I ordered 5 sticks and they arrived within about a week. The first stick I opened had a white substance stuck to it (see pictures). a second stick I opened did not have the same substance. The three other sticks also do not seem to have the substance on them, but I have not opened them. Some of this white stuff feels wet and slimy, while on other parts of the stick, it is dried up and crusty. I could not find any expiration dates nor any information on what the white substance could be on the packaging. I have not used any of the sticks out of concern for my safety. The smell is quite potent up close. The two sticks I opened smelled about the same. It is hard to describe because I have never smelled anything like it. I would say it smells like what radishes taste like, in combination with a strong chemical smell. It is not pleasant, although some people seem to like it. Cannot comment on the intended use because I am concerned to try it. The fact that this is a product of Pakistan has me worried because I do not know what safety regulations exist for the manufacture of this product.

As a final note, I noticed the size of these sticks varies a bit. The smallest stick had about as much girth as a pencil, but the largest had considerably more girth. The base of the stick could cover a nickel.

Update:
It has been a week and the stick that initially came with a strange white substance stuck to it is now covered in a strange black substance. I have not touched it since I first opened it. It appears the stick has been contaminated with some sort of mold. (See picture) I have disposed of all of the Sewak. Think twice before buying.

title: Oh the uses for glycerin
text: This bottle I bought to put a scant teaspoon into my home made ice cream to keep it from forming ice crystals after storing in the freezer.  I just bought a Cuisinart Ice Cream Machine and followed a simple recipe for chocolate ice cream, but I wanted to make sure that it would not become hard and full of ice crystals once I stored it in the freezer, so I did some research online and glycerin is one of several ways to keep ice cream creamy.  It only takes a teaspoon in the recipe and the other thing about glycerin is that it is sweet, so it blends in well with an ice cream recipe.  My ice cream turned out great and it is smooth and creamy after being in the freezer.  Now, this is not my first use of glycerin as I have used a small amount in water to spray in my hair.  Especially on really humid days when my naturally curly hair turns into a frizz-ball, spraying my hair with a 10 parts water, 1 part glycerin (or even less glycerin, depending) keeps my hair from frizzing out so bad.  For me, in ice cream or in my hair, glycerin works great!

text:
The only reason I did not give this product five stars is because of the packaging. The cap comes off in two parts for some reason. One part opens the dropper tip and the other opens the entire top of the bottle. When I went to fill the makeup cup of my airbrush I uncapped the wrong part of the Aeroblend bottle and before I realized it I'd literally dumped $24.50 worth of product down the drain... and on the vanity, and on the floor... :(

I used the makeup once before accidentally pouring the rest of the bottle out. But, from my very limited experience, Aeroblend is an amazing product. It evenly covered my very uneven skin and made it look almost flawless. Aeroblend blended perfectly with my actual skin tone (although maybe I just got lucky and chose the right shade on the first try) so it looks completely natural. I'd been using Art of Air makeup and had to do a lot of mixing and experimenting with different shades every time I put it on. Even then I could never get it just right. Aeroblend is very light (not heavy) so it didn't look or feel caked on my skin. It didn't even feel like I was wearing makeup. I definitely recommend this product, just be sure to pay attention when you're opening the bottle.

For a discount on the price, I asked and received an invitation to experience Baebody Reinol Serum 2.5%......

First.... I am not looking for a 'regime' to reduce fine lines, wrinkles, puffy eyes and the natural effects of growing older. I am looking for a a product that I can use to forestall and diminish the realities of how rough I have been on my skin.

Second.... I have been using lotions and creams for several years now... around my puffy eyes and crows feet. Most of the products I have used are more like lotions/gels. This serum is more fluid and spreads easily .....

Third.... I received Baebody Retinol Serum two days ago...... I began using the next morning. My first impression was ..... this is more like a liquid than a lotion/gel......I have applied around my eyes, face, forehead, and neck, I have no need to apply to decolletage ( google it). Could I see an immediate effect.....Kinda like a Grimm character morphing? I did not. If I did, I would buy stock in the company!

Fourth..... I will continue to use on a faithful basis and let all know what I experience and see..... in a month's time.

Watch this post.........

Take care now -

title: Lies and fraud. Cheap junk. Don't buy these.

Other sellers through Amazon may be more honest in their descriptions of these Salux cloths. I won't know, I guess, until I receive the ones I ordered through Amazon from a different merchant. title: A Good Shaver from Norelco
text:
This is the latest shaver in Norelco's Quadra system. The shaving heads are mounted in such a way that gives them the freedom to depress independently of one another, to better adapt to the unique contours of your face. Another advantage to this razor is that the shaving heads can be washed under the faucet. This is a feature that the Quadra system razors share with the more expensive Spectra system razors.
This razor is light-years better than my previous Norelco. My last Norelco was the 885, bought back in 1991. That razor always irritated my skin, especially the neck area. Although it did last nine years. Three years ago, I switched to the Braun Syncro system. The Braun worked very well for me. Anyway, I decided to give Norelco another try. I was very surprised, and impressed, to say the least. This Quadra shaves just as close and just as comfortable as the Braun Syncro. And, it is very quiet. So far, I am only getting 35 minutes of shaving time per charge. But, I believe that the battery will reach its full capacity after a few more discharge and charge cycles.
For me, it is an even choice between this Norelco and the Braun. I can readily recommend either one. I suppose you just might have to try both and see which one will work better for you. One thing is obvious though. Either one will save you money in the long run, compared to using a blade shaver like the Mach 3, for example. The long-term cost of periodically buying replacement blades for a Mach 3 or Sensor Excel can easily exceed the price of either one of the electrics. I will admit, however, that neither of the electric razors can match the closeness of the Mach 3.

text:
I ordered this set for the lashes since I already have some liner. I am very glad I do have the liner because the one that comes with this set is crap. I made sure my eyes were clean and dry. I read the directions on the back of the package...
shake the liner 10 times (I made sure I shook it more than that), apply a thick layer and let dry a few seconds (it took longer than that) apply another thick coat then get the lash and apply it to the liner area. gently press down.
Very simple right? NOPE. The edges kept lifting up and the lash fell off after a couple of blinks. OK I thought, maybe my liner wasn't thick enough, so I applied another really good coat and then tried the lash again....Same results. I then washed my eye again and tried with my other liner and the lash stayed on like it should.
I like the lashes very much. All three pair are a natural length (IF you use mascara), and vary in looks. If you get these, make sure you have another liner available or plan to purchase one.

text: This order replaced an identical one which was tossed on a box and arrived in pieces. This time it was packed with airbags and it's usable. I would caution against dropping this on any floor, as it's brittle, but it's quite handy for all the little things easily misplaced on a trip - tweezers, hair elastics, bandaids, nail files, make-up brushes - not bulky or tall items. title: Patience required
text:
I’ve been trying out a couple of different lash serums over the past month. With my husband also using it (on his brows), while I use it on my lashes, we’ve been able to try different brands to see if there are any differences in results. This serum, by Kimuse, is very similar to the others in consistency (a thin liquid) and in how it’s applied (with a very thin brush). I have had no negative reactions to the serum, and no irritation to my eyes even when I’ve slipped and gotten some in my eye. This serum boasts results in as little as 3-4 weeks, while most others are more conservative at 6 weeks. In the few weeks we’ve been using the serums, neither of us have noticed any dramatic changes as far as lash or brow growth, but I do think I’m losing fewer lashes which is a definite plus. Honestly, I’m not sure if any serum is going to provide dramatic results, but we’ll continue for at least a few more weeks and see what happens while hoping for the best.Hopefully, I’ll be back with exciting news!

Update: After using this, as well as other, lash growth serums for several months, I have noticed a definite improvement in the length of my lashes. I have not noticed as significant an improvement in the thickness, or volume, of my lashes, however. I believe that these types of serums do help promote growth, and I haven't been able to detect much difference between brands except that a couple of them irritated my eyes. Therefore, my conclusion is that this is helpful and the real determination of what works best will be what's most comfortable for you to use, so read the ingredients and watch for any possible allergy triggers or irritants.

title: Nice set
text:
"Jeff's Wife" - I got these when they were an Add-On Item for $3.99, definitely worth the price. The stamper works great, I didn't even wash it first (even though you should always wash new stampers before first use), and it's slightly (I do mean slightly) softer then other clear stampers I own.

If you're new to stamping or not familiar with clear stampers, they are more delicate than opaque ones and tear easily, so be gentle with it. Wash it with dish soap & warm water, dry with a paper towel and clean it with a lint roller or tape. Never buff it or use acetone, you'll make it cloudy defeating the purpose of a clear stamper. When picking up, ROLL GENTLY over the image if you apply too much pressure it won't pick up. When applying the image to the nail press straight down (again, with GENTLE pressure) and rock side to side or roll from side to side. Don't push the tip of the nail into it, it will tear.

All the plates stamp great, I didn't swatch every image, although plates 29 & 41 have shallow etching (in my experience this is normal for BP plates) so the thinner scraper is a nice addition. It's not as thin as the 0.5mm and not a thick as the 1mm ones I own, I'd say it's 0.75mm (I didn't get out the calipers). There are different size images, a little for every nail size. But I do wish the water marble designs were bigger, I'm not a Water Marble Witch yet. Plate 52 is great for lead lighting or Sharpie water coloring.

The stamping guide works like it's supposed to, I've added a photo to show how it's used just in case it's confusing. I have a set of 4 templates from another brand already, there's not much difference in size or thickness of the metal but the designs are different. The edges aren't finished, like a plate with no backing, but I don't think it would cause anyone to slice their finger open unless you're being extremely careless.

All in all a great set.

title: Pretty good brushes for a budget!
text:
First off, the brushes do not smell... The case does or the plastic the whole thing was in does. I've had the set out for two days now and it doesn't really smell like plastic anymore.
Case: not super soft material but not overly rigid, closes with the two snaps well. Has a pretty floral motif in gold with a white background... Really like the pattern! Spaces for the brushes are sized appropriately and nothing falls out. Also includes a close over flap to protect the brush heads.
Face brushes : keeping in mind that this is a budget set, I didn't not compare these to my Sigma or real techniques brushes. Instead I looked at their overall quality and performance. The face brushes are soft, decent on the amount of hairs and pretty dense. They worked well for everything I tried, although I do not use powder foundation. A few of the brushes had some uneven hairs poking out, which I trimmed and did not seem to negatively affect the outcome. Ferrules on my set (white and gold) are firmly attached, no wobbly-ness and no shedding after washing twice and using twice.
Eye brushes: work pretty well, I like the face brushes better to be honest but these work, just not great. My issue was with the product pick up and then depositing it on my eyelids... It did but not evenly. The ferrules were attached firmly and not shedding on theses either. Only one eye brush had a few uneven hairs.
Package also included a brief description of brush names and suggested uses, along with cleaning instructions (useful for a beginner, for sure).
Overall, the set is pretty good and the price is really good. I think it's worth it for the face brushes and the case, so-so on the eye brushes.
*I did use a coupon code on this item but I paid with my own money*

title: Turbo trimer!
text:
The good the bad and the ugly. Here goes. I've always sworn by Norelco trimmers. I've owned several. They normally last reasonably well. I normally get 5 years of use out of them. I say reasonably well because in this day and age, 5 years is good but I prefer things to last 20 years like they used too. Sadly; that's not going to happen. The adjustable guide is the best design that I have found. Far better than similar units that use multiple guides that can get lost, damaged and require additional storage space. The turbo function does work, it has enough high power that calling it "turbo" is not only cool but accurate. The charge/low battery lights function well. The vacuum functions well. I've tried other manufactures so called vacuum units and found that not only did they not work they were a total disappointment. This vacuum system works! Removing and installing the guide was a bit tricky at first but you get used to it. The single thing that I miss is the slide up mini trimmer. Frankly; I would rather have that than the vacuum. Still, I like this product and recommend it! I have had it about a year now and it still works perfect!

Update: 3 years old and like new!

title: Great upgrade. Affordable and solid.
text:
I got this from Amazon Warehouse, where it was open box but supposedly unused. I don't know if that was true, but the condition of my item is irrelevant to the review. This is a great light. It replaces both my 24w UV bulb lamp and my 9w LED UV lamp.

This thing cures Gelish and RCM so fast, and my manis are lasting so much longer without lifting or chipping. Most of the time now, I get bored or my nails grow too much before the polish even shows a hint of coming off. The LED placement is great, and it cures all 5 fingers at once with no trouble. There is a bit of heat, but it's minimal and I'd be surprised if anyone found it painful. I haven't tried the 99s low heat mode.

The sensor feature is nice. I was under the impression that I could set the timer to 30s or 60s once and forget it, but so far it seems like I have to choose a time every time. If not, it goes on until you remove your hand. I haven't gone over 105 seconds, so I'm not sure how long it would go for, but it definitely doesn't have a default shut off of 99s as advertised. My open box didn't include a user manual. I'm hoping to find one online.

The white of this model doesn't reflect as much light as those lined in silver. But it still leaks a fair amount of light. I'd definitely advise using glasses or averting your eyes. And make sure to keep kids away, because even the reflected light can be painfully intense.

It comes off the base for doing pedicures, and while the magnetic components seem to work well and the pieces fit together nicely, I don't polish my toes so I don't use this without the base.

title: Nice look; feels pretty solid; but average in performance & value
text:
This is a “dressed up” version of the Wahl “LifeProof” shaver (which I also reviewed). It has a more upscale look and feel to it, plus adds a battery gauge to show the charge level. However, the shave quality is the same – OK, but not a standout.

The case feels more solid than the LifeProof and, while it’s more of a traditional look, I think they did a nice job with the overall aesthetics. It is pretty grippy even with wet hands. It does not, however, feel as comfortable to hold as the more sculpted models such as most of the Panasonic shavers and some Braun shavers.

The shave quality of this model is identical to that of the LifeProof: very Remington in how it feels (close, but rather aggressive). Performance is best on the easy spots (cheek) but not as good on the more trickier spots (neck and jawline). The flex head helps with dealing with face contours but it lacks enough travel to do an excellent quality job.

The aggressiveness of the shave is dialed down when using it wet. It needs a very, very thin layer of shave cream (the gel style creams work well) or the head gets bogged down.

Love the trimmer! The positioning could be improved to make it easier to use, but it cuts very cleanly on sideburns and ‘shash trimming.

The controls are clean, easy to read and tell you all you need to know (charge and battery status).

I like the feel of this better than the Wahl LifeProof, but the shave quality keeps this at the same rating (average, which is 3 stars). It’s a very workable shaver, but for the price there are better choices available from Panasonic (anything in their Arc line) or, for less money, from Remington.

title: use in a ventilated space!
text:
first the elephant in the room - read the ingredients and you will see there is formaldehyde. technically this is terrible but it is somewhat manageable. be in a ventilated space. personally i turn the bathroom fan on while i am using it for the whole process - especially during the flat iron part. i also turn on a regular floor fan pointed into the bathroom, whatever i can do to keep the air moving.

ok - now that we have covered that - the actual product. it's sooooo easy to use. the process is so simple and easy. the directions are super easy to understand and follow and there are pictures included. it's pretty quick - you can get through it all within an hour once you get started on the actual product. just follow the directions.

then for maintenance between treatments there is a shampoo and conditioner provided. these are EXTREMELY thick! like the conditioner is so crazy thick it's almost too difficult to get it out of the bottle. it's a workout. but it's all good to help maintain though.

now - the results. i'm not disappointed at all. i know it's working. it's not a crazy perma-straight situation though. this is NOT salon results. let me repeat that ... NOT salon results. i have super natural curly hair - i can still wash my hair curly. the same amount of curls as i have always had. when i do wear it curly though, i also still have the same amount of frizz. it's sad and true. that said though - it's when wear it straight that the product shows it's worth! the picture i have posted it right after coming after getting caught in the rain. in the past my hair would just revert back to the full on curl, no waves just the game of 'how big is my hair gonna grow?' watch party. this time though ... i ended up with a style that i actually like! something i could easily still get away with wearing for the rest of the day/evening. as rainy and muggy as it has been lately - i can dig this and appreciate it through and through.

so all that said - do i wish it did a bit more for the curly hair frizz ... yes. but for the price and the fact that i will probably get 4 treatments out of this set - i think the system is worth for the investment - cost and time.

title: Crest White Strips Do Work - A Dentist Reviews this Product
text:
I am a dentist who recommends Crest White Strips because they do work to whiten teeth. Follow the directions in the box, and here are some further tips:

1. (Optional step) I recommend you first brush your teeth with water (don't use toothpaste) to remove the layer of plaque. Your enamel has pores and the pores need to be open for the chemical to penetrate. If you use a fluoridated toothpaste, the flouride may block the enamel pores. (Crest's instructions indicate you do not need to brush. I talked to a Crest representative on this point, and she indicated that the hydrogen peroxide will penetrate plaque, therefore this step is optional. The instructions indicate no brushing because they do not want fluoridated toothpaste on the teeth before whitening).

2. Use the strips twice per day for maximum efectiveness. The inner part of the strip has a chemical called carbamide peroxide (a 6% form of hydrogen peroxide; in-office dental whitening uses a 15-30% version of the same chemical) that causes the stains inside your teeth to be oxidized and turn white. Applying the strips has a small learning curve as you will probably bend or fold a couple of them before you get the technique down.

2. Leave the strips on for 30 minutes at a time. After thirty minutes your saliva has probably diluted the peroxide to the extent that it is no longer effective. You can reapply a new strip immediately if you chose, for the treatment requires one hour of treatment time per day to work. It does not matter if you do this in one continuous 60-minute period or two 30-minute periods. Do this for two weeks and your teeth should get whiter.

Disadvantages

1. The chemical may "burn" your gums. If you notice a burning sensation when you use the product, it is the peroxide oxidizing (or burning) your gums. Depending on how severe the burning is, it may cause you to stop the treatment. It is OK to stop the treatment for a day or two to let the gums heal. Once they feel normal again, resume treatment with the White Strips.

2. Your teeth may become senstiive during the two-week treatment time. Try to push yourself through the sensitivity if it is mild, but if it bothersome to cold water or air, take a day or two off to let the teeth settle down and then pick up where you left off.

3. The strips only cover your front teeth, so only your front teeth will bleach. You may notice the distinct difference between the back (unbleached) teeth and the front (bleached) teeth. Since most people notice the front 6 teeth anyway, this is not a concern. However, if you have a wide toothy smile, you may want to have a dentist make you a tray that will hold the chemical on the back teeth to whiten them too.

3. The bleaching effect works best on yellow stains. If your stains are due to tetracycline (brownish grey stains in a band on your teeth, your best bet is to have a dentist whiten your teeth as the dentist will use a tray to hold a more concentrated form of the chemical on your teeth for a longer period of time.

Crest White Strips work for the vast majority of people. Over time, you will get a result that should be whiter than when you started. Crest White Strips are a good place to start with bleaching, and if you are not satisfied with the results, you can then see your dentist for a more concentrated form of bleaching or other cosmetic options.

I visit my dentist often, but I sometimes need a little help to find rogue bits of debris in some of my teeth. The dental mirror is incredibly handy for that use. I also find the dental picks are better for me as hobby tools. I've never felt the need to scrap my own teeth to risk damage to surrounding tissues. They do a good job in tiny crevices and have a textured handle which is easy to hold. I find this set to be a good value and the versatile use is a great bonus for me.

title: As far as I can tell, it's soap like any other soap
text:
Although the fragrance (and ingredients) claim to be ginger, coconut, and turmeric, it has more of a lemon fragrance to me, perhaps the blend of ginger and coconut. If you concentrate, you can smell the ginger, but if you just catch a whiff of it, I think you'd say it's lemon.

It's a small hard-milled bar and it cleanses well and is refreshing. Beyond that, it seems pretty expensive for the size of the bar, even if it is hard milled.

As regards the claims made; I have no idea. I think it would take months, if not years for the ingredients to achieve the claims that the seller makes, especially since this is a topical application. I have done a lot of research on nutraceutical ingredients and, for sure, both ginger and turmeric are well documented and studied beneficial products, but not necessarily when used topically.

If you buy into the claims, try it; at worst it's a decent, if expensive, soap.

Review of: Lymphatic Drainage Organic Ginger Soap

title: Patches Work Well...Not a Huge Fan of the Roller
text:
Somehow, I managed to dodge dark circles under my eyes for most of my life...until a few years ago. Now, they're the 'norm' for me. Same for puffy eyes. FRLEDM's 24K gold under eyes patches help tackle both issues and do so quickly. I keep the patches in the fridge-I get better results when they're cold and it feels good as well. I wear the patches in the morning for about 15 minutes and I'm good to go. It did take multiple uses before the results were obvious but that's to be expected. I like many of the ingredients in the patches, including: collagen, hyaluronic acid (HUGE fan!), and aloe, to name a few. I'm not a fan of the roller, unfortunately. I just do not care for the way it feels on skin...its not smooth and gentle, more like tugging and pulling. I will be passing it along to my mom who is anxious to try it.

While I'm not a fan of the roller, I am a fan of the patches and am pleased with the results they provide. I will continue to use the patches and definitely recommend them. I hate to say that I don't recommend the roller just because I don't like the way it feels so I will just say its not for me.

title: Glass bottle is top notch, sprayer is not
text: I got these to put water/vinegar mixture in one and alcohol in the other, to use for cleaning and disinfecting purposes, respectively.  I wanted glass, rather than plastic, for these purposes.  The bottles themselves are top notch - heavy duty glass, nice size that is easy to hold yet doesn’t require constant refilling.  There are two included cap tops which are also nice - leak-proof if you want to store something in them that you either don’t need the sprayer for, OR, are transporting them somewhere and want to make sure no spillage.  The sprayer on the other hand, is not so great.  I do like that the sprayer tube is extra long... meaning you can get down to the last few drops.  But it feels cheap overall.  Other problems with the sprayer:  the screw on top fits pretty firmly, but the nozzle does not stay in place - it sort of swivels around.  This gets to be annoying if you are squirting multiple squirts because the nozzle keeps shifting.  The other thing that might be an issue for some is that there are only two settings and they are BOTH mist settings.  It appears that one is a slightly finer mist than the other (barely) but I am not 100% sure that is even the case.  This is not a problem for me because of the purpose I am using them... but wanted to point this out in case it might be a problem for others.  Overall the glass bottles are great but the nozzles need some work.  It also comes with 4 black labels - the labels actually are sort of a thin rubbery material and seem really nice... but what the heck am I going to use to write on BLACK labels?

title: Very Effective in Healing and Clearing Skin
text: I cannot say enough good things about this Retinol Serum. I have tried several things from the Baebody line of products, and they have all been very high quality and very effective. I am a huge fan of Retinol and how it benefits the skin. I am at a crappy age where I still get breakouts, and I am starting to get wrinkles. I hate having the same gross skin as I did as a teenager. And I have tried everything! Prescription meds, prescription creams, ProActiv, micro-dermabrasion, chemical peels, etc,etc. Nothing seemed to help until I started using this Retinol Serum. Retinol is just a fancy word for Vitamin A and apparently me skin is in desperate need of it. It acts on DNA to promote healthy epidermal skin cells. It does a great job of moisturizing my skin, which helps with wrinkles. And it also does a great job of preventing breakouts. If I do break out because of hormones, it helps clear them up without drying out my skin. Sometimes it clears up my skin within a day or overnight. Vitamin A is a really potent antioxidant that protects your skin from free radicals, generates cell growth, and repairs damaged cells. Retinol belongs to a family called retinoids, and is one of the only substances that is small enough to penetrate the outer epidermal layer to the layer where collagen and elastin reside. It is really strong at first. It is really effective and it is tempting to want to use too much too often, but it can end up irritating the skin. I started using it every other day at first and then built up to using it every day. I also like to use a Vitamin C serum, but using Vitamin C and Retinol together tends to decrease their effectiveness. And sunlight decreased the effectiveness of Retinol, so I use the Vitaming C serum in the morning and the Retinol Serum at night. I let it work it's magic while I sleep. It has helped clear up my skin and help heal sun spots and acne scars. My only regret about it is that I didn't start using this years ago! I was able to try this Retinol Serum at a promotional discount for testing and reviewing purposes and in exchange for my honest and unbiased opinion.

title: Great stuff!
text:
I bought this because of the positive reviews and it arrived quickly. (the product I usually get was out of stock) So I used this right away on myself and another nail tech tried it too, she loved it! After about a week we hadn't run into any lifting issues with the base coat and the top coat was still nice and shiny. So I started using it on some clients and it has worked really well! Now after using it for a good 6 months I would definitely recommend DND base and top coat for most clients.

I'm a licensed Instructor and nail tech, I've been doing nails for almost 20 years, I do gel polish by leaving the base coat on. (basically by doing a fill every 2 weeks, not a new set.) I only remove the gel polish color and prep the re-growth and apply base coat to the new growth. That said, the only issue Ive had on a couple clients is the base coat can get a little soft after several months if my client's hand are in water and/or chemicals a lot. So I need to remove the entire base coat and start all over every few months. This isn't the end of the world but to avoid having to do this, I use a different base coat on clients who are hairdressers or for those who have their hands in water a lot.
That is the base coat only and on just a few clients. I haven't had any issue like that with the top coat. I have since re-purchased this duo several times. I will continue to do so. :0)

title: Pretty decent product but do your research
text:
Overall, this product isn’t horrible compared to others on the market. It is paraben-free, sulfate-free, EU Allergen free and uses minimal ingredients however it also contains alcohol, silicone and is not safe for fungal acne. After running this product through a cosmetic ingredient safety checker, it scored an 88% one the EWG Health Rating. Most popular, name-brand face lotions are around 65%-80% on the EWG Health Rating. I use the EWG (Environment Working Group) as a reference when checking products and try to stay away from the alarmist side. Only 8% of this product is considered “moderate risk” mainly polyarylamide, Fragrance (unnecessary additive; possible allergy) , alcohol denat. (Bad for dry skin, bad for sensitive skin, potentially block pores) and BHT (also found in edibles, rubber products and is banned in UK and EU due to limited research showing BHT is linked to cancer). This product is good for brightening, anti-aging and promotes wound healing. It also contains steric acid which can potentially block pores.

Keep in mind, everyone’s skin is different and what effects one person may not effect another. Learn your skin and what products work best for you. Personally, I would stay away from this product if you have very dry skin and/or sensitive skin. I have “normal” skin (no sensitivities, not overly dry or oily, limited acne, no allergies) and didn’t have any issues with this product so far. It has a light scent that isn’t overpowering but completely unnecessary (I HATE fragrance in beauty products; stick with essential oils). It absorbed nicely and didn’t leave my face feeling oily. I am giving this product 4 stars as of February 21, 2021 due to the minimal ingredients and will update this review once a larger amount of time has passed to fully understand how to works with my skin.

title: excellent coverage, non cakey, doesnt settle into lines, a tad warm for fair, cool skin
text:
Primer, liquid Foundation, BB cushion, and a flat kabuki brush. I have another Phoera kit, and I like it a lot.
https://www.amazon.com/gp/product/B093GFPFP9

I am not sure if Nude (#102) is the lightest shade they have or not, but if you are like me and have fair skin with cool undertones this may lean a little warm. It isn't bad, but if they had a better match available I would want to get that.
THEY DO!! this is for fair with pink undertones
https://www.amazon.com/dp/B07RZ6QZLJ/

The BB cushion is a tad lighter, and a better match for my skin. I do like both. I tend to like cushion over liquid, but both of these are fantastic. I really like how these feel, and despite being a little warm on my cool skin, the make up looks good on the skin. Doesn't settle into every nook and cranny, nor dry flakes.
My skin is 40+ so this is something I look for in make up.

The primer is fantastic. A LITTLE GOES A LONG WAY. Use less than you think you need lest you want a more oily look to seep through. I find that primers like this are great for dry skin, and for more dry feeling foundations.. but their foundations arent drying. So less is more with their primer.

The formula for the liquid foundation really impresses me. Staying power is good. Skin feels comfortable. Skin looks healthy. I can touch my skin after and it doesn't feel like there is make up on. Provides really good coverage with a little bit yet doesn't look cakey and fake. Can be built up. I would recommend this over dermablend, personally. All my redness disappears (from Type 1 Rosacea). To provide a more sheer wash, just change up your application- use a damp sponge to put it on, or use a damp sponge as last step to blend it in and lighten it up.

I really think it is worth the try. I wasn't even going to try this, but since they provided so much information in their product description it really piqued my interest. If you need coverage with a natural look.. try this!

title: A fantastic product at a fantastic price
text:
I’ve tried other brands of argan oil, and have been surprised that some of the brands almost seem more like canola oil or a neutral oil, to where I almost wondered if some of them are counterfeit. Not so with this brand. This brand has the natural scent of the real deal, and is effective to boot. I have a baby, so have been washing my hands about 10 times a day, every time I change his diaper. Between that and all of the diaper wipes I use, my hands have been starting to peel and crack, so I knew I needed a solution.

This argan oil came with a regular lid, an eyedropper, and a pump dispenser. I used the pump dispenser and set it right next to my faucet so I could get a quick pump of oil every time I wash my hands. Well, it only took a couple of days to experience really great results. My hands feel normal again, and I am so relieved. From hard skin that was rough and crackled, to soft, happy hands again.

I have also used the product on my split ends, and here, I’d like to caution you that only a few drops are needed. It is very effective and soaks and well, so you only need a very small amount.

Overall, this argan oil is one of the best I have found. It comes packaged beautifully and looks like a gift, has multiple options for how you dispense it, and is pure, organic, and has the mild scent of real argan oil, unlike some competitors.
